title: Customer Relationship Management Manager
description:
**Company Description**
CBS Developers is a New Delhi–based real estate developer with a legacy of more than 50 years, now led by the third generation of the founding family. The company focuses on building homes that offer uncompromised ownership, drawing on deep industry experience and broad market knowledge. CBS is guided by core values of servitude, simplicity, and ethics, which shape its culture and approach to business. The organization aims to be recognized as a reasonable, responsible, and realistic developer with a strong focus on creating customer value and long-term relationships.
  
**Role Description**
The Customer Relationship Management Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in New Delhi, responsible for leading customer engagement and retention strategies across the organization. This role includes designing and implementing CRM processes, managing customer databases, and segmenting markets to support targeted communication and sales initiatives. The manager will oversee customer interaction touchpoints, monitor satisfaction levels, and work closely with sales, marketing, and project teams to ensure consistent, high-quality customer experiences. * Sales and Market Segmentation skills to support targeted campaigns, lead nurturing, and customer retention strategies.
* Project Management skills to plan, execute, and monitor CRM initiatives, timelines, and cross-team dependencies.
* Experience with CRM platforms and customer databases, preferably in real estate or related industries.
* Ability to build long-term customer relationships and handle escalations with professionalism and empathy.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Management, or a related field; advanced qualifications are an advantage.
* Proficiency in MS Office and familiarity with data visualization or reporting tools.
* Detail-oriented, organized, and able to work independently while aligning with organizational values and goals.

title: Key Account Manager - SCG India
description:
**Job Summary**

We are seeking a Key Account Manager to manage and develop strategic customer relationships, drive revenue growth, and expand business opportunities within the building materials and B2B sectors in India.

The role focuses on managing key accounts, understanding customer business needs, developing tailored commercial solutions, and building long-term partnerships to support sustainable business growth.

The ideal candidate will possess strong commercial acumen, negotiation skills, and experience managing strategic B2B customers in a competitive and dynamic business environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Key Account Management & Customer Relationship Development**

* Manage and develop relationships with key accounts, strategic customers, distributors, and business partners to drive long-term business growth.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned key accounts, ensuring effective communication, customer satisfaction, and timely resolution of business-related issues.
* Understand customers' business objectives, requirements, and challenges to identify opportunities for tailored products, services, and solutions.
* Build strong relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders to strengthen customer loyalty and long-term partnerships.

**Sales Growth & Business Development**

* Develop and implement account strategies and business plans to achieve sales targets, revenue growth, and profitability objectives.
* Identify opportunities to expand existing accounts through cross-selling, upselling, and new business initiatives.
* Explore potential customers and market opportunities within the building materials, construction, and related B2B industries.
* Monitor market trends, customer developments, and competitor activities to identify business opportunities and strengthen market positioning.

**Commercial Management & Negotiation**

* Lead commercial discussions and negotiations related to pricing, contracts, sales agreements, and business terms.
* Prepare sales proposals, quotations, and commercial presentations aligned with customer needs and company objectives.
* Monitor account profitability, pricing performance, and commercial risks to support sustainable business growth.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure effective contract execution, order fulfillment, and customer service.

**Cross-functional Collaboration & Sales Performance**

* Collaborate with Sales, Technical, Product, Supply Chain, Finance, and other relevant teams to deliver effective customer solutions.
* Coordinate with local and regional teams, including stakeholders in India and Thailand, to support key account requirements and business initiatives.
* Maintain accurate customer records, sales pipelines, forecasts, and account performance reports.
* Analyze customer performance and sales data to identify improvement opportunities and support business planning.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance customer experience and operational efficiency.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
* At least 3–5 years of relevant experience in key account management, B2B sales, business development, or commercial management.
* Experience in building materials, construction materials, manufacturing, industrial products, or international trading is preferred.
* Proven ability to manage customer relationships, negotiate commercial agreements, and achieve sales objectives.
* Strong understanding of B2B sales processes, account planning, pricing strategies, and customer relationship management.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a commercial and results-oriented mindset.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional and multicultural teams.
* Proficiency in English, both written and spoken.
* Willingness to travel within India to meet customers and business partners as required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience managing strategic accounts, major distributors, construction companies, developers, or industrial customers.
* Established professional networks within the building materials or construction-related industries.
* Experience in project sales, solution-based selling, or long-term B2B contract management.
* Experience working with multinational organizations or regional business teams.
* Familiarity with CRM systems, sales forecasting, and account performance analysis.

**About SCG**

SCG is one of Thailand's leading business conglomerates, with over 100 years of experience and a strong international presence across multiple industries.

In India, SCG operates through SCG International India Private Limited, focusing on international trading, building materials, sourcing, and supply chain solutions. SCG also participates in a joint venture with BigBloc Construction Limited to manufacture innovative building materials, including Autoclaved Aerated Concrete (AAC) blocks and wall panels.

SCG is committed to sustainable growth, innovation, and delivering high-quality products and solutions to meet evolving customer and market needs.

title: Merchant Onboarding Team Lead
description:
**About The Role**
You will own merchant onboarding at Loop from sales handoff to Success handover, across three regions. You will lead a team of Onboarding Specialists, set the operating standard for every onboarding, and be accountable for time to go live, onboarding quality, and early churn. This role is about building a predictable onboarding engine that scales with our growth. It is not about running onboardings yourself.
  
  
**What You Will Own**
Onboarding Delivery and Governance
  
  

* Own end to end onboarding performance: kickoff SLAs, milestone adherence, and go live dates across the full merchant portfolio.
* Set the standards for kickoff, weekly touchpoints, configuration, migration validation and handover, and audit adherence.
* Step in personally on strategic, high value or at risk merchants.

Cross Functional Partnership
  
  

* Act as the primary escalation point for Sales, Implementation Engineering, Migration, Product and Success.
* Improve the sales to onboarding handoff so merchants are scoped correctly before kickoff.
* Agree SLAs and escalation paths with Implementation Engineering and Migration, and hold all sides to them.
* Turn recurring merchant feedback into prioritised product inputs and track them to resolution.

Process, Tooling and Reporting
  
  

* Own onboarding playbooks, templates and documentation standards.
* Keep Salesforce, Sheets and internal dashboards accurate, and remove manual tracking wherever possible.
* Report weekly and monthly on onboarding health to leadership, with risks and corrective actions.
* Identify bottlenecks using data and redesign the process to remove them.

Merchant Experience and Retention
  
  

* Own the merchant experience during onboarding, including handling of delays, product gaps and escalations.
* Drive down churn during onboarding and in the first 30 days post handover.
* Ensure every handover to Success is complete, documented and accepted by the Success team.

Team Leadership and Capacity
  
  

* Lead, coach and grow a team of Onboarding Specialists across regions
* Plan capacity and allocate merchants by region, complexity and specialist bandwidth.
* Hire, onboard and ramp new specialists. Set clear performance goals and run regular 1:1s and reviews.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 7+ years in customer onboarding, implementation or customer success at a B2B SaaS company, with 3+ years managing teams of 10 or more.
* Experience leading distributed teams across multiple regions and time zones.
* Strong track record of running onboarding at scale with measurable improvement in time to value and early retention.
* Comfort with technical setups: integrations, data migration, configuration. You do not need to code, but you need to hold your own with engineers.
* Hands on with Salesforce and dashboarding; data driven in how you run the team.
* Calm, clear communicator in escalations with merchants and senior internal stakeholders.

description:
**Job Description**
HWSD Manager owns the end-to-end management of Hardware Services (HWS) transactions in progress, identifying, managing, and mitigating operational and delivery risks throughout the transaction lifecycle. The role ensures that customer Service Level Agreements (SLAs) are consistently achieved across all product and service offerings through effective coordination of cross-functional teams, proactive escalation management, performance monitoring, and continuous process improvement initiatives.

title: Senior Consultant
description:
**Your Impact**
As a Senior Consultant in Evalueserve's TMT Process Transformation & Managed Services practice, you will lead the delivery and continuous improvement of business processes for global technology clients. You will own services across the lifecycle of incentive, marketing and partner programs, from partner onboarding and enrollment through claim execution, support and payment reconciliation. The role combines process excellence, service governance, data-led insight and practical automation. You will simplify fragmented ways of working, standardize operations across regions and progressively move services from ticket-based task execution to outcome-owned delivery.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Process Operations & Client Delivery**

* Manage client processes across the full lifecycle of incentive, marketing and partner programs, including partner onboarding, enrollment, offer setup, claim execution, support and payment reconciliation.
* Take end-to-end ownership of service outcomes, balancing operational accuracy, turnaround times, stakeholder experience, risk controls and continuous improvement.
* Coordinate with client stakeholders, partners, global delivery teams, Credit and Collections, and other dependent functions to resolve issues and maintain service continuity.
* Respond to audit and control requests, maintain process evidence, track remediation actions and support adherence to approved procedures.
* Plan and execute user acceptance testing for client tools and workflow changes, document results, coordinate defect resolution and support controlled releases.
* Lead and mentor a team of process consultants and analysts, providing work allocation, coaching, quality oversight and professional development support.
* Monitor service performance, manage priorities and exceptions, and ensure that commitments, controls and client outcomes are consistently achieved.
* Build strong day-to-day client relationships through reliable execution, transparent communication and proactive resolution of operational risks.

**Process Excellence & Operating Model Transformation**

* Map end-to-end processes, document standard operating procedures and establish clear roles, hand-offs, controls, inputs and outputs.
* Standardize processes across regions while accounting for approved local variations, making delivery clear, consistent, efficient and transparent.
* Transform the operating model by consolidating services, eliminating non-value-adding work and streamlining fragmented activities rather than carrying forward current complexity.
* Apply an understand-explain-act-verify-prevent approach to identify patterns behind recurring work, evidence root causes, implement corrective actions and prevent recurrence.

**Automation, AI & Data Analytics**

* Identify and prioritize opportunities for workflow automation, intelligent routing, self-service, AI-assisted case handling and analytics-led decision support.
* Work with operations, technology and client teams to translate process pain points into practical automation or AI use cases with clear controls and measurable benefits.
* Use enrollment, claims, payment and service data to produce accurate reporting, identify trends and exceptions, and generate actionable insights for client stakeholders and partners.
* Support responsible use of AI-enabled tools by validating outputs, protecting confidential information, documenting human review points and monitoring operational performance.

**Experience And Education**

* 7-11 years of experience in process management, managed services, business operations, service delivery, process transformation or operational excellence.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex, multi-step processes and client relationships in a global delivery environment.
* Proven track record of improving process performance through standardization, simplification, root-cause resolution, automation or data-led interventions.
* Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, technology, operations or a related discipline.
* Master's degree or relevant certification in operations, process excellence, project management, analytics or automation is preferred.

**Skills And Knowledge**

* Strong process thinking, structured problem-solving and root-cause analysis skills, with the ability to connect operational activity to business outcomes.
* Hands-on experience in process mapping, SOP development, controls, service metrics, continuous improvement and operating model design.
* Strong stakeholder and governance management skills, including the ability to run service reviews, communicate risks and drive actions across client and delivery teams.
* Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills; experience with reporting and visualization tools such as Power BI is preferred.
* Working knowledge of workflow automation, AI-enabled operations, data analytics and UAT methods, with sound judgment on where human oversight is required.
* Strong program and service management capabilities, including planning, prioritization, issue management, quality control, change management and team leadership.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex process issues and present clear recommendations and decisions.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience in partner incentives, marketing programs, claims operations, payment reconciliation, partner support or related commercial operations.
* Experience consolidating or standardizing processes across regions, functions or service lines in a managed-services environment.
* Experience leading process analysts, operations teams or cross-functional improvement initiatives.
* Familiarity with process mining, workflow platforms, robotic process automation, generative AI, agentic workflows and business-intelligence tools.
* Exposure to audit support, operational controls, UAT, change implementation and service transition is desirable.

**Why This Role is Unique**

* Work directly with some of the world's leading technology companies to run and transform business-critical operational processes.
* Own processes end to end and improve the outcomes experienced by clients, partners and internal stakeholders.
* Build a differentiated combination of process excellence, managed-services leadership, data analytics, automation and applied AI expertise.
* Gain significant exposure to senior client stakeholders through service governance, transformation reviews and operational decision-making.
* Shape a more simplified, standardized and insight-led operating model while introducing automation and AI at a practical, responsible pace.
* Accelerate your career by combining operational ownership, technology understanding, people leadership and measurable client impact.

**How We Will Support Your Growth**
We are committed to nurturing your leadership potential. You will be paired with an Evalueserve mentor, work alongside high-performing teams on global TMT operations, and access learning programs in process excellence, managed services, data analytics, automation and applied AI.
  
  
Leadership Perspective
  
  
Pallab Kumar Deb, CEO
  
  
“Domain knowledge is the hardest thing to build in the age of AI. We've spent 25 years building it, workflow by workflow, in industries where getting the details wrong is expensive. That's what domain-led AI firm means here. Not a layer of AI on top of generic services, but AI built into the specific judgment calls our clients face every day. If you want to build AI that changes how real work gets done, not AI that just looks good in a demo, this is where that happens.”
  
  
Sanjoy Roy Choudhury, Executive Vice President
  
  
“With 25 years of Evalueserve—a journey that started with a bold vision to transform data into actionable insights and create lasting value for our clients. Over the years, we’ve evolved from delivering research to enabling digital transformation across industries, helping organizations navigate complexity with clarity.”
  
  
Why Join Evalueserve?
  
  
Evalueserve is a global leader in managed services that empower smarter decision-making and streamline critical workflows for more than 30% of the Fortune 500 companies across 45 countries. With over 4,500 professionals worldwide, our solutions are grounded in deep domain expertise and enhanced by cutting-edge AI and automation to boost productivity and scale client impact. Over the last 25 years, we have helped clients transform how they work—and today, we are pushing the frontier further with generative and agentic AI.
  
  
We foster a merit-based and innovation-driven culture that encourages creativity, continuous learning, and professional growth. Our hybrid working model provides international exposure and flexibility. Evalueserve has been recognized as a Great Place to Work® across four continents and ranks among the top 5% of global companies for diversity—alongside numerous awards across its solution lines.
  
  
Recent Awards and Recognitions
  
  

* AIM Research 2025: Top 10 of the “20 Best Firms for Women in Tech”
* Forrester Wave 2024: Leader in Market & Competitive Intelligence Platforms
* Chartis Research 2024: Category Leader in Credit Portfolio Management
* Credit Strategy Lending Awards 2024: Winner, “Best Technology Partner”
* Banking Tech Awards 2024: Highly Commended, “Best LendTech”

Follow Us
  
  
**Stay Connected And Learn More About Life At Evalueserve**

* Follow us on LinkedIn for the latest updates and career opportunities.
* Discover how our leaders are driving innovation through AI-powered supply chain optimization solution built on Google Cloud.
* Know how Evalueserve climbed 16 places on the “50 Best Firms for Data Scientists in 2024.”

title: Client Experience Manager
description:
**Location:**
Gurgaon

**Job Type:**
Full-time, in-person

**Salary:**
₹15,000 to ₹30,000 per month, depending on experience

**About Homeie**

Homeie is a technology company making it easier for people to rent homes.

In the same way that
**Zomato simplified food delivery, Blinkit simplified groceries, and companies like Snabbit are simplifying home services, Homeie is simplifying the process of renting a home.**

Today, finding a rental home usually means speaking to many brokers, searching through hundreds of listings, coordinating visits and handling everything yourself.

With Homeie, a customer simply tells us what kind of home they are looking for. Our technology and team then work with brokers across Gurgaon, find the most suitable homes, arrange the visits and help the customer through the complete process until they move in.

Homeie is a funded startup (we’ve raised close to INR 10 crores) and is currently building its team in Gurgaon.

**About the Role**

We are hiring a
**Client Experience Manager**
to manage our supply-side.

This is a good fit for people from
**retail, front office, guest relations or other similar roles**
who enjoy speaking to people and delivering a high-quality experience.

You will work from our Gurgaon office and use Homeie’s technology platform to manage brokers and properties. You will receive complete training before starting.

**Who We Are Looking For**

You may be a strong fit if you have experience in: Real estate or broker networks, tele-calling or telesales, sales or business development, vendor or partner management

We are especially looking for people who are:

• Well-spoken and confident in Hindi and English

• Polite, calm and professional with customers

• Good at understanding people and building trust

• Organised and reliable

• Comfortable using a laptop, WhatsApp and basic software

•
Familiar with Gurgaon, or quick to learn its areas

**Why Join Homeie**

You will work from a professional office, interact with premium customers, use technology every day and learn how a fast-growing startup operates.

You will also build valuable experience across
**customer experience, real estate, sales, technology and operations**
.

As Homeie grows, strong performers will have the opportunity to take on larger responsibilities, manage teams and grow into senior roles. There will also be monthly performance incentives for people who consistently deliver a great customer experience and help close transactions.

Monitor engineers' daily schedules, site visits, attendance, and service reports.

Handle customer complaints and escalations professionally.

Coordinate with clients and engineers to ensure quick and effective resolution.

Maintain regular communication with customers regarding service status and pending issues.

Ensure high customer satisfaction and build long-term client relationships.

Maintain service records, complaint logs, and customer feedback.

**D. AMC Management & Business Development**

Manage existing Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs), including renewals, service schedules, and compliance.

Contact existing clients to discuss AMC renewals and identify new AMC opportunities.

Convert eligible existing clients into AMC customers and generate recurring service revenue.

Prepare and coordinate AMC proposals, quotations, and renewal follow-ups with the sales team.

Maintain an AMC database with contract expiry dates, renewal status, and client details.

Identify opportunities to upsell service packages and additional maintenance support.

Ensure timely preventive maintenance visits as per AMC commitments.

**E. Reporting & Coordination**

Prepare and submit daily, weekly, and monthly service reports to management.

Track service KPIs, complaint resolution time, engineer productivity, and customer satisfaction.

Coordinate with the Sales, Projects, Procurement, and Finance departments for smooth operations.

Monitor spare parts requirements, service tools, and inventory coordination.

Maintain proper documentation of service calls, site visits, AMC contracts, and service expenses.

**3. Technical Skills Required**

The candidate should have sound knowledge of the following AV products and technologies:

Professional audio systems, amplifiers, mixers, DSPs, microphones, and speakers.

Video conferencing systems and collaboration solutions.

Projectors, professional displays, LED walls, and interactive flat panels.

Video switchers, matrix switchers, scalers, and signal processors.

Control systems, automation, and room control solutions.

AV over IP, HDMI, HDBaseT, and other AV connectivity technologies.

Basic networking concepts, IP configuration, and system integration.

Preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and fault diagnosis of AV systems.

**4. Educational Qualification & Experience**

Diploma or B.Tech in Electrical, Electronics, Electronics & Communication, or a related engineering field.

5–8 years of relevant experience in AV system integration, technical support, or service operations is preferred.

Prior experience managing AV engineers and handling customer escalations is essential.

title: Corporate Relations Manager
description:
Role at a glance

**A full-time, outcome-driven role combining office work in Delhi with field outreach to companies and campuses across Delhi NCR.**

About DIYguru

DIYguru Mobility Pvt. Ltd. is India's largest ASDC-certified EV skilling organisation. Since 2016, we have trained 95,000+ learners through 49 accredited programs, working with 528+ corporate partners across 8 countries.

We work with IIT Delhi, IIT Jammu, ASDC, AICTE, Bosch, Hyundai and Tata Technologies, and connect trained talent to employers through emobility.careers and the Bharat eMobility Recruitathon. DIYguru is looking for a Corporate Relations Lead to build and manage strong relationships with corporate recruiters, HR professionals, hiring managers, colleges, universities, ITIs, diploma institutes and industry stakeholders.

The role combines office-based and field-level outreach: visits to corporate offices, college campuses, universities, ITIs, industry events and networking platforms to develop new partnerships and generate measurable opportunities.

* Build and maintain relationships with HR Heads, Talent Acquisition teams, Hiring Managers and industry stakeholders.

* Ensure hiring partners confirm role, compensation and terms in writing before drives, in line with DIYguru's Hiring Partner Guidelines.

Campus & institute relations

* Visit colleges, universities, ITIs and diploma institutes to develop placement, hiring, internship and industry collaboration opportunities.
* Build and maintain relationships with college TPOs, placement officers, HODs, deans and training & placement teams.
* Identify opportunities for corporate training, industry projects, OJT, internships, placement drives and other industry–academia collaborations.

Representation & partnerships

* Represent DIYguru in corporate meetings, campus meetings, industry events, HR forums, job fairs, networking events and Recruitathons.
* Support corporate communication, employer branding, hiring partner engagement, partnership announcements and MoU coordination.

Reporting & tracking

* Maintain accurate CRM records, MIS, corporate and institute databases, lead pipelines, follow-up trackers and hiring reports.
* Track outreach activity and ensure measurable outcomes from every corporate visit, campus visit, meeting and networking activity.

Key skills

* Relationship & communication: Strong corporate and professional communication; corporate relationship management; strong networking and relationship-building skills; ability to run meetings and presentations.
* Business development: Field sales / business development mindset; lead generation and conversion; negotiation and follow-up; LinkedIn networking and outreach; college and industry outreach.
* Placement know-how: Recruitment and placement coordination; understanding of JDs and hiring requirements.
* Tools & reporting: Excel / Google Sheets, CRM and MIS management.
* Working style: Willingness to travel locally for corporate and campus visits; comfortable working with targets, field activities and measurable outcomes.

Who can apply
  
Qualifications & experience

* Graduate in any discipline; an MBA or PGDM in HR, Marketing or Business Development is preferred.
* 2–5 years of experience in corporate relations, B2B sales, business development, campus relations, placements or recruitment.
* Experience working with HR teams, recruiters or college placement cells is a strong plus.
* Familiarity with the EV, automotive, engineering or skilling sector is an advantage.

The ideal candidate

We prefer candidates who are comfortable with field outreach, travelling for meetings, and actively developing relationships with companies and educational institutions.

The ideal candidate can confidently meet HR teams, recruiters, TPOs, college management and industry professionals, understand their requirements, and convert those relationships into actual hiring and partnership opportunities.

What we offer

* Visible impact: Every partnership you build turns into jobs, internships and careers for EV learners.
* A strong network to start from: Work with DIYguru's base of 528+ corporate partners and established academic relationships.
* Flagship events: Play a lead role in employer engagement for the Bharat eMobility Recruitathon as it expands to new cities.
* Ownership: Build and own corporate relationships in one of India's fastest-growing sectors.
* Growth: A performance-based annual appraisal cycle and room to grow as DIYguru expands nationally and internationally.

title: Paid Media - Account Manager (Meta & Google Ads)
description:
**We’re hiring an Paid Media - Account Manager (Meta & Google) at Neuroid**

Location: Ghitorni, New Delhi

Setup: In-office (4 days WFO)

Type: Full-time

Neuroid is a performance and content agency built for D2C brands - furniture, jewellery, skincare, apparel, F&B - managing ad spend in crores every month. We integrate performance marketing with content and creative, so the ads and the assets behind them are built to work together, not handed across a wall.

We’re hiring an Account Manager to own the relationship side of 8 to 10 D2C accounts. You sit between the founder, the media buyers and the client. The buyers run the ads; you run the account - the numbers, the conversation, the next step, and the renewal. This is not a client-servicing role where you forward emails. If you can’t open Ads Manager and explain why ROAS moved without a buyer in the room, this isn’t for you.

**What you’ll do**

* Weekly performance reviews with every client: what we spent, what it returned, what changes next week, sent before they ask
* The relationship: you are the first call for every account you hold; the founder is the escalation, not the default
* Scope and renewals: track what was promised, flag scope creep, run the renewal conversation 30 days before expiry
* Churn prevention: spot an unhappy account early and fix it with the buyer, not after the client has already decided
* Creative and content coordination: make sure what the buyer needs from the content team is briefed, dated and delivered
* Upsell: know when a client is ready for Google, retention or a creative mandate, and make the case

**Who this is for**

* 2 to 4 years in performance marketing for D2C or ecommerce - ideally a media buyer who now wants to own accounts, or an AM at a performance agency who actually understands the ads
* You know what a healthy D2C P&L looks like: ROAS, CAC, AOV, contribution margin, and why a brand at 2X might be fine and a brand at 4X might not be
* You write clearly, run a meeting without a deck, and are comfortable telling a client something they don’t want to hear
* You’ve managed at least 5 accounts at once and nobody slipped
* Available full-time, in-office at Ghitorni (3rd Floor, 354, 100ft Road, near Ghitorni metro), starting November

**What you get**

* 8 to 10 named accounts from day one, with real authority over how they’re run
* Direct access to the founder, the Head of Ops and the buyers; no layers
* A path to Head of Accounts as the book grows

**How to apply**

Email hr@neuroidmedia.com with the subject “Account Manager”. Tell us in three to five lines about one account you saved or grew, with numbers. No cover letters.

title: Head of Customer Success – Cloud & FinOps
description:
**About The Opportunity**
We are partnering with a fast-growing, profitable global cloud cost optimization and FinOps organization that helps enterprises optimize cloud spending, improve operational efficiency and maximize the value of their cloud investments.
  
  
Serving hundreds of customers across multiple countries, the organization operates across AWS, Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud, combining cloud consulting, cost optimization, managed services and proprietary cloud management platforms.
  
  
We are looking for a Head of Customer Success to lead and scale an established customer-facing organization as the business continues to grow.
  
  
This is an opportunity for a technically grounded, customer-centric leader who can combine cloud expertise, operational excellence, people leadership and proactive customer engagement to build a consistent, measurable and scalable Customer Success function.
  
  
The Role
  
  
You will lead an established centralized Customer Success team of approximately 12–15 professionals, with the opportunity to expand the team as the customer base grows.
  
  
Your mandate is to strengthen the way the organization serves its customers by building robust operating processes, improving service quality, increasing adoption of cloud optimization platforms, and ensuring every customer receives timely, technically sound and commercially meaningful support.
  
  
This is not a build-from-scratch or turnaround assignment. It is an opportunity to take a functioning operation to the next level of scale, consistency and performance.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Customer Success Leadership & Team Development

Lead, coach and develop a centralized Customer Success organization of 12–15 professionals.
  
  
Define team structure, roles, responsibilities, capacity planning and hiring requirements for future growth.
  
  
Establish performance expectations, capability-development programs and a culture of accountability.
  
  
Build a scalable operating model that maintains service quality as the customer base expands.
  
  

* Customer Experience & Escalation Management

Own the overall customer experience across billing queries, cloud operations, technical escalations and platform-related requests.
  
  
Ensure customer issues are driven to resolution, even when they require coordination across Engineering, Cloud Operations, Finance, Product or external cloud-provider teams.
  
  
Establish clear escalation paths, accountability, response commitments and proactive customer communication.
  
  
Engage with senior customer stakeholders to resolve critical concerns and strengthen long-term relationships.
  
  

* Cloud Billing, Cost Management & FinOps

Guide customer conversations around cloud consumption, billing discrepancies, cost trends and optimization opportunities.
  
  
Understand AWS billing constructs, including Reserved Instances, Savings Plans, credits, partner benefits and invoice reconciliation.
  
  
Work closely with FinOps and cloud engineering teams to investigate cost anomalies, identify optimization opportunities and communicate findings clearly.
  
  
Help customers understand their cloud expenditure and make informed decisions about cost, utilization and operational efficiency.
  
  
Coordinate AWS support cases, billing investigations, credits and refunds where applicable.
  
  

* Customer Success Operations & Process Excellence

Build and standardize SOPs, playbooks, response templates, troubleshooting guides and a centralized knowledge base.
  
  
Establish and continuously improve service metrics, including response times, resolution SLAs, backlog, customer satisfaction and recurring issues.
  
  
Introduce consistent workflows for billing queries, escalations, customer reviews and cross-functional issue resolution.
  
  
Use operational data to identify recurring problems, improve productivity and reduce reliance on individual team members.
  
  

* Product Adoption & Proactive Engagement

Drive meaningful adoption of cloud cost visibility, analytics and optimization platforms.
  
  
Develop customer enablement programs that help customers realize value beyond commercial cloud discounts.
  
  
Identify customers with low product adoption, emerging risks or untapped optimization opportunities.
  
  
Establish a proactive engagement rhythm through monthly and quarterly business reviews, cost-anomaly monitoring and regular value-realization discussions.
  
  
Measure adoption through actual platform utilization, implemented recommendations and realized customer value—not simply logins or registrations.
  
  

* Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner closely with Cloud Engineering, Cloud Reliability, Solution Architecture, Product, Onboarding, Finance and Sales.
  
  
Establish clear ownership for issues that span multiple functions.
  
  
Support the Sales organization by building the customer satisfaction, adoption and service foundation that enables renewals and expansion.
  
  
Work with cloud-provider and partner teams to resolve customer concerns and improve service delivery.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**
10+ years of overall professional experience, with a meaningful foundation in cloud support, Technical Account Management (TAM), cloud operations, AWS billing or cloud cost management.
  
  
At least 4–5 years of recent leadership experience in Customer Success, technical account servicing, cloud operations or service delivery.
  
  
Demonstrated experience managing and developing a team of 10+ professionals.
  
  
Strong practical understanding of AWS cloud billing and cost management, including Reserved Instances, Savings Plans, AWS credits, invoicing and the AWS support/case process.
  
  
Experience building or improving SOPs, service playbooks, knowledge bases, SLA frameworks, KPI dashboards and operational processes.
  
  
Experience driving proactive customer engagement, platform adoption, optimization initiatives or customer-value programs.
  
  
Excellent communication, customer management, problem-solving and cross-functional leadership skills.
  
  
Ability to explain technical billing and cloud-cost concepts clearly to customer stakeholders.
  
  
Willingness to work from the Noida office five days a week.
  
  
**Preferred Background**
Candidates from the following environments are particularly encouraged to apply:
  
  
AWS Partner organizations, Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and cloud resellers.
  
  
Cloud consulting, managed cloud services and cloud financial management organizations.
  
  
FinOps, cloud cost optimization and cloud management platform companies.
  
  
Product or SaaS companies, provided the candidate has substantial hands-on cloud billing and cost-management expertise.
  
  
Experience with Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud is valuable, but general cloud experience alone will not replace the required AWS billing knowledge.
  
  
What Success Looks Like in the First 12 Months
  
  
A consistent, high-quality customer experience across the entire customer base.
  
  
Standardized playbooks and workflows for common customer interactions and billing queries.
  
  
Clearly defined and regularly reviewed service metrics, response times and resolution SLAs.
  
  
Stronger adoption of cloud visibility and optimization platforms.
  
  
Improved proactive communication, cost-anomaly outreach and customer-value realization.
  
  
A scalable team structure, capability-development plan and hiring roadmap for the next phase of growth.
  
  
Why Consider This Opportunity?
  
  
Lead an established Customer Success organization in a high-growth cloud and FinOps business.
  
  
Work at the intersection of cloud technology, customer experience and financial optimization.
  
  
Build scalable processes and operating practices with measurable business impact.
  
  
Partner with senior leadership and cross-functional teams.
  
  
Performance-based incentives, ESOP participation and comprehensive benefits.
  
  
Interested?
  
  
If you have a combination of AWS cloud expertise, customer-facing leadership, cloud billing knowledge and a track record of building scalable service operations, we would love to hear from you.

* Set clear scorecards covering acquisition, activation, AQB/AMB, transaction activity, fee income, cross-sell, productivity, service quality and compliance.
* Conduct structured coaching through joint market visits, call observations, weekly reviews and capability-building sessions.
* Identify skill gaps and develop targeted interventions around sales planning, segment understanding, solution selling, digital banking and compliance.
* Maintain a strong talent pipeline and manage attrition proactively.

**Key Performance Indicators**
**Dimension**
**Illustrative KPIs**
**Acquisition**
New-to-bank current accounts, high-value accounts, segment-wise acquisition
  
  
**Balance Growth**
AQB/AMB growth, activated accounts, value build-up and balance retention
  
  
**Transaction Primacy**
Inward credits, transaction-active accounts and payment/collection volumes
  
  
**Revenue**
Fee income, POS/QR revenue, cash-management revenue and cross-sell revenue
  
  
**Product Penetration**
Internet banking, POS, debit/business card, FFD, assets and promoter banking

Non-activation rate, dormant accounts, early attrition, balance decline and compliance exceptions

Productivity per RM, conversion rate, hiring quality, attrition and training completion
  
  
**Customer Experience**
Onboarding TAT, service-resolution TAT, complaint trends and retention of top accounts
  
  
**Candidate Profile**
**Experience**

* 8–15 years of relevant experience in banking, preferably in current accounts, CASA, business banking, SME banking, transaction banking, branch banking or merchant acquiring.
* At least 3–5 years in a people-leadership role managing sales managers, relationship managers or acquisition teams.
* Demonstrated track record of building a current-account portfolio, increasing operating balances and delivering cross-sell revenue.
* Experience in managing business clusters, market catchments, branch ecosystems or multi-location sales teams is preferred.

**Education**

* Graduate degree required.
* MBA / PGDM in Finance, Sales, Marketing or Banking preferred.
* Relevant certifications in banking, KYC/AML, payments or financial products are an advantage.

**Skills And Competencies**

* Strong understanding of current-account economics, CASA, transaction banking, payments, merchant acquiring and business-client needs.
* Proven ability to lead field sales, build market networks and execute through branches and partner channels.
* Solution-selling mindset with ability to connect client pain points to banking products.
* Strong command of sales analytics, funnel management, portfolio reviews and performance dashboards.
* Excellent stakeholder-management skills across branches, products, operations, risk and service.
* High integrity, sound judgement and uncompromising compliance orientation.
* Strong communication, negotiation, coaching and executive-presence skills.

*A high-energy banking sales leader who can build a cluster-wide current-account franchise—not merely open accounts. The successful candidate will create transaction-active, balance-building, profitable client relationships by combining market-led acquisition, disciplined team execution, digital and payment solutions and deep promoter-level engagement.*

title: Account Manager
description:
**We’re Hiring: Account Manager (Client Decoder & Internal Orchestrator)**

Most Account Managers operate as glorified postmen—they take a messy email from a client, forward it to the creative team, and watch the chaos unfold. We aren’t looking for a postman.

We are looking for a lethal Account Manager who operates in the future. We need someone with the emotional intelligence to decode exactly what a client
*actually*
wants, and the internal leadership to rally our creative and performance teams to deliver it flawlessly. If you thrive on proactive organization and hate last-minute scrambles, this is your room.

**What You’ll Be Doing (The Real Work):**

* **The Client Decoder:**
  Clients don't always know how to articulate their business problems. You will read between the lines, extract their true objectives, manage their expectations, and translate their feedback into razor-sharp, actionable briefs for our team.
* **The 30-Day Proactive Rule:**
  You do not operate reactively. Your core mandate is to build systems and timelines that ensure we are fully prepped, aligned, and have assets ready
  **30 days**
  before the client even realizes they need them. You eliminate the "urgent" agency culture.
* **The Internal Diplomat:**
  You are the bridge between the client and the agency, but you fiercely protect the internal team's time. You build immense rapport with our designers, copywriters, and media buyers because you bring them clarity, structured timelines, and zero friction.
* **Account Growth & Strategy:**
  You don’t just farm accounts; you grow them. Because you are constantly 30 days ahead, you have the mental bandwidth to pitch new strategic initiatives, cross-sell services, and act as a true growth partner to the founders we work with.
* **Expectation Management:**
  You are comfortable saying "no" to a client when a request threatens the quality of the work or the timeline, but you do it with such tact that they thank you for it.

**Who You Are:**

* **You are a master communicator:**
  You can de-escalate a panicked client on a phone call and immediately write a clear, calm Slack update to the internal team.
* **You are hyper-organized:**
  Your project management boards (ClickUp, Asana, Notion) are immaculate. You track deliverables with military precision.
* **You are a culture multiplier:**
  The internal team actually
  *wants*
  to work on your accounts because you make their jobs easier, not harder.
* **You understand digital marketing:**
  You aren't just a people person; you understand performance marketing, creative strategy, and D2C brand growth enough to have highly technical conversations with both the client and the media buying team.

**If you know how to build deep client trust and keep an agency running 30 days ahead of schedule, apply below.**

title: Account Director, Digital Natives
description:
**About The Team**
OpenAI’s mission is to build safe artificial general intelligence (AGI) which benefits all of humanity. This long-term undertaking brings the world’s best scientists, engineers, and business professionals into one lab together to accomplish this.
  
  
In pursuit of this mission, our Go To Market (GTM) team is responsible for helping customers learn how to leverage and deploy our highly capable AI products across their business. The team is made of Sales, Solutions, Support, Marketing, and Partnership professionals that work together to create valuable solutions that will help bring AI to as many users as possible.
  
  
**About The Role**
Our Sales team has a unique mission to help customers understand the deep impact that highly capable AI models can bring to their business and users. This role is a mixture of technical understanding, vision, partnership, and value-driven strategy.
  
  
You’ll be a key driver of opportunities through the entire sales cycle, from pipeline generation to closure. You’ll work with researchers, engineers, and solution strategists to help customers evolve their industry with AI.
  
  
This role can be based in Delhi or Mumbai
  
  
**In This Role, You'll**

* Manage a portfolio of customer accounts, developing and executing strategies for a comprehensive account plan
* Support your customer accounts from initial engagement to successful deployment and through to renewal
* Partner with solutions and research engineering to build and execute complex customer programs and projects
* Own a revenue target
* Manage revenue forecasts
* Analyze key account metrics to create reports and provide insights to internal and external stakeholders
* Closely monitor the industry landscape (people, competitors, partners, etc.) to contribute to product roadmap and other corporate strategies
* Collaborate with solutions, marketing, communications, business operations, people operations, finance, product management, and engineering
* Support the recruitment and onboarding of other teammates
* Support the development of company culture

**We're Seeking Someone With Experience Including**

* 7+ years selling and renewing platform-as-a-service and/or software-as-a-service
* Designing and executing complex deal strategies
* Supporting the growth of fast-growing, high-performance companies
* Working directly with c-level executives
* Communicating technical concepts to customers and internal stakeholders
* Gathering, distilling, and processing complex market (industry, competitor, customer, prospect) intelligence

**You Might Thrive In This Role If You**

* Are customer-centric. You are motivated to deeply understand your customer’s priorities and help them achieve their vision for using our models to improve their products and services. You build strong relationships with executives and professionals across functions and serve as a trusted advisor.
* Have a passion or deep curiosity in artificial intelligence. You embrace the opportunity to help deploy our technology in a way that benefits humanity. You’re excited to educate our customers on AI and how to plan for the future.
* Are a builder. You are excited to impact how our company operates and scales. Your passion is building strong systems and processes from the ground up and executing them with precision.
* Are excited by new challenges. You don’t have the answers to every question up front, but the process of solving them invigorates you. Bespoke issues requiring multidimensional knowledge excite you. You’re willing to experiment with new solutions.
* Are a strategist. You deeply understand go to market best practices and raise the bar for our organization. You think and plan forward on the order of years and bring internal and external stakeholders along with your strategy.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. * High energy, execution focus, and customer obsession

* Prior experience with National Instruments / Emerson Test & Measurement solutions will be a strong advantage

Our culture offers flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation and holiday leave.

At Emerson, we are motivated by a spirit of collaboration that helps our diverse, multicultural teams across the world drive innovation that makes the world healthier, safer, smarter, and more sustainable. And we want you to join us in our bold aspiration.
  
  
We have built an engaged community of inquisitive, dedicated people who thrive knowing they are welcomed, trusted, celebrated, and empowered to solve the world’s most complex problems — for our customers, our communities, and the planet. You’ll contribute to this vital work while further developing your skills through our award-winning employee development programs. We take this responsibility seriously and strive to make a positive impact through every endeavor.

description:

Conducting MBR/QBR’s is a

vital part of the role, mind of a project manager and heart of customer relations.

title: Sr. Delivery Consultant, Customer Experience, Professional Services
description:
**Description**
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
We are seeking a Senior Delivery Consultant specializing in Amazon Connect Customer Experience to join AWS Professional Services. In this role, you will design, build, and deliver complex customer experience solutions on Amazon Connect, serving as the technical authority for enterprise-grade contact center transformations. You will spend \*\*80% of your time\*\* hands-on — architecting and implementing CX solutions — while leading pre-sales engagements, driving team capability development, and integrating AI-native approaches into every engagement.
  
  
This is a customer-facing delivery leadership role that combines deep technical execution with strategic consulting, pre-sales leadership, and practice development.
  
  
As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Designing and implementing complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions tailored to customer needs
* Providing technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout project delivery
* Collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and propose effective migration strategies
* Acting as a trusted advisor to customers on industry trends and emerging technologies
* Sharing knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable artifacts

## Required Qualifications
  
  
### Technical Expertise
  
  

* \*\*10+ years\*\* of hands-on experience designing and implementing Amazon Connect solutions (or equivalent enterprise contact center platforms with 3+ years on Connect)
* \*\*Deep proficiency\*\* in Amazon Connect ecosystem: Contact Flows, Routing Profiles, Contact Lens, Amazon Q in Connect, Lex, Outbound Campaigns, Tasks, Cases, and Customer Profiles
* \*\*Strong software engineering skills\*\* — Python, TypeScript/Node.js, AWS CDK/CloudFormation, CI/CD pipelines, serverless architectures (Lambda, Step Functions, DynamoDB, SQS/SNS)
* \*\*AI/ML competency\*\* — practical experience implementing generative AI solutions using Amazon Bedrock, LLM-based agents, prompt engineering, RAG architectures, and conversational AI (Lex, Q in Connect)
* \*\*Integration expertise\*\* — building production integrations with CRM/ITSM systems (Salesforce, ServiceNow, Zendesk), telephony (SIP/PSTN), and workforce management platforms
* \*\*Architecture at scale\*\* — designing multi-region, multi-tenant, highly available contact center architectures handling 10,000+ concurrent contacts

### Consulting & Leadership
  
  

* \*\*Pre-sales experience\*\* — led or co-led 5+ customer proposals/SOWs including effort estimation, delivery planning, and technical presentations to senior stakeholders
* \*\*Delivery leadership\*\* — managed end-to-end delivery on engagements with 5+ team members, navigating scope changes, customer escalations, and go-live coordination
* \*\*Stakeholder management\*\* — demonstrated ability to build trusted advisor relationships with VP/C-level customer stakeholders
* \*\*Mentoring track record\*\* — coached or mentored 3+ junior consultants; contributed to team hiring decisions

### Certifications (Required or within 6 months of hire)
  
  

* AWS Solutions Architect – Professional
* AWS Certified AI Practitioner or ML Specialty
* Amazon Connect Specialty (or equivalent demonstrated expertise)

\* \* \*
  
  
## Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Experience with \*\*Amazon Connect Agent Workspace\*\*, \*\*Step-by-step Guides\*\*, and \*\*Connect APIs\*\* for custom CRM embedding
* Hands-on with \*\*agentic AI frameworks\*\* — multi-agent orchestration, MCP (Model Context Protocol), AgentCore, Strands SDK
* Knowledge of \*\*contact center operations\*\* — WFM, quality management, compliance recording, PCI-DSS, HIPAA considerations
* Experience \*\*migrating legacy platforms\*\* (Genesys, Avaya, Cisco, NICE) to Amazon Connect
* Background in \*\*voice AI\*\* — real-time STT/TTS, voice biometrics, IVR modernization, voicebot design
* Published \*\*thought leadership\*\* — blogs, conference talks, whitepapers, or reference architectures in the CX/contact center domain
* Familiarity with \*\*ProServe delivery mechanisms\*\* — PDLC, engagement management, CSAT frameworks, utilization tracking

\* \* \*
  
  
## Working Model
  
  

* \*\*80% Delivery:\*\* Hands-on customer engagements — designing, building, deploying Connect CX solutions
* \*\*10% Pre-Sales:\*\* Discovery workshops, proposals, estimations, customer presentations
* \*\*10% Practice:\*\* Team mentoring, capability uplift, TFC contributions, product team collaboration

\* \* \*
  
  
## About the Team
  
  
AWS Professional Services works with enterprise customers to accelerate cloud adoption and realize transformational business outcomes. The Connect CX practice delivers contact center modernization, AI-powered customer experience solutions, and omnichannel transformation programs for some of the world's largest organizations.
  
  
We are builders who are obsessed with customer outcomes, thrive in ambiguity, and believe the best solutions come from deep technical expertise combined with genuine curiosity about customer problems.
  
  
\* \* \*
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Solution Design & Delivery (80%)

Architect and deliver complex Amazon Connect implementations including multi-channel (voice, chat, email, task) contact center solutions for enterprise customers
  
  

* Design end-to-end CX solutions encompassing contact flows, routing strategies, agent workspaces, real-time and historical analytics, workforce management integration, and omnichannel orchestration
* Lead technical delivery on engagements valued at $1M+ — owning architecture decisions, HLD/LLD documentation, implementation patterns, and production go-live
* Build production-grade integrations with CRM systems (Salesforce, ServiceNow), backend applications, and third-party platforms using Lambda, API Gateway, EventBridge, and Step Functions
* Implement AI-powered capabilities including Amazon Q in Connect, Contact Lens, Lex-based conversational AI, generative AI agents, sentiment analysis, real-time transcription, and intelligent routing
* Design and deploy agentic AI solutions multi-agent orchestration, tool-calling frameworks, prompt engineering, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop workflows within the contact center context
* Ensure operational excellence establish monitoring (CloudWatch, Contact Lens), alerting, disaster recovery, and performance optimization for production contact center environments
* Create reusable delivery accelerators CDK constructs, solution patterns, reference architectures, and automation frameworks that reduce future engagement timelines
* Pre-Sales Leadership (10%)
* Lead customer discovery conduct workshops, ideation sessions, and technical deep-dives to understand customer pain points and define CX transformation roadmaps
* Create compelling proposals develop SOWs, technical architectures, effort estimations, and delivery plans for complex Connect engagements
* Present to C-suite and senior stakeholders articulate business value, ROI projections, and differentiated solution approaches during competitive evaluations
* Support pipeline development collaborate with Account Managers, Solutions Architects, and Engagement Managers to identify and qualify opportunities worth $500K–$5M+

• Customer-first mindset with exceptional interpersonal skills.

Strong communication and collaboration skills, and experience managing by influence
  
  
BT Group is the UK’s leading communications group and the holding company behind some of the country’s most recognised brands – including BT, EE, Openreach and Plusnet. Our customers include consumers, small, medium and large businesses, public sector organisations and other communications providers.
  
  
BT Group’s role is about setting direction, unlocking value and creating the conditions for our brands and businesses to thrive.

We have a singular culture that unites all our people: we are customer-first challengers, who are committed, clear and connected. These behaviours unite us as one team to deliver for our colleagues, our customers, our stakeholders and the country. GobbleCube is an agentic growth operating system designed to help brands scale profitably across digital marketplaces. Founded in November 2022 by the ex- core team of Blinkit, the platform went live commercially from private beta in September 2024.

Since then, GobbleCube has scaled rapidly, supporting 600+ brands across enterprise and D2C, growing revenue 10X, and onboarding 45 of India’s largest CPG enterprises in just the last 9 months, including HUL, Nivea, Tata Consumer Products, ITC, Godrej, Beiersdorf, MTR, L’Oréal, Hershey’s, and many more.

As commerce becomes more distributed and hyperlocal, GobbleCube is building agentic solutions to help brands navigate complexity in real time, across visibility, performance marketing, supply chain, and growth strategy. Headquartered in Gurugram, the company supports brands across India, MENA, and LATAM.

**About the role**

We are looking for a Customer Success Manager from a Tier 1 college to join our high- growth SaaS company. The ideal candidate will have strong problem-solving skills and the ability to transform customer challenges into revenue opportunities. This role involves program management, revenue management, and building scalable solutions and teams to drive business growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

● Work closely with customers to understand their pain points / deep solves, build scalable

solutions and convert them into revenue opportunities.

● Oversee key accounts, ensuring customer satisfaction, retention, and revenue growth.

● Build and standardize operational processes, frameworks, and SOPs to scale customer success and account growth.

● Act as a bridge between customers and internal teams (sales, onboarding, product and tech) to align desired business outcomes of the clients.

● Leverage data analytics to track customer usage, identify growth opportunities, and improve business strategies.

● Identify and drive opportunities for expanding revenue from existing customers through additional product offerings.

● Conduct regular check-ins and business reviews with customers, ensuring they derive maximum value from GobbleCube's platform.

**Required Skills**

● Bachelor’s/Master's degree from a Tier 1 college (IITs, IIMs, ISB, NITs, etc.).

● 3+ years of experience in Growth, Customer Success, Strategy & Ops, Business Consulting, or a related role in a B2B SaaS/FMCG/Ecommerce/Internet company.

● Strong problem-solving skills with a structured approach to tackling business challenges.

● Experience in program management, account management, and setting up scalable processes/solutions.

● Excellent analytical skills with proficiency in data tools (Excel and SQL).

● Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

● Proven track record of driving revenue growth through customer engagement and optimization strategies.

title: Key Account Manager
description:
**About the Role**

The Key Account Manager will be responsible for managing key enterprise accounts, driving customer success, ensuring service performance, and identifying opportunities for revenue growth. This role sits at the intersection of Customer Success, Revenue, Operations, Finance, and Product. The ideal candidate should be customer focused, commercially sharp, data-driven, and strong in execution. The person should be able to build strong customer relationships, understand account-level performance, resolve issues proactively, and work internally with cross-functional teams to ensure high customer satisfaction and account growth.

**Responsibilities**

* Own and manage relationships with assigned key accounts.
* Act as the single point of contact for customers for business, service, operational, and escalation-related matters.
* Drive account growth through retention, upsell, cross-sell, and increased wallet share.
* Understand customer requirements and work with internal teams to deliver reliable logistics solutions.
* Track account-level performance including revenue, order volume, service levels, delivery success rate, TAT, escalations, and customer satisfaction.
* Prepare account MIS, performance dashboards, weekly/monthly reviews, and business review presentations.
* Coordinate with Operations, Product, Technology, Finance, and Customer Success teams to resolve customer issues and improve service delivery.
* Identify revenue leakage, pricing gaps, operational inefficiencies, and margin improvement opportunities.
* Support onboarding of new customers and ensure smooth transition from sales closure to operations execution.
* Conduct regular customer reviews to understand feedback, business needs, and future growth opportunities.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* 4–6 years of experience in key account management, customer success, revenue, business development, or client servicing roles.
* Prior experience in logistics, quick commerce, e-commerce, SaaS, marketplace, supply chain, or B2B platform businesses preferred.

**Required Skills**

* Good understanding of revenue growth, account expansion, retention, and customer success.
* Strong analytical ability with comfort in Excel, MIS, dashboards, and performance tracking.
* Ability to work with data and identify trends, gaps, and improvement opportunities.
* Excellent communication, problem-solving, ownership, and follow-up discipline.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
**Role**

You run a team that manages about 20 D2C brands (fashion and wellness) on Meta ads. You are every founder’s single point of contact, and you lead a Media Buyer, a Creative Strategist and an Editor. You’re judged on each brand’s revenue, ROAS and retention, not on how happy the client sounds. You report to the Co-founder & COO. You need 2–6 years of D2C or e-commerce experience running Meta ads.

**You'll love this role**

* **Ownership**

  : When a brand drops, you look first at what you control.
* **Calm under pressure**

  : When a founder panics, you respond with facts and a plan.
* **Hunger**

  : You act without being chased and build what’s missing.
* **Humility**

  and coachability: You credit the team and own the misses.
* **Fast learning**

  : You pick up a new skill and use it the same week.

**This won't be a fit if you**

* Find client calls, team follow-ups or weekly reports draining
* Say yes to every founder request to keep the peace
* Would rather do the work yourself than get it done through a team
* Need reminders to send reports and updates
* Would be upset by an occasional weekend client emergency

**Day-to-day responsibilities**

* Run the daily morning check-in and assign work with a goal, an owner and a deadline
* Handle all founder communication: updates, bad news and saying no
* Review briefs and creatives before anything goes live
* Make budget and scaling calls with the Media Buyer, and find out why ROAS dropped before asking for new creatives or more budget
* Track how many creatives are briefed, built and launched, and fix wherever work gets stuck
* Review each brand’s numbers weekly and agree the next week’s plan with its founder
* Score each pod member with numbers every Saturday and post the weekly goals (OKRs)
* Get each newly signed brand live within 48 hours, with access, tracking and the pod brief done

**CTC, timings, location**

* **Pay**

  : ₹60,000–1,00,000 a month fixed, plus a 10% client-retention incentive and a bonus per client testimonial
* **Hours**

  : 10 AM–6 PM, 6 days a week
* **Location**

  : Gurugram, Hybrid

title: Media Services Manager
description:
Job Description: Media Servicing Lead

📍 Location: Gurgaon

💼 Experience: 8–10 Years

🏢 Industry: Advertising, Media & Integrated Marketing Agency

🕒 Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and strategic Media Servicing Lead to lead client relationships, manage media accounts and oversee the planning, execution and delivery of integrated media campaigns.

The ideal candidate will act as the primary point of contact for key clients while coordinating with internal media planning, buying, digital, creative and account management teams. This role requires strong client servicing expertise, commercial understanding, media knowledge and leadership skills to ensure campaign effectiveness, client satisfaction and long-term account growth.

Key Responsibilities

1. Client Relationship & Account Management

- Own end-to-end client servicing for assigned media accounts and act as the primary point of contact.

- Build and maintain strong relationships with client stakeholders across marketing, brand, media and leadership teams.

- Understand client business objectives, target audiences, brand priorities and communication requirements.

- Manage client expectations, feedback, approvals and escalations professionally.

- Drive client satisfaction, retention and long-term account relationships.

- Identify opportunities to expand existing accounts through additional media services and integrated solutions.

2. Media Planning & Strategy

- Understand client briefs and translate business objectives into effective media strategies.

- Work closely with media planning and buying teams to develop integrated media plans.

- Contribute to media mix recommendations across digital and traditional channels, depending on client requirements.

- Ensure media strategies align with campaign objectives, target audiences, budgets and timelines.

- Participate in campaign planning, brainstorming sessions, client presentations and strategic reviews.

- Evaluate media proposals and recommendations to ensure they meet client expectations.

- Identify opportunities to improve reach, engagement, campaign efficiency and overall media effectiveness.

3. Campaign Execution & Delivery

- Oversee end-to-end execution of media campaigns from briefing and planning to launch and reporting.

- Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely delivery of media plans, campaign assets, bookings and other deliverables.

- Monitor campaign progress, schedules, media placements and agreed deliverables.

- Ensure all campaign activities are executed according to approved plans and client requirements.

- Track campaign performance and coordinate with relevant teams on optimisation opportunities.

- Proactively identify delivery risks, delays and dependencies and implement corrective actions.

- Maintain high standards of accuracy, quality control and operational efficiency.

4. Media Budget & Commercial Management

- Oversee media budgets, estimates, campaign spends and allocation in coordination with relevant teams.

- Ensure media plans and campaign execution remain aligned with approved budgets.

- Coordinate with finance and internal stakeholders on purchase orders, billing, invoicing and payment follow-ups.

- Monitor campaign costs and ensure commercial terms are clearly communicated and documented.

- Identify potential scope changes, additional requirements and commercial risks.

- Support account profitability through efficient resource and budget management.

- Maintain confidentiality regarding client commercials, agency costs and internal financial information.

5. Reporting & Performance Analysis

- Review campaign reports, media performance updates and delivery dashboards.

- Ensure campaign results are communicated clearly to clients with actionable insights.

- Coordinate with media and digital teams to track relevant metrics based on campaign objectives.

- Identify trends, performance gaps and opportunities to improve future media plans.

- Prepare and present campaign reviews, monthly reports and strategic recommendations.

- Ensure reports and presentations are accurate, well-structured and aligned with client expectations.

6. Cross-Functional Coordination

- Work closely with media planning, media buying, digital marketing, creative, production and account management teams.

- Translate client requirements into clear internal briefs with defined objectives, deliverables and timelines.

- Ensure all stakeholders are aligned on campaign priorities, responsibilities and deadlines.

- Facilitate smooth communication between clients and internal teams.

- Review key client-facing documents, presentations, media plans and campaign reports before submission.

- Resolve coordination challenges and maintain accountability across teams.

7. Team Leadership & Process Management

- Lead, guide and mentor the media servicing team.

- Allocate responsibilities and establish clear expectations around quality, timelines and client communication.

- Review team deliverables and ensure consistent servicing standards.

- Support team members in handling client discussions, presentations, escalations and campaign requirements.

- Improve internal workflows, reporting processes and account management practices.

- Encourage collaboration, accountability and continuous improvement across teams.

Required Skills & Qualifications

- 8–10 years of experience in media servicing, media account management or client servicing within an advertising, media or integrated marketing agency.

- Strong experience handling key client accounts and managing senior stakeholders.

- Good understanding of media planning, media buying and integrated campaign execution.

- Experience coordinating with digital, creative, media planning and buying teams.

- Strong understanding of media budgets, campaign deliverables, reporting and commercial management.

- Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and relationship management skills.

- Strong project management, analytical and problem-solving abilities.

- Ability to manage multiple accounts, priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced agency environment.

- Proficiency in Google Workspace, Microsoft Office and relevant project management or reporting tools.

- Strong attention to detail, ownership and decision-making abilities.

Preferred Experience

- Experience managing large or marquee client accounts.

- Exposure to both digital and traditional media campaigns.

- Experience in integrated marketing and cross-channel campaign planning.

- Familiarity with media performance metrics and campaign reporting tools.

- Experience leading a media servicing or account management team.

- Experience preparing pitches, proposals and strategic media presentations.

Key Competencies

- Client relationship management

- Media strategy and campaign execution

- Commercial and budget management

- Cross-functional team coordination

- Stakeholder management and negotiation

- Leadership and team development

- Analytical thinking and problem-solving

- Attention to detail and delivery excellence

Key Success Measures

Success in this role will be measured by client satisfaction and retention, quality and timeliness of campaign delivery, effective budget management, account growth, team performance and the overall quality of media servicing.

divya@numoohiringsolutions.com

title: Senior Onboarding Specialist
description:
**About the role**

You will own merchant onboarding at Loop from sales handoff to Success handover, across three regions. You will lead a team of Onboarding Specialists, set the operating standard for every onboarding, and be accountable for time to go live, onboarding quality, and early churn. This role is about building a predictable onboarding engine that scales with our growth. It is not about running onboardings yourself.

**What you will own**

Onboarding Delivery and Governance

* Own end to end onboarding performance: kickoff SLAs, milestone adherence, and go live dates across the full merchant portfolio.
* Set the standards for kickoff, weekly touchpoints, configuration, migration validation and handover, and audit adherence.
* Step in personally on strategic, high value or at risk merchants.

Cross Functional Partnership

* Act as the primary escalation point for Sales, Implementation Engineering, Migration, Product and Success.
* Improve the sales to onboarding handoff so merchants are scoped correctly before kickoff.
* Agree SLAs and escalation paths with Implementation Engineering and Migration, and hold all sides to them.
* Turn recurring merchant feedback into prioritised product inputs and track them to resolution.

Process, Tooling and Reporting

* Own onboarding playbooks, templates and documentation standards.
* Keep Salesforce, Sheets and internal dashboards accurate, and remove manual tracking wherever possible.
* Report weekly and monthly on onboarding health to leadership, with risks and corrective actions.
* Identify bottlenecks using data and redesign the process to remove them.

Merchant Experience and Retention

* Own the merchant experience during onboarding, including handling of delays, product gaps and escalations.
* Drive down churn during onboarding and in the first 30 days post handover.
* Ensure every handover to Success is complete, documented and accepted by the Success team.

Team Leadership and Capacity

* Lead, coach and grow a team of Onboarding Specialists across regions
* Plan capacity and allocate merchants by region, complexity and specialist bandwidth.
* Hire, onboard and ramp new specialists. Set clear performance goals and run regular 1:1s and reviews.

﻿

What we are looking for

* 7+ years in customer onboarding, implementation or customer success at a B2B SaaS company, with 3+ years managing teams of 10 or more.
* Experience leading distributed teams across multiple regions and time zones.
* Strong track record of running onboarding at scale with measurable improvement in time to value and early retention.
* Comfort with technical setups: integrations, data migration, configuration. You do not need to code, but you need to hold your own with engineers.
* Hands on with Salesforce and dashboarding; data driven in how you run the team.
* Calm, clear communicator in escalations with merchants and senior internal stakeholders.
