title: Lead Managed Services Consultant
description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.
  
  
By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real-time insights.
  
  
Today, 1,900+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Summary**
Lead managed services delivery for enterprise SaaS customers by owning platform strategy, governance, operational excellence, and continuous improvement initiatives. Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, driving adoption, business value realization, platform optimization, and long-term success. Experience with customer community platforms such as Sprinklr Community or similar solutions is highly desirable and will be considered an advantage.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead end-to-end managed services delivery, ensuring platform stability, governance, adoption, and alignment with customer business objectives.
* Drive strategic consulting engagements, helping customers optimise digital experiences, engagement models, operational processes, and platform utilisation.
* Act as the primary advisor to customer stakeholders, providing guidance on best practices, platform capabilities, governance frameworks, and roadmap planning.
* Lead requirements discovery, solution design, enhancement planning, and execution of continuous improvement programmes.
* Establish governance frameworks covering user administration, access management, workflows, content lifecycle management, and operational controls.
* Oversee platform health checks, audits, release management activities, and optimisation reviews.
* Lead investigation and resolution of complex platform, workflow, configuration, and user experience challenges.
* Own reporting, analytics, adoption measurement, and recommendations to improve customer outcomes.
* Provide leadership and mentorship to consultants and delivery teams supporting managed services engagements.
* Partner with Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and customer leadership teams to deliver successful business outcomes.
* Provide architectural guidance on integrations, APIs, authentication, SSO, enterprise connectivity, and ecosystem solutions.
* Establish reusable delivery standards, governance playbooks, operational frameworks, and best practice models.
* Contribute to customer digital transformation initiatives, ensuring scalable and sustainable platform adoption.

**What Makes You Qualified?**
**Must Have Qualifications**

* 8-12 years of experience in Managed Services, SaaS Consulting, Digital Experience Platforms, Customer Engagement Solutions, or Enterprise Software implementations.
* Proven experience managing enterprise SaaS platforms and customer-facing managed services engagements.
* Strong consulting experience involving solution design, customer advisory services, governance reviews, and stakeholder management.
* Expertise in platform governance, operational excellence, adoption strategies, user management, workflows, and business process optimisation.
* Strong understanding of user experience principles, digital engagement strategies, information architecture, and customer journey optimisation.
* Working knowledge of web technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, responsive design principles, and modern digital experiences.
* Solid understanding of REST APIs, integrations, authentication models, SSO, webhooks, and enterprise system connectivity.
* Experience facilitating workshops, executive reviews, solution discussions, and strategic planning sessions.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and customer management skills.
* Experience leading distributed delivery teams and managing multiple customer engagements simultaneously.

**Good To Have Skills**

* Experience with customer support communities, brand advocacy programs, knowledge communities, or peer-to-peer support ecosystems.
* Exposure to SEO, search optimization, content strategy, and digital engagement best practices.
* Understanding of CRM platforms, customer support ecosystems, and customer experience technologies.
* Experience managing globally distributed communities and enterprise-scale engagement programs.
* Program management and service delivery leadership experience within managed services organizations.

**Who You Are**

* A strategic consultant with strong expertise in enterprise SaaS platforms, managed services, and customer success.
* Skilled at balancing business objectives, operational requirements, and technical considerations.
* Comfortable engaging with executive stakeholders while collaborating effectively with technical teams.
* A proactive leader who drives continuous improvement, innovation, and customer value realisation.
* Experience with customer communities and digital engagement platforms is considered a strong advantage.

**What Success Looks Like**

* High customer satisfaction, adoption, and business value realisation.
* Well-governed, scalable, and optimised platform operations.
* Successful execution of transformation, optimisation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Improved user adoption, engagement, and operational efficiency metrics.
* Trusted advisor status with customer leadership and key stakeholders.
* Consistent delivery of managed services KPIs, governance objectives, and customer success outcome

**We focus on our mission**
: Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:
  
  

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified-CXM.
* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.

**We believe in our product**
: Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.
  
  
**We invest in our people**
: We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.
  
  
To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.
  
  
To learn more about all-things-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.
  
  
**EEO - Our philosophy**
: Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.
  
  
Sprinklr is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.
  
  
Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.
  
  
**Warning about Recruiting Scams:**
Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commission's advice to avoid these types of scams.
  
  
If you are contacted by someone whom you suspect may not be appropriately representing Sprinklr, please do not engage and block their email or phone number immediately.

title: AVP - Journey Excellence and Transformation
description:
Embark on a transformative journey as
**“AVP - Journey Excellence and Transformation”**
at Barclays, where you’ll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You’ll harness cutting-edge technology to revolutionize our digital offerings, ensuring unparalleled customer experiences.
  
  
You will join the Business Banking transformation team, which shapes future-state operating models and redesigns end-to-end customer and colleague journeys. Working across Operations, Product, Technology, Risk, Compliance and Customer Experience, the team turns strategic designs into practical transformation roadmaps that simplify processes, strengthen controls and enable sustainable digital change.
  
  
**Skills**
To be successful in this role as a “AVP - Journey Excellence and Transformation”, you should possess the following skillsets:
  
  
**Target Operating Model Design**

* Lead the development and evolution of Target Operating Models across Business Banking customer and operational journeys.
* Conduct current-state assessments to understand existing processes, customer and colleague pain points, operating structures, technology dependencies, controls and performance.
* Define future-state operating-model components across people, process, technology, data, controls, governance and performance management.
* Develop clear design principles to guide future-state structures, service models and ways of working.
* Define roles, responsibilities, capabilities, interaction models, governance arrangements and decision rights required to support the target state.
* Ensure proposed operating models are practical, scalable and aligned with Business Banking priorities, customer needs and applicable regulatory expectations.
* Maintain traceability between identified business problems, design decisions, proposed changes and intended outcomes.

**Customer and Colleague Journey Transformation**

* Lead the assessment and redesign of end-to-end customer and colleague journeys across areas such as onboarding, servicing, lending, Customer Due Diligence and case management.
* Apply customer-centred design principles to simplify journeys, reduce avoidable friction and improve customer and colleague outcomes.
* Facilitate journey-mapping and design workshops with operational teams, subject-matter experts and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Identify process gaps, failure points, unnecessary hand-offs, duplication, delays and control weaknesses.
* Translate complex operational challenges into simplified, scalable and digitally enabled future-state journeys.
* Ensure journey designs appropriately consider different customer needs, servicing requirements and risk profiles.
* Establish appropriate measures to assess the impact of journey changes on customer experience, service quality, turnaround time and operational performance.

**Process Optimisation and Continuous Improvement**

* Apply appropriate process-improvement methodologies to assess and redesign end-to-end processes.
* Develop current-state and future-state process maps, service blueprints and supporting design documentation.
* Identify opportunities to remove process debt, reduce manual activity, simplify hand-offs and improve first-time-right outcomes.
* Use operational data, customer insight and colleague feedback to identify root causes and prioritise improvement opportunities.
* Assess opportunities to improve productivity, create capacity and strengthen process resilience.
* Embed continuous-improvement principles within future-state processes and operating models.
* Support the identification, validation, measurement and tracking of transformation benefits.

**Digital, Automation and AI Enablement**

* Identify and assess opportunities to use digital workflow, automation, process mining, analytics, artificial intelligence and generative AI within Business Banking journeys.
* Work with Product and Technology partners to translate business requirements into appropriate digital and technology capabilities.
* Support the assessment of technology feasibility, business value, operational impact and control implications.
* Ensure that proposed technology solutions are integrated into the wider operating model rather than implemented as isolated process changes.
* Contribute to the design and implementation of workflow, case-management and AI-enabled servicing solutions.
* Promote responsible adoption of technology, with appropriate consideration of governance, data, customer outcomes, operational resilience and controls.

**Transformation Planning and Delivery**

* Translate agreed target-state designs into structured and executable delivery roadmaps.
* Define delivery phases, dependencies, business readiness requirements, risks, assumptions and intended outcomes.
* Support the development of business cases, investment proposals and governance submissions.
* Partner with change and delivery teams to transition designs from concept through mobilisation, implementation and embedding.
* Provide design oversight during delivery to ensure that implemented changes remain aligned with agreed target-state principles.
* Identify and manage design risks, dependencies and issues, escalating where appropriate.
* Support pilot, test-and-learn and phased implementation approaches where these are appropriate.
* Monitor delivery progress, benefit realisation and adoption against agreed measures.
* Produce clear updates, recommendations and decision papers for senior stakeholders and governance forums.

**Risk and Control**

* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work performed.
* Ensure target operating models and journey designs appropriately consider regulatory requirements, operational risk, customer outcomes, data, privacy and control effectiveness.
* Identify potential risks and control impacts arising from process, technology, organisational or operating-model changes.
* Engage Risk, Compliance, Legal and Control stakeholders at the appropriate stages of design and delivery.
* Ensure key controls, accountabilities, governance arrangements and escalation routes are clearly reflected in the future-state design.
* Support completion of relevant risk assessments, governance reviews and approvals.
* Escalate material design, delivery or control concerns through the appropriate governance channels.
* Ensure all activities and duties are carried out in full compliance with regulatory requirements, the Enterprise Risk Management Framework and applicable internal Barclays policies and standards.

**Some Other Highly Valued Skills Include**

* Experience identifying and evaluating opportunities across digital workflow, automation, process mining, analytics, artificial intelligence and generative AI, including consideration of business value, operational impact, governance and controls.
* Experience developing business cases, benefits assessments, executive papers and senior-management updates, and providing design oversight through mobilisation, implementation and embedding.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
This role is based in our Gurugram/Noida.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To collaborate with stakeholders and use data and MI to identify process optimisation opportunities for capacity creation in relevant business areas.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Development and implementation of strategies to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of banking operations, using data led insights.
* Participation in projects and initiatives to improve performance & optimisation efficiency and effectiveness.
* Development of reports and presentations on performance & optimisation and communicate findings to internal senior stakeholders.
* Identification of industry trends and developments, and collaboration with stakeholders across the bank to provide recommendations for change and improvement within performance and optimisation processes.
* Development and implementation of analytics and reporting performance & optimisation to mitigate risks and maintain efficient operations.
* Identification of capacity creation in operations using data and Management Information.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Manager - Client Operations & Support
description:

Zinnia is the leading technology platform for accelerating life and annuities growth. With innovative enterprise solutions and data insights, Zinnia simplifies the experience of buying, selling, and administering insurance products. All of which enables more people to protect their financial futures. Our success is driven by a commitment to three core values: be bold, team up, deliver value – and that we do. Zinnia has over $180 billion in assets under administration, serves 100+ carrier clients, 2500 distributors and partners, and over 2 million policyholders.
  
  
**Who You Are**
The
**Client Operations & Support Manager**
serves as the operational liaison between Zinnia’s clients and internal functional teams. This role is responsible for managing client inquiries, operational escalations, and service requests, ensuring timely resolution and a high-quality client experience.
  
  
The role works cross-functionally with Operations, Technology, Finance, Licensing, and Shared Services teams to coordinate issue resolution, provide operational insights, and support client service delivery. * Manage escalations from intake through resolution, ensuring timely follow-up and closure.
* Monitor shared client mailboxes and ensure inquiries are routed and resolved appropriately.
* Handle cases requiring special handling and ensure compliance with operational guidelines.

Cross-Functional Coordination
  
  

* Collaborate with internal teams including Operations, Technology, Finance, Licensing, and Shared Services to resolve client requests.
* Engage subject matter experts and functional leads to address complex inquiries.
* Ensure workflow items submitted through operational channels are resolved accurately and efficiently.

Operational Governance & Reporting
  
  

* Provide clients with operational metrics including volume trends, processing status, and performance insights.
* Support scorecard inquiries and operational reporting requests.
* Assist in resolving administrative invoice queries and access-related issues.

Client Communication & Relationship Support
  
  

* Facilitate clear and professional communication with clients regarding request status and resolutions.
* Support recurring operational meetings by preparing data, insights, and action updates.
* Assist in preparation of operational presentations and business review materials.
* Actively participate in client monthly/quarterly reviews, representing ZInnia’s performance, operational metrics and service delivery outcomes
* Ensure commitments and service priorities are tracked and fulfilled.

Process Improvement & Service Excellence
  
  

* Identify recurring issues and recommend process improvements.
* Support operational best practices to improve efficiency and client satisfaction.
* Maintain documentation of procedures, resolutions, and operational guidelines.

**What You’ll Need**

* Bachelor’s degree (minimum)
* 10+ years of total work experience out of which 6+ years in business operations, client support, financial services, or insurance operations.
* Proven ability to manage client requests and escalations in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong facilitation, problem-solving, and coordination skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities with accuracy and efficiency.
* Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in life insurance, annuity administration, or financial services operations.
* Exposure to client service delivery or global delivery models.
* Knowledge of process improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma).
* Experience with operational reporting and data analysis.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office tools.

Key Competencies
  
  

* Client focus and service excellence
* Operational accountability
* Cross-functional collaboration
* Analytical thinking and problem-solving
* Professional communication and executive presence
* Continuous improvement mindset

Work Model & Collaboration
  
  

* Will work closely with US-based client relationship leaders and operational teams.
* Requires complete overlapping work hours with US time zones as needed.
* Participation in client calls and leading regular operational reviews.

**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?**
We’re looking for the best and brightest innovators in the industry to join our team. At Zinnia, you collaborate with smart, creative professionals who are dedicated to delivering cutting-edge technologies, deeper data insights, and enhanced services to transform how insurance is done. Visit our website at www.zinnia.com for more information. Apply by completing the online application on the careers section of our website. We are an Equal Opportunity employer committed to a diverse workforce. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability.

**The Opportunity**
**Your Key Responsibilities**

The ideal candidate will possess 3 to 8 years of relevant experience for Senior level a strong understanding of the insurance industry, and exceptional consulting skills. **Key Responsibilities:**

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* 3 to 8 years of experience in business consulting, with a focus on the insurance sector, particularly group benefits and retirement.
* Strong domain knowledge of insurance process, products, regulations, and market dynamics.
* Proven consulting skills, including project management, analytical thinking, and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly and persuasively.
* Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Strong client management skills, with a focus on building lasting relationships and delivering exceptional service.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.

In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.

title: Corporate Relation Lead
description:
***Corporate Relations Lead – Industry Partnerships & Placements***

* Company: DIYguru Mobility Pvt. Ltd.
* Industry: Electric Vehicles (EV), Mobility & Skill Development
* Department: Corporate Relations & Placements
* Location: Delhi – Sultanpur / Noida
* Employment Type: Full-Time
* Experience: 2–5 Years
* Education: MBA/PGDM in HR, Marketing, Operations or Management preferred. Graduates with relevant experience in corporate relations, placements or business development may also apply.

**About DIYguru**

DIYguru is India’s leading platform for upskilling students and professionals in Electric Vehicles (EV) and future mobility. We are focused on bridging the industry skill gap through hands-on, industry-relevant learning experiences that prepare individuals for emerging career opportunities across EV, battery technology, automotive electronics, connected mobility and sustainable transportation.

Through our industry-focused programs, corporate partnerships, placement initiatives and practical learning ecosystem, DIYguru connects education, industry and employment to build a future-ready workforce for the rapidly evolving mobility sector.

**About the Role**

DIYguru is looking for a Corporate Relations Lead – Industry Partnerships & Placements who can build, manage and grow relationships with corporate recruiters, HR professionals, hiring managers and industry stakeholders.

This is a partnership-heavy and placement-focused role. The candidate will be responsible not only for generating corporate leads but for converting relationships into tangible business and placement outcomes, including:

* Hiring requirements
* Placement opportunities
* Internship opportunities
* OJT opportunities
* Recruitathon participation
* Corporate training opportunities
* Industry partnerships
* MoUs and strategic collaborations
* Repeat hiring relationships

The ideal candidate will combine corporate relationship management, recruitment coordination and strong follow-up skills.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Corporate Partnership Development

Build relationships with HR Heads, Talent Acquisition Managers, Recruitment Heads and Hiring Managers.

Identify companies with recurring manpower and talent requirements.

Develop corporate accounts rather than one-time hiring relationships.

Understand workforce requirements, skill gaps and hiring challenges.

Develop long-term hiring and industry partnerships.

Conduct meetings and present relevant DIYguru solutions.

Maintain regular engagement with existing corporate partners.

2. Corporate Outreach

Identify and prioritize target companies across EV, automotive, manufacturing, engineering, software, electronics, battery, mobility and related sectors.

Develop account-wise prospect lists and identify relevant decision-makers.

Conduct outreach through LinkedIn, email, calls, industry networks, referrals and events.

Schedule meetings with HR and business stakeholders.

Maintain a structured corporate sales/partnership pipeline.

Move prospects through defined stages from lead → meeting → requirement → partnership → hiring → repeat engagement.

Track conversion and follow-up activities consistently.

3. Placement & Recruitment Partnerships

Acquire new corporate hiring requirements and understand company manpower needs.

Study and interpret technical and non-technical Job Descriptions.

Coordinate with the placement team for candidate mapping and shortlisting.

Ensure candidate profiles are aligned with company requirements before sharing.

Coordinate assessments, interviews, hiring drives and recruitment activities.

Track candidate selection, offer and joining status.

Collect employer feedback after hiring processes.

Identify opportunities for repeat hiring and additional manpower requirements.

Maintain strong relationships with companies throughout the recruitment cycle.

4. Industry Networking & Representation

Attend industry events, HR conferences, EV and automotive events, seminars and networking forums.

Build professional relationships with industry leaders, HR professionals and business stakeholders.

Use LinkedIn strategically for corporate networking and relationship development.

Identify potential partnership opportunities through industry networks.

Represent DIYguru professionally in external meetings, events and discussions.

Maintain an active network of relevant industry contacts.

5. College & Institutional Partnerships

Develop relationships with TPOs, Placement Officers, HODs and institutional decision-makers.

Identify colleges, ITIs, diploma institutes and universities with relevant candidate pools.

Develop college-industry-placement opportunities.

Support campus hiring drives and Recruitathons.

Coordinate institutional outreach and partnership discussions.

Build and maintain a structured institutional database.

Identify opportunities for long-term college and industry collaborations.

6. Employer Branding & Corporate Communication

Work closely with the marketing/content team to support:

Corporate success stories

Hiring partner communications

Placement success stories

Industry collaboration announcements

LinkedIn outreach campaigns

Corporate newsletters

Employer partnership content

Ensure that all external communication reflects DIYguru's professional image and value proposition.

7. MIS, CRM & Pipeline Management

Maintain accurate and updated records for:

* Corporate database
* HR/POC database
* Target account list
* Active hiring requirements
* Corporate prospect pipeline
* Follow-up tracker
* Meeting tracker
* JD tracker
* Interview tracker
* Selection tracker
* Joining tracker
* Repeat hiring tracker
* Partnership/MoU tracker
* Prepare regular MIS reports covering new leads, meetings, requirements, conversions, active hiring, closures and repeat opportunities.

**Key Performance Expectations**

Success in this role will be measured through both relationship quality and measurable business outcomes, including:

* Number and quality of new corporate accounts developed.
* Corporate meetings and qualified opportunities generated.
* New hiring requirements acquired.
* Placement, internship and OJT opportunities created.
* Conversion of prospects into active corporate partners.
* Successful candidate selections and joining.
* Repeat hiring from existing corporate accounts.
* New industry partnerships, Recruitathon participation and collaboration opportunities.
* Accuracy and consistency of CRM/MIS reporting.

Required Skills

* Strong corporate communication and relationship-building skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication
* Strong negotiation and persuasion skills
* Recruitment and placement coordination skills
* Excellent follow-up and pipeline management
* Professional LinkedIn networking skills
* Ability to understand and interpret Job Descriptions
* Strong Excel/Google Sheets and MIS skills
* Ability to communicate with senior HR and business stakeholders
* Ownership and accountability
* Ability to work with targets and measurable outcomes

**Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate should have experience in one or more of the following areas:

* Corporate Relations
* Campus Recruitment
* Placement Cell
* HR Recruitment
* Talent Acquisition
* Industry Partnerships
* EdTech Partnerships
* Staffing/Recruitment
* College Relations

We are looking for someone who is proactive, commercially aware, confident in professional conversations and comfortable building relationships from the first interaction through long-term partnership

Why Join DIYguru?

* EV & Future Mobility Exposure: Work directly with companies and professionals across the rapidly growing EV and mobility ecosystem.
* Industry Partnerships: Gain hands-on experience building real corporate and institutional relationships.

title: GM/AVP Customer Service & Operations
description:
**Position:**
GM/AVP Customer Service & Operations

**Location:**
Delhi

**Department:**
Operations & Customer Experience

**Position Overview:**

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced leader to join our team as the Head of Customer Service at DocOnline. This senior role will be instrumental in shaping and enhancing the end-to-end customer experience across our Inbound & Outbound Call Centre and all consumer touchpoints, including physical branches. The ideal candidate will lead a high performing team, drive operational efficiency, and implement strategies to improve customer satisfaction, branch service standards, and service-led sales conversions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

1. Leadership & Team Management:

* Provide strategic leadership to the customer service and branch operations teams.
* Build and manage a culture of performance, accountability, and continuous learning.
* Hire, train, and develop team members to drive excellence in customer interactions.
* Set and monitor KPIs for call centre, regional branches, and backend service operations.

2. Customer Experience Management:

* Own the customer journey across all service channels: inbound calls, walk-ins, digital, and backend support.
* Develop strategies to improve CSAT, NPS, First Contact Resolution (FCR), and Average Handling Time (AHT).
* Identify service gaps and implement improvements to ensure seamless and consistent customer experiences.

3. Operations & Process Optimization:

* Lead initiatives to optimize internal processes and eliminate inefficiencies across the service ecosystem.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders to streamline call flow, escalation handling, and ticketing systems.
* Utilize data insights to enhance workflows and track key performance indicators across call centre and branches.

4. Technology & CRM Integration:

* Work closely with IT to identify and implement CRM tools, IVRs, and AI-based service solutions.
* Ensure smooth integration of customer service platforms with core operations.
* Drive automation and self-service initiatives to reduce dependency on manual intervention.

5. Branch & Territory Service Oversight:

* Lead multi-location branch service teams, aligning them with the overall customer service vision.
* Standardize service protocols and performance measures across branches.
* Support sales enablement through service by training staff on service-to-sales interactions and upselling opportunities.

6. Quality Control & Feedback Systems:

* Define and enforce quality assurance standards across customer service teams.
* Roll out audits, call monitoring, and service feedback mechanisms to continuously raise service benchmarks.
* Conduct regular coaching sessions and refreshers to improve service delivery.

**Qualifications:**

* 10–15 years of progressive experience in customer service leadership, preferably in digital healthcare, BFSI, telecom, or services sectors.
* Proven expertise in managing large-scale call centre operations and branch networks.
* Hands-on experience with CRM platforms, call analytics, and ticketing systems.
* Strategic mindset with a strong focus on metrics, customer outcomes, and cross functional collaboration.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills with an ability to work across levels and geographies.
* Experience in driving service-led sales, especially in B2C environments, is highly desirable.

**Key Metrics to Drive:**

* Net Promoter Score (NPS) – Gauge customer loyalty and overall experience.
* Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) – Measure customer feedback post-interaction.
* Customer Effort Score (CES) – Assess ease of service interaction.
* First Contact Resolution (FCR) – Track issues resolved in the first interaction.
* Average Handling Time (AHT) – Optimize call time without compromising quality.
* Call Abandonment & Escalation Rate – Monitor dropped calls and unresolved escalations.
* Service Level Adherence (SLA Compliance) – Ensure timely response and resolution across touchpoints.
* Ticket Closure Turnaround Time (TAT) – Measure operational agility in resolving issues.
* Agent Utilization & Occupancy Rate – Improve efficiency and productivity of call centre staff.
* CRM Adoption Rate (Branch + Contact Centre) – Ensure all leads, queries, and follow-ups are logged and tracked effectively.
* CRM Hygiene & Data Accuracy Score – Track proper tagging, closure, and documentation of all customer records.
* Branch-wise Service & Sales Performance – Analyze branch productivity, service quality, and contribution to revenue.
* Walk-in to Resolution Time (Branch TAT) – Optimize branch turnaround and service delivery time.
* Cross-sell/Upsell % via Service Channels – Convert inbound service queries into revenue opportunities.
* Inbound vs. Outbound Call Volume Ratio – Maintain optimal call mix for efficiency and engagement.
* Repeat Interaction Ratio – Track recurrence of unresolved or follow-up queries.
* Customer Query to Fulfilment Conversion % – Ensure closure from initiation to outcome.
* Internal Transfer & Manual Escalation Ratio – Reduce non-value-adding transfers and touchpoints.
* Automation vs Manual Process Efficiency – Drive digital adoption and eliminate redundancy.
* Cost per Resolution / Contact – Optimize cost-effectiveness without compromising service quality.
* Referral Generation via Service – Leverage customer delight for brand advocacy.
* Churn Reduction Post-Service % – Retain customers through prompt, empathetic resolutions.
* Sales Through Service Closure % – Measure service-driven revenue contribution.
* Process SLA Breach Rate – Identify failure points and drive compliance.
* Customer Experience Index (composite metric) – Overall measurement of service perception and delivery.

DocOnline is committed to transforming digital healthcare access for millions. If you are passionate about building customer-first cultures, improving service efficiency, and scaling branch-based service excellence, we welcome you to apply.

title: Lead - Insurance - Distribution and Partnerships
description:
**Lead - Distribution and Partnerships Risk and Continuity Practice**

**Reports to:**
Head, Risk Advisory & Continuity Practice

**Role Overview:**
This role owns origination through two partner channels that feed the Risk Advisory & Continuity Practice without depending on Client Associates' own relationship managers.The first is the professional-referral channel: law firms and consulting houses whose own client work puts them inside the moments that create capital gaps for UHNW families and promoters - a business sale, a buy-sell trigger, a generational handover, an estate or succession settlement. The job is to build standing, credible relationships with the partners at these firms, so that when such a moment surfaces in their client work, the practice is the first call. This is a relationship-capital role. Mandates are signed, not tickets closed.The second is the volume channel: DSA and MFD partners onboarded as referral partners and POSPs under Client Associates' Corporate Agent registration. The job here is to onboard partners, activate them, service them at volume, and manage churn so the channel stays productive.The two channels run on different rhythms. The professional channel is low-volume and high-trust, and revenue lags by design. The volume channel is activation-led and is measured on partners signed, POSPs activated and leads routed. Holding both credibly is the hard part of this role, and the profile below is written with that in mind.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Professional-referral channel: 
  Identify, approach and build relationships with senior partners at estate and succession law firms, M&A and corporate law firms, tax and succession advisory boutiques, and independent family-office and wealth consultants.
* Structure and formalise professional-referral mandates with each partner firm - cumulative, relationship-based, with no churn.
* Introduce the practice's Two-Gap diagnostic (Event Gap and Transmission Gap) into partner firms' own client conversations, without pitching product directly.
* Route live opportunities and gap conversations to the practice for diagnosis and structuring.
* Represent the practice externally in professional-services circles - conferences, firm briefings and partner events.
* Volume channel: 
  Identify, onboard and sign DSA and MFD partners on lead-supply and referral terms.
* Register and activate POSPs under the Corporate Agent registration, with documentation and compliance in order.
* Service high-volume referral partners - training, lead handling and response times - so that partners stay productive.
* Manage churn: track partner activity monthly and re-engage or exit inactive POSPs.
* Route qualified leads from volume partners to the relationship teams and the practice.
* Work with finance to keep partner payouts accurate and on time.
* Across both channels, o
  wn the commercial terms of each partnership within a mandate set by the Head of the practice.
* Maintain relationship governance - a tracked record of partners signed, firms engaged, active mandates and the conversion of referrals into mandates.
* Track the partnership pipeline with stage and value in the CRM and report to the Head monthly.
* What This Role Is Not: 
  Not a case-structuring or product-pitching role - diagnosis, quoting and solution design stay with the practice.
* Not a direct-selling role. Volume partners and POSPs sell; this role builds, activates and services the channel.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

Someone with existing standing in the professional-services and UHNW ecosystem, who has also run a partner network with discipline. Likely backgrounds: Business development or intermediary relationships at a private bank or wealth manager.

* Business development or client-relations leadership at a family-office consulting practice, or a boutique M&A or tax advisory firm.
* A law or consulting firm's own business-development lead, with an understanding of how partners think about referring clients externally.
* Head of channel partnerships or alliances at an insurer, broker or insurtech platform, with experience activating and servicing DSA, MFD or POSP networks.

Comfortable operating without a product to pitch in the professional channel, and comfortable with the operating detail of activation, servicing and churn in the volume channel.

**Qualifications and Experience:**
10 to 15 years in business development, channel partnerships or client-relationship roles within financial services, wealth management or professional services.

* Demonstrated ability to build and sustain senior relationships at partner or principal level over a multi-year, low-volume cycle.
* Hands-on experience onboarding, activating and servicing a partner or POSP network, including its documentation and compliance.
* Working familiarity with the Corporate Agent framework and with the limits of referral-for-a-fee arrangements.
* Working familiarity with UHNW and promoter wealth structures - succession, estate planning, buy-sell arrangements - sufficient to hold a credible conversation. Technical structuring is not this role's responsibility.
* An existing network in legal, consulting or family-office circles is a strong advantage.

**Reporting Line and Success Metrics:**

 
Reports directly to the Head of the Risk and Continuity Practice, as part of the practice's founding team alongside the General Insurance Lead and the Analyst.

**Professional-referral channel.**
Year one is not measured on revenue, because revenue lags relationship-building by design. Early metrics are: Number of professional-mandate relationships established.

* Number of firms actively engaged in ongoing conversation.
* Number of gap conversations routed to the practice through these relationships.

**Volume channel.**
Early metrics are: Number of DSA and MFD partners signed.

* Number of POSPs registered, and the share that become active.
* Number of qualified leads routed to the practice or the relationship teams.
* Churn held within the plan level.

Tomorrow, it needs to work because we've built systems that make great execution repeatable.

**Metrics & Continuous Improvement**

**What We're Looking For**

* Ensure Adherence to the regulatory guidelines and internal AML & Sanction Policy of HSBC, which includes pouch and mail, monetary instruments, cash services and payment transparency Line of Business Procedures

* Excellent sales and people management skills
* Client driven with a strong focus on quality of service
* Strong interpersonal communication skills
* A strong sense of ownership, responsibility and accountability
* An excellent understanding of financial planning, wealth management and understanding client need

The jobholder forms an integral part of the wider HSBC management team. **Role Context**
The jobholder will own and manage a portfolio of clients with Total Relationship balance of 25 lacs or more

* Maximising growth in their portfolio and achieving the RBWM plan/metrics
* Leading Premier activities to ensure opportunities are identified and client needs are met effectively, maximising all available resources.

* Evidence of strong sales results in insurance and investment products
* Relationship management experience with high net worth clients
* Strong technical skills in wealth management
* Strong communication, client focus and influencing skills
* Strong sales orientation, networking and portfolio management skills
* Sound knowledge of financial services products and services and the client relationship management system

title: Manager - Digital transformation (MarTech)
description:
**About OneMetric**
OneMetric (formerly Growtomation) is a revenue enablement partner for B2B teams. We build revenue engines end to end: the systems and data teams run on, the GTM execution that drives demand, closed deals and retention, and the AI that makes the entire engine faster and smarter.
  
  
As an Elite HubSpot Partner, we work with high-growth companies across the US and globally. We start with the real revenue problem, not the tool. While most companies buy technology, GTM execution and AI solutions from separate vendors, we bring them together into one connected revenue engine.
  
  
**Who We're Hiring For**
We're looking for a Manager - Digital transformation (MarTech) who combines marketing operations expertise, technical depth and a strong understanding of how B2B companies run programs such as Account-Based Marketing (ABM) and demand generation.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of business consulting, marketing technology and revenue operations. You'll work directly with CMOs, CROs, CEOs and other senior stakeholders to understand the business challenges driving their need for technology, translate those challenges into executable game plans, and partner with our technology and delivery teams to bring those solutions to life.
  
  
This isn't a pure consulting or project management role. You'll need to understand how businesses operate, how their marketing and sales programs work, and how the right technology architecture and execution can drive measurable outcomes.
  
  
If you enjoy solving complex business problems, designing connected technology solutions and working closely with senior stakeholders, this role is for you.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Business Discovery & Consulting: Lead discovery conversations with CMOs, CROs, CEOs and other stakeholders to understand business goals, GTM motions, operational challenges and the underlying problems driving technology requirements.
* Solution Strategy & Planning: Translate business challenges into clearly defined problem statements, solution approaches and executable game plans, working with Solution Architects and the technology execution team to define scope, priorities and implementation plans.
* MarTech & RevOps Solutions: Design and implement technology setups across Marketing, Sales and Customer Experience (CX), ensuring systems, workflows and data connect to support business objectives.
* ABM & Demand Generation Enablement: Understand how B2B companies plan and execute ABM and demand generation programs, and translate these requirements into scalable technology solutions, workflows and measurement frameworks.
* Technology Stack & Integration: Work hands-on with marketing and revenue technology platforms, including HubSpot, Salesforce, and ABM and intent platforms such as Clay, Demandbase, 6sense, Influ2 and Contact Level, to enable integrated GTM execution.
* Cross-functional Execution: Partner with Solution Architects, Delivery, Customer Success and other internal teams to translate the agreed game plan into technical requirements, implementation roadmaps and measurable outcomes.
* Client & Stakeholder Management: Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, facilitate working sessions, communicate recommendations and manage expectations throughout solution design and delivery.
* Engagement Governance: Maintain visibility into project scope, timelines, dependencies and risks. Identify gaps early, resolve execution blockers and ensure the delivered solution addresses the original business problem.
* Continuous Improvement: Develop discovery frameworks, solution playbooks and repeatable approaches that improve consulting quality, implementation efficiency and client outcomes.

****What success looks like****

* Senior stakeholders trust you to understand their business challenges and recommend solutions beyond simply implementing a tool.
* Business problems are translated into clear, technically feasible execution plans.
* Marketing, Sales and CX technology setups work together to support ABM, demand generation and broader revenue objectives.
* Solution Architects and delivery teams have the business context and requirements needed to execute effectively.
* Client engagements remain aligned with business outcomes, with measurable improvements in operational efficiency, GTM execution and revenue performance.

****What we're looking for****

* Experience: 5–8 years in MarTech, Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations, solutions consulting or technology implementation, ideally within a B2B SaaS, MarTech or consulting environment.
* Business Consulting: Experience conducting discovery with senior stakeholders, identifying root causes and translating business challenges into actionable solution plans.
* MarTech & RevOps Expertise: Strong understanding of how B2B Marketing, Sales and Customer Experience teams operate, including their processes, data flows and technology requirements.
* ABM & Demand Generation: Practical understanding of B2B demand generation and ABM programs, including how technology enables targeting, campaign orchestration, engagement and performance measurement.
* Technology Implementation: Demonstrated experience implementing or architecting technology setups for Marketing, Sales and/or CX teams, including workflows, integrations, data structures and process automation.
* Platform Knowledge: Strong hands-on knowledge of HubSpot and familiarity with tools such as Salesforce, Clay, Demandbase, 6sense, Influ2 and Contact Level. Experience with multiple platforms across the MarTech and ABM ecosystem is a plus.
* Stakeholder Management: Confidence working with CMOs, CROs, CEOs and cross-functional teams, translating between business priorities and technical execution.
* Execution & Ownership: Ability to turn strategy into a practical implementation plan, manage competing priorities and stay accountable for outcomes.
* How you think: Curious about how businesses work, technically sound, commercially aware and comfortable navigating ambiguity without relying on a fixed playbook.

****Why join us****

* Solve real business problems: Work directly with senior leaders to address business challenges through technology and execution.
* Bridge strategy and implementation: Own the journey from discovery and solution planning to implementation alongside experienced technical teams.
* Work across the revenue ecosystem: Gain exposure to leading MarTech, CRM, ABM and AI platforms and complex B2B GTM environments.
* Join a top-tier ecosystem: As a HubSpot Elite Partner, we work with ambitious businesses and a strong technology ecosystem.
* Grow with the business: Be part of a growing team where ownership, problem-solving and impact create opportunities to take on more responsibility.
* Outcomes over hours: We care about the quality of your thinking, what you build and the outcomes you drive.

title: Growth Business Manager- D2C
description:
**About Nory For You:**

Nory For You is a direct-to-consumer brand that sells through its own website, Nory.com. As the business grows, we are looking for a commercially minded professional to own the website as a business and drive profitable, sustainable growth across acquisition, conversion and retention.

**About the Role:**

The D2C Growth Business Manager will own and scale revenue from Nory.com. This is not a pure performance-marketing or website-operations role. You will own the complete website growth funnel, from traffic quality and conversion to average order value, CRM revenue, repeat purchase and overall profitability, working closely with the Performance Marketing Manager and the Creative Strategist.

**Core mandate:**
own Nory.com as a business and continuously identify what is limiting faster, profitable revenue growth.

**What You Will Own**

**Revenue and Profitability**

* Website revenue, growth targets and overall D2C business performance, with monthly and quarterly revenue plans and early flags on gaps.
* Contribution margin and profitable revenue, including the impact of discounts and offers.

**Funnel and Conversion**

* The full funnel: Traffic → PDP → Add to Cart → Checkout → Purchase → Repeat Purchase.
* Conversion-rate optimisation across landing pages, PDPs, cart and checkout, with a structured, prioritised testing roadmap.

**Acquisition Economics**

* Traffic quality analysis by channel, campaign, product and customer segment.
* Guidance to the Performance Marketing Manager on where to scale, reduce or redirect spend, based on CAC, conversion and profitability.

**Average Order Value**

* Bundles, cross-sell, upsell, multi-packs and offer architecture that lift AOV without eroding margin.

**Retention and Lifecycle**

* Email and WhatsApp journeys: abandoned-cart recovery, reactivation, cross-sell and repeat purchase.
* Customer cohorts, repeat rate, LTV and CAC tracking.

**Insight, Collaboration and Reporting**

* Joint work with the Creative Strategist to identify the messages, customer problems and creative concepts that drive high-quality traffic and conversion.
* Weekly reporting on what changed, why it changed and what action should follow, backed by a prioritised experimentation roadmap.

**How Success Will Be Measured**

* Website revenue growth
* Contribution margin / profitable revenue
* Blended CAC
* Website, PDP-to-cart and checkout conversion
* Average Order Value
* CRM revenue and abandoned-cart recovery
* Repeat purchase rate and customer LTV

**What You Bring**

**Must Have**

* 4–8 years in D2C, e-commerce, digital commerce or growth, with experience owning website revenue or an e-commerce funnel.
* Strong analytical and commercial mindset; able to separate vanity metrics from real business performance.
* Sound understanding of paid acquisition economics, even if you do not run campaigns yourself.
* Hands-on experience with CRO, funnel analysis, cohort analysis and experimentation.
* Good grounding in CRM, lifecycle marketing and retention.
* Working command of Shopify, GA4, Meta and Google advertising data, and e-commerce analytics.
* A structured, action-oriented approach: analyse, diagnose, prioritise, execute and measure.

**Good to Have**

* Experience in consumer health, wellness, beauty or other education-led D2C businesses.
* Familiarity with CRM and engagement tools (for example Klaviyo or WebEngage) and A/B testing tools.

**Why This Role**

* End-to-end ownership of a D2C website as a business, not a single channel.
* A clear, measurable mandate with direct impact on revenue and profitability.
* Close collaboration with performance marketing and creative strategy on a shared growth agenda.

title: Sr. Partner Business Manager
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.
  
  
We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.
  
  
**Role**
We are looking for a Sr Partner Business Manager to join our team. This is a Hybrid - Gurgaon role, reporting to the Sr Director, Channels & Alliances in the WW Alliances & Channels department. Success in this role is achieved by establishing strong working relationships and driving collaborative alignment across Zscaler sales teams, alliance and channel partners, professional services, marketing, and support. In this role, your mission is to accelerate partner-driven revenue growth by enabling partners to master the Zscaler value proposition and position our cloud platform to solve the complex business challenges of their prospective clients.
  
  
**What You’ll Do (Role Expectations)**

* Generate pipeline revenue by driving joint go-to-market (GTM) activities with channel partner leadership, partner sales executives, and internal sales teams
* Partner closely with national partners and Regional Account Managers to identify high-value mutual prospects and secure new business meetings (NBMs)
* Build product and sales competency across growth national partners, aligning their GTM and sales strategies with the Zscaler CLOSE framework to drive partner-sourced pipeline
* Establish and implement criteria, processes, and governance controls for partner selection, management, and performance, ensuring adherence to contractual obligations and ethical standards

**Who You Are (Success Profile)**

* You act like an owner, bringing deep passion, accountability, and a bias for action while seamlessly navigating between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
* You are a high-trust collaborator who champions teamwork over ego, fostering transparent communication and constructive feedback to build lasting trust.
* You operate with urgency and precision, thriving in high-growth environments where you deliver high-impact results rapidly for partners and internal stakeholders.
* You are a pragmatic builder with an obsession for creating and operationalizing scalable programs, rolling up your sleeves to deliver immediate, measurable value.
* You lead with integrity, holding yourself and others to high ethical standards while earning credibility through consistent and transparent follow-through.

**What We’re Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)**

* Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
* Demonstrable sales and customer outcome success partnering with Global System Integrators (GSIs) and consulting firms in India
* Proven track record selling cloud platforms, with the ability to articulate technical architectures as business outcomes and digital transformation drivers
* Experience developing channel ecosystems for network security and cloud technologies, including security proxies, caches, SSL/IPSec VPNs, and firewalls
* Established enterprise channel sales experience with proven working relationships across leading regional GSI partners

**What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)**

* Experience leveraging AI-powered sales intelligence platforms or positioning AI-driven security architectures to accelerate complex enterprise sales cycles
* Strong communication and presentation skills with a proven ability to teach, inspire, and influence senior cross-functional leaders and external partners
* Demonstrated self-motivation and discipline to manage and execute rigorous internal and external operating cadences

At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure.
  
  
**Benefits**
Our Benefits program is one of the most important ways we support our employees. Zscaler proudly offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families throughout their life stages, including:
  
  

* Various health plans
* Time off plans for vacation and sick time
* Parental leave options
* Retirement options
* Education reimbursement
* In-office perks, and more!

Learn more about Zscaler's hybrid working model and benefits here.

**About Standard Chartered**
We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. title: Senior Technical Account Manager
description:
**About The Job**
The Senior Technical Account Manager (STAM) provides leadership and strategic direction for key accounts and is responsible for working independently to lead complex projects, and provide expert technical guidance to customers, and leading the resolution of varied and non-routine complex technical issues. This role exercises independent judgment and creative solutioning to ensure customer success. The STAM may coordinate the activities of other team members (team lead) to ensure successful completion of projects and assignments. This role is responsible for mentoring and providing guidance and advice to new team members. The STAM proactively develops and maintains strategic relationships with key customer stakeholders, serving as a trusted advisor and technical leader. This position contributes to overall business growth by driving customer satisfaction and retention.
  
  

* Lead complex technical troubleshooting and problem resolution efforts for critical customer issues.
* Develop and deliver technical tutorials and workshops to customers and internal teams.
* Proactively identify and address technical risks and opportunities within customer environments.
* Collaborate with sales and product management teams to develop and support the implementation of customer solutions.
* Serve as a technical mentor and coach for junior team members.
* Contribute to the development of new support tools and processes.
* Lead internal initiatives to improve team performance and customer satisfaction.
* Identify and drive initiatives to improve service delivery processes.
* May be required to work on customer site and connect to customer systems.

**What You'll Do**

* Perform technical reviews & share knowledge to proactively identify & prevent issues
* Understand your customers' technical infrastructures, hardware, processes, and offerings
* Perform initial or secondary investigations and respond to online and phone support requests
* Deliver key portfolio updates and assist customers with upgrades
* Manage customer cases and maintain clear and concise case documentation
* Create customer engagement plans & keep documentation on customer environments updated
* Ensure a high level of customer satisfaction with each qualified engagement through the complete adoption life cycle of our offerings
* Engage with Red Hat's field teams, customers to ensure a positive platform & cloud technology experience and a successful outcome resulting in long-term enterprise success
* Communicate how specific Red Hat platform & cloud solutions and our cloud road-map align to customer use cases
* Capture Red Hat product capabilities and identify gaps as related to customer use cases through a closed-loop process for each step of the engagement life cycle
* Engage with Red Hat's product engineering teams to help develop solution patterns based on customer engagements and personal experience that guide platform adoption
* Establish and maintain parity with Red Hat’s platform & cloud technologies strategy
* Contribute internally to the Red Hat team, share knowledge and best practices with team members, contribute to internal projects and initiatives, and serve as a subject matter expert (SME) and mentor for specific technical or process areas or process areas
* Travel to visit customers, partners, conferences, and other events as needed

**What You'll Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in science or a technical field; engineering or computer science
* Competent reading and writing skills in English
* Ability to convey information to customers in a clear and concise manner
* Ability to effectively manage and grow existing enterprise customer and partner relationships by delivering best-in-class support
* Advanced troubleshooting and debugging skills, with a passion for problem solving and investigation
* Upstream involvement in open source projects (patches submitted for upstream) is a plus
* Indian citizenship or authorisation to work in India
* Red Hat OpenStack Platform - RHOSP

+ Fundamental understanding of OpenStack, Container architecture, and administration experience across all working components
+ Deep understanding and troubleshooting skills on OpenStack core components.
+ Deployment and troubleshooting experience of OpenStack clusters on bare metal or non-bare metal environments.
+ Planning, Designing, and implementation of OpenStack products on various hardware.
+ Technical and Deep understanding of Ceph cluster storage and its functionalities.
+ Experience with Linux operating system installation, configuration, upgrade, and maintenance.

* Red Hat OpenShift Platform - RHOCP

+ Experience in Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform (RHOCP) or Kubernetes or Docker cluster management
+ Understanding of RHOCP Architecture & different types of RHOCP installations Experience in RHOCP Troubleshooting and data/logs collection
+ Strong working knowledge of Prometheus and Grafana open source monitoring solutions will be considered a plus
+ Administration experience of Red Hat OpenShift v4.x will be considered a plus
+ Competent comprehension of enterprise architecture and strategic business drivers

* Direct experience with a variety of hardware vendors

**About Red Hat**
Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.
  
  
**Inclusion at Red Hat**
Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)**
Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.
  
  
Red Hat does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or CVs from recruitment agencies. We are not responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions, or any other payment related to unsolicited resumes or CVs except as required in a written contract between Red Hat and the recruitment agency or party requesting payment of a fee.
  
  
Red Hat supports individuals with disabilities and provides reasonable accommodations to job applicants. If you need assistance completing our online job application, email application-assistance@redhat.com. General inquiries, such as those regarding the status of a job application, will not receive a reply.
