title: Account Director – AI-Native
description:
**Account Director – AI-Native**

Tealbox Digital · Gurgaon · Hybrid, 3 days a week · 5–10 years' experience

₹20–26 lakh fixed + up to 20% variable

**The bet we're making**

Most of what a media buyer does today - building campaigns, structuring accounts, reading reports, spotting the obvious optimisation - is going to be absorbed by AI. Not in five years. Now.

If that's right, the scarce skill in an agency stops being platform expertise. It becomes two things. Knowing what to point the systems at. And being the person a client actually trusts.

We're hiring for that role. You'd own a portfolio of client businesses. You'd run them through an AI layer we're building. You'd be the human accountable for what comes out. Not an account manager who uses AI. Someone whose job is to get far more done per person than the industry thinks possible.

**About Tealbox**

We're a paid media agency for B2B SaaS and DTC brands, on Meta, Google and YouTube. Accounts run from ₹5 lakh to ₹5 crore a month in ad spend. Small team, serious about the craft. We're working out what an agency should be once the execution gets automated.

**What you'd own**

* **The portfolio.**
  A book of client businesses, end to end. Measured on whether clients stay and grow and on the portfolio's margin - not on what you shipped.
* **The client relationship.**
  You're the person they call. You bring a point of view they didn't ask for. You tell them the truth when it's inconvenient. You say no when no is right.
* **Quality control at scale.**
  The hard part. Twenty accounts of AI-generated analysis means twenty accounts of plausible-looking output. Some of it is wrong. All of it is spending someone's money. You're the check.
* **The AI layer, applied.**
  We build the systems. You decide how they're used on each account. You spot where they're working and where they're producing confident nonsense. You tell us what to build next.
* **A small pod.**
  A couple of people plus the systems. You coach them and set how the pod works.

**Who we're looking for**

Five to ten years in account management, client servicing, performance marketing or growth. We care more about the shape of your judgment than the label on your CV.

* **Business judgment.**
  You see what actually drives a client's business. When you see a number, you have an instinct for whether it's plausible before you check.
* **Client trust.**
  You've held senior relationships and kept them. You've challenged a client and been right.
* **AI fluency you can show.**
  Not "I use ChatGPT." You've changed how you work. You know where the tools break. You've built something other people now use.
* **The scepticism to catch a wrong answer.**
  You don't accept confident output because it's well formatted.

**On advertising knowledge, read carefully.**
You need to read performance data with confidence. You need to hold your own with a media buyer. You need to be credible with a client about why performance moved. That's a real bar and we'll test it. You do not need to build campaigns yourself. We think the buying craft moves into the systems. What doesn't move is judgment about whether the output is any good. If you're a strong media buyer who wants to keep building campaigns, this job will frustrate you.

**Compensation**

Fixed: ₹20–26 lakh a year, depending on experience. Variable: up to 20% of fixed, paid twice a year. Three targets: client retention in your portfolio, portfolio margin, and accounts under management.

**Why this is worth your time**

* **You'd be early on the thing everyone's about to do**
  . Every agency will claim to be AI-native within two years. You'd have actually done it, with proof.
* **Your output is your market value.**
  If you can run twenty-five accounts where a peer runs six, you're worth several times that peer in the market. The variable is built to reflect that. This role makes you more valuable, not more locked in.
* **Direct line to the founder building the system you use.**
  Your feedback goes straight to the person building it.

**The honest version**

* **The AI layer runs on a few accounts today.**
  It's being expanded. Some of what you need will be ready when you join. Some won't. You'd shape it from real problems.
* **The ramp is real.**
  You start with five to eight accounts, not twenty. Twenty to thirty is where this goes within a year, if the systems deliver. That's the direction, not the starting line.
* **Gurgaon-based, hybrid, three days a week in office;**
  days agreed with Varun.
* **We work to the outcome.**
  When a client outcome, a launch or a live problem needs attention outside normal hours, we deal with it. That expectation grows with seniority. Three things come with it. Your manager owes you recovery time after a heavy stretch. Anything that causes repeated out-of-hours work gets fixed as a process problem, not absorbed. And nobody here measures commitment by response time at midnight.
* **We're mid-repair.**
  We're a founder-led business fixing how it manages people. You'd be joining during, not after.
* **Nobody has done this job before.**
  Including us.

**How we'll hire**

Four rounds, quick, and you'll know where you stand at every step.

1. **Track record and business judgment:**
   A conversation.
2. **Assignment:**
   A three-hour take-home exercise.
3. **Client leadership:**
   Assignment discussion and a live client role-play.
4. **Values and ways of working:**
   A two-way conversation.

If this sounds like the kind of challenge you’d enjoy, we’d love to hear from you.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
The role
  
  
As a Manager, Technical Services, you will lead a team of highly skilled support engineers. You will create the conditions for excellent customer outcomes, develop technical and people leadership capability within the team, and help scale the support model for evolving customer workloads.
  
  
Your team will support a broad range of technologies, including MongoDB database and cloud services, distributed applications, APIs, cloud infrastructure, observability, and modern AI-enabled application workflows. You will help establish durable operating practices for a fast-growing area while ensuring seamless collaboration with the wider global Technical Services organization.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Technical Services Engineers, including regular 1:1s, clear goals, performance feedback, career development, and succession planning
* Build an inclusive, accountable, and customer-focused team culture where engineers can do their best work
* Own regional service delivery for your team, balancing customer experience, case health, quality, operational discipline, and team sustainability
* Lead and coordinate high-impact customer escalations, ensuring timely communication, sound technical judgment, clear ownership, and effective follow-through
* Partner with Engineering, Product, Security, Customer Success, Sales, and other Technical Services teams to resolve complex issues and bring customer feedback into product and process improvements
* Work with global peers to maintain consistent follow-the-sun processes, effective handoffs, and high-quality support across regions
* Help scale support for modern application workloads involving APIs, cloud services, distributed systems, containers, observability, data services, and AI-enabled application workflows, including agent orchestration, model and tool integrations, MCP, retrieval, memory, and production reliability considerations
* Establish and improve team operating mechanisms, including incident management, case reviews, root-cause analysis, knowledge management, quality practices, and capacity planning
* Identify recurring customer issues and drive improvements to self-service content, diagnostic tooling, runbooks, and support processes
* Participate in hiring and onboarding, and build a strong local talent pipeline
* Use operational metrics and customer feedback to identify trends, communicate performance, and prioritize improvements
* Contribute to regional and global Technical Services initiatives that improve the customer experience, operational efficiency, and technical capability of the organization

What you’ll bring
  
  
**Required**

* 3+ years of experience leading a technical support, customer engineering, site reliability, operations, or similar customer-facing technical team
* Demonstrated success developing people, managing performance, hiring strong talent, and building inclusive, high-performing teams
* Experience coordinating complex or high-severity customer escalations and working effectively with Engineering and Product organizations
* Strong technical foundation in troubleshooting production systems, with the ability to guide structured investigations across application, infrastructure, network, identity, and data layers
* Experience with one or more of cloud platforms, distributed systems, databases, containerized workloads, APIs, observability, or enterprise software
* Foundational knowledge of AI-enabled applications and agentic workflows, with the ability to assess technical judgment in areas such as agents, model-provider integrations, tool calling, Model Context Protocol (MCP), retrieval and memory, orchestration, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop workflows
* Strong customer advocacy and sound judgment under pressure, with the ability to set expectations and drive issues to resolution
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt communication for technical, business, and executive audiences
* Experience translating organizational objectives into clear team priorities, measurable outcomes, and individual goals
* A collaborative, pragmatic leadership style and the ability to operate effectively across global, cross-functional teams

**Preferred**

* Experience supporting MongoDB, MongoDB Atlas, or another database or distributed data platform
* Experience with cloud-native technologies, such as AWS, Azure, or GCP; Docker; Kubernetes; networking; identity and access management; or CI/CD systems
* Familiarity with logs, metrics, traces, alerting, incident response, and root-cause analysis
* Experience supporting developer platforms, platform services, or AI-enabled applications
* Experience using operational metrics, dashboards, or scorecards to improve support performance and customer outcomes

Success in the role
  
  
Within 30 days
  
  

* Complete MongoDB onboarding and build rapport with the team and key partners
* Develop a working understanding of the Technical Services operating model, customer support processes, and product portfolio
* Establish a regular 1:1 cadence and begin assessing team strengths, development opportunities, and operational priorities

Within 60 days
  
  

* Build productive relationships with peer managers and stakeholders in Engineering, Product, Customer Success, Sales, and Escalation Management
* Understand regional and global follow-the-sun workflows, escalation processes, and the team’s current performance measures
* Begin contributing to regional escalations, case reviews, and team operating rhythms

Within 90 days
  
  

* Own the day-to-day leadership of the team, including development planning, performance management, and delivery oversight
* Identify opportunities to improve team efficiency, knowledge sharing, customer experience, or technical readiness
* Define a practical plan for scaling the team’s capability and operational maturity over the following 6–12 months

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
  
  
MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
  
  
MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

title: Integrated Logistics Excellence Manager Performance
description:
**It's more than a job**
As a member of the Freight Forwarding team Kuehne+Nagel, you will play a key role in transporting goods, optimising processes, and fulfilling our customers' promises. And by transporting medicines, toys and important machine parts, you are not only delivering goods, you are making small and big moments possible for people all around the world. At Kuehne+Nagel, our contribution counts in more ways than we imagine.
  
  
‎
  
  
The IL Excellence Manager is responsible for driving operational excellence across the supply chain by managing LSP performance, ensuring compliance with SOPs and KPIs, and advancing digital integration through automation and real-time shipment visibility.
  
  
The role collaborates closely with internal stakeholders and external LSPs to support efficient operations, continuous improvement, and successful customer implementations.
  
  
**How you create impact**
LSP (3PL) Management
  
  

* Manage and oversee Logistics Service Providers (LSPs) to ensure service excellence
* Monitor supplier performance, drive continuous improvement, and manage escalations
* Support LSP onboarding, integration, SOP implementation, EDI, and digital initiatives
* Coordinate with customers, Control Towers, and internal stakeholders to ensure smooth operations
* Lead LSP training and change management during new implementations

Problem Solving
  
  

* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) to resolve operational issues affecting KPIs and service quality
* Identify process bottlenecks, analyze performance data, and implement corrective actions
* Monitor process deviations and troubleshoot system or data integration issues

Business Continuity & Hypercare
  
  

* Ensure BCP readiness and resolve critical supply chain disruptions during Hypercare

Freight Procurement
  
  

* Support transportation procurement, supplier management, and cost optimization

**What we would like you to bring**

* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience
* Strong background in 3PL/logistics operations
* Experience in transportation, preferably within the pharmaceutical industry
* Knowledge of reefer containers, GDP/GxP, and logistics data management
* Experience in LSP supplier management, including performance monitoring and escalation handling
* Candidates with an Operations Excellence Manager background may also be considered
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

**What's in it for you**
At Kuehne+Nagel, you’ll be part of a global logistics leader that believes in creating real impact on business, on customers, and on careers. Here’s what you can look forward to:
  
  

* Global Exposure: Step into a world of international opportunities with a presence in 100+ countries
* People-Centric Culture: Join a team where your voice matters and people genuinely care
* Learning & Development: Grow with us personally and professionally through world-class training and career pathways
* Innovation & Sustainability: Be part of a future-focused company driving real change in logistics and the planet
* Rewards & Recognition: Get rewarded for your passion, performance, and potential
* Stability with Agility: Enjoy the best of both worlds a trusted global brand with a startup spirit

**Who we are**
Logistics shapes everyday life - from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.
  
  
As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. Whether we help deliver life-saving medicines, develop sustainable transportation solutions or support our local communities, your career will contribute to more than you can imagine.

title: Head of Hospitality (Pan India)
description:
Company: Dolphy India Private Limited

Position: Head of Hospitality

Location: Gurugram, Haryana

Industry Must Have: Hotel Project—Working

Job Purpose

We are looking for an experienced and well-connected Hospitality Head who has strong relationships with India's leading hotel chains, hotel owners, corporate management teams, and procurement decision-makers. The ideal candidate should have excellent communication, networking, negotiation, and business development skills.

**Must Have Candidate Profile**

* Experience in selling hospitality-related products and solutions for new hotel projects, hotel construction, renovation, and pre-opening requirements.
* Strong connections with hotel owners, developers, project directors, architects, interior designers, consultants, purchase heads, and procurement teams.
* Experience in project sales, specification sales, B2B sales, and institutional sales within the hospitality industry.
* Established relationships with India's leading hotel chains, particularly their corporate procurement and project development teams.
* Ability to identify upcoming hotel projects and generate business opportunities at the planning, construction, and furnishing stages.
* Experience in selling hotel bathroom products, sanitaryware, faucets, bathroom accessories, and other hospitality-related products.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-management skills.
* Ability to convert professional connections into product approvals, vendor registrations, project orders, and long-term corporate business.

**Must Have Background:**
Candidates from hospitality project sales, building materials, sanitaryware, bath fittings, interior solutions, or hotel project procurement will be preferred.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with owners, promoters, directors, corporate heads, and senior management of major hotel chains across India.
* Build direct connections with procurement heads, purchase managers, sourcing teams, and corporate procurement departments.
* Generate new business opportunities and develop strategic corporate accounts.
* Establish relationships with hotel groups for centralized procurement, product approvals, vendor empanelment, and bulk purchasing.
* Identify key decision-makers and convert professional relationships into business opportunities.
* Conduct corporate meetings, negotiate commercial terms, and manage key accounts.
* Coordinate with internal sales, procurement, and operations teams to achieve revenue targets.
* Expand Dolphy's presence across luxury, premium, midscale, and economy hotel segments.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Relevant experience in hospitality product sales, hotel procurement, key account management, or corporate business development.
* An established professional network within India's major hotel chains.
* Strong relationships with hotel owners, corporate leadership, procurement heads, and purchase decision-makers.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-management skills.
* Proven ability to generate business through networking and convert contacts into long-term corporate accounts.
* Experience in vendor registration, product listing, centralized procurement, and B2B sales will be an advantage.
* New hotel-chain corporate accounts developed.
* Meetings secured with relevant decision-makers.
* Successful vendor registrations and product approvals.
* Qualified business opportunities and revenue generated.
* Growth in repeat business and long-term corporate relationships.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
At Sciometrix, our goal is to deliver the best-ever personalized care with utmost compassion enabling patients to lead healthier and happier lives. Our commitment to innovation in healthcare technology drives us to lead the way in Care Management, Digital Care Coordination, Value-Based Care, and Population Health.
  
  
We envision a world where advanced technology and human compassion intersect seamlessly to deliver superior patient experiences and outcomes.”
  
  
Our mission is to enhance the lives of patients by leveraging digital solutions that reduce hospital readmissions, improve health outcomes, and optimize the delivery of healthcare services.
  
  
At the heart of our philosophy lies the belief that every patient deserves access to the highest quality of care, tailored to their individual needs. We strive to make this vision a reality by pioneering innovative solutions that prioritize patient well-being and provider efficiency. With Sciometrix, the future of healthcare is not just about treating illnesses; it's about empowering patients to live their best lives.
  
  
**What's In It For You**
🚀Dynamic Startup Culture: Cultivate a security-focused mindset within our agile startup environment, advocating for proactive risk management and continuous improvement as fundamental pillars, enabling us to thrive in the fast-paced world of web development.
  
  
⚧️Commitment to Diversity: We are paving the way to create change in the industry and our leadership is committed to diversity, inclusion and belonging
  
  
🌍 Global Network: Expand your global network by developing, learning, and growing with our top talent and connections around the world
  
  
🤝🏻Community of Belonging: As a community of belonging, we prioritize creating an environment where everyone feels safe, empowered, and valued. Our organization is committed to fostering continual growth and cultivating the ideal atmosphere that enables you to bring forth your best self at work.
  
  
🌟Benefits: Hybrid Work Opportunity, Health Insurance, Accidental wellness cover, Company provided devices, Internet reimbursement, 20 total leaves(+Maternity, paternity & Bereavement leave), 10 Holidays (including optional)
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are seeking a dynamic and results-oriented Customer Success Manager (CSM) to join our team. The CSM will be responsible for driving customer success, fostering long-term relationships, and identifying growth opportunities. The ideal candidate is customer-centric, has a strong background in account management, and is skilled in identifying and leveraging opportunities for customer expansion.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Account Management Strategies: Develop and implement strategies to manage customer accounts, ensuring customer satisfaction and loyalty.
* Customer Retention: Work closely with customers to understand their needs and ensure they continue to find value in our products and services.
* Performance Metrics: Track and analyze customer success metrics, providing regular reports and insights to both customers and internal stakeholders. Improve performance , trouble shoot with internal teams
* Customer Advocacy: Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, advocating for their needs within the company and ensuring their voice is heard, gather and relay customer feedback to product and development teams to drive continuous improvement.
* Collaboration and Communication: Act as a liaison between customers and the marketing team, ensuring seamless communication and collaboration to meet customer needs.
* Customer Support Troubleshooting: Efficiently identify and resolve customer issues, ensuring prompt and effective solutions.
* Customer Experience Enhancement: Focus on creating strategies and processes to optimize the customer journey and develop initiatives to enhance the overall customer experience.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in business, Marketing, or a related field.
* 5-10 Years of experience as a customer success specialist
* B2B SaaS start-up experience will be preferred
* Proven experience as a Customer Success Manager, Account Manager, or similar role.
* Strong understanding of customer success principles and practices.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to build and maintain strong customer relationships.
* Demonstrated ability to identify and pursue growth opportunities.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to track and report on key performance metrics.
* Proficiency with customer success software and CRM tools.

**Equal Opportunity**
Sciometrix is an
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
and is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and more.

title: Chief Relationship Manager-First Private
description:
**Job Requirements**
About the Role
  
  
The
**Chief Relationship Manager – First Private**
is responsible for acquiring and managing relationships with High Net Worth Individuals (HNIs) and Ultra High Net Worth Individuals (UHNIs). The role focuses on delivering comprehensive wealth management solutions, including investment, insurance, and other banking products, to meet the sophisticated financial needs of private banking clients. The role holder is expected to drive fee income, ensure exceptional customer satisfaction, and position IDFC FIRST Bank as the preferred financial partner for affluent clients.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Acquire HNI and UHNI clients through natural market outreach, open market activities, and referrals from internal sources such as branches and digital networks.
* Manage end-to-end customer relationships by addressing all banking and wealth management needs.
* Provide a seamless and personalized banking experience, both in terms of product offerings and relationship management.
* Drive cross-sell of investment, insurance, and other bank products to generate fee income.
* Achieve high customer satisfaction scores by delivering consistent and high-quality service.

Secondary Responsibilities
  
  

* Ensure full compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies.
* Maintain a strong relationship management orientation with a focus on service excellence.
* Demonstrate a results-driven approach with a strong execution mindset.

Managerial & Leadership Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead and develop a high-performing team.
* Ensure adequate staffing and capability building across the team.
* Drive target achievement and monitor team performance to meet business goals.

What We Are Looking For
  
  
Education
  
  

* Graduation:Any discipline (Full-Time)
* Postgraduation:MBA / PGDM (Preferred)

**Experience**

* Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in private banking, wealth management, or allied financial services.

Skills and Attributes
  
  

* Deep understanding of investment and insurance products.
* Proven ability to manage and grow HNI/UHNI client relationships.
* Strong interpersonal, communication, and relationship-building skills.
* High focus on customer service and satisfaction.
* Leadership and team management capabilities.
* Execution-oriented with a results-driven mindset.
* High level of integrity and commitment to compliance.

The company focuses on helping clients grow through tailored business development strategies and advisory services. In addition to core consulting, Kheewa provides promotion and portfolio management support to strengthen client visibility and performance. The team is committed to long-term partnerships, working closely with clients to drive sustainable business growth and operational improvement.Role Description The Key Account Manager is a full-time, remote role responsible for managing and growing relationships with key clients across the MSME sector. This role involves overseeing client accounts, understanding business needs, and proposing strategic solutions that support growth and performance. Day-to-day tasks include conducting business reviews, developing account plans, coordinating with internal teams to deliver services, and monitoring client satisfaction and outcomes. description:
## About the Role

You will own a book of named accounts and grow revenue from each one: more kits, more instruments, more workflows. You will sell and expand Manta, Beluga and Orca across hospital labs, diagnostic labs and research institutes. You report to the Co-Founder and Chief Sales & Marketing Officer.

## Key Responsibilities

- Own and grow your accounts

- Build an account plan for each lab: current workflows, sample volumes, decision makers, budget cycles and the next expansion opportunity.

- Drive reagent and consumable pull-through on every installed Manta, Beluga and Orca. Track run volumes and act early when usage drops.

- Expand each account from extraction (Manta, Beluga) into library prep automation (Orca) and sample-to-report workflows, and into new sites within multi-site groups.

- Own renewals: kit supply contracts, AMCs and warranty extensions.

- Be the customer's single point of contact

- Run quarterly business reviews with lab heads and procurement on volumes, cost per reportable test, uptime and open issues.

- Coordinate Field Application Scientists and Field Service Engineers for installs, validations, troubleshooting and training. Raise and follow tickets on the FAS/FSE desk until closed.

- Manage escalations calmly and early, before they become trust problems.

- Run the commercial process

- Prepare quotations, pro-formas and bundle proposals, and negotiate pricing within approved limits.

- Collect advances and payments to company terms. Work with procurement on tenders, single-source and proprietary article certificates where needed.

- Keep pipeline, forecasts and account activity up to date in Odoo CRM, every week.

- Feed the company

- Bring back what customers want next: new assays, input volumes, panels and integrations. Product and R&D teams build from this.

- Turn happy accounts into references, case studies and joint publications with marketing.

## Requirements

- 2 to 4 years selling or managing accounts in life science tools, NGS, molecular diagnostics or lab automation in India.

- A degree in life sciences, biotechnology or a related field. You can talk extraction chemistry, library prep and NGS workflows with a lab scientist.

- A record of growing revenue inside existing accounts, not only winning new ones. Bring numbers.

- Relationships with genomics labs, hospital molecular labs, diagnostic chains or research institutes in your region.

- Comfort with long, multi-stakeholder deals: lab head, clinical lead, procurement and finance.

- Disciplined with CRM, forecasts and follow-through.

- Willing and able to travel at least 20 days a month, including tier 2 cities.

## Preferred Qualifications

- Experience at a company like Thermo Fisher, Illumina, MGI, Qiagen, Revvity, Roche or a strong Indian distributor.

- Hands-on bench experience in a molecular or NGS lab.

- Experience with government or institutional tenders (GeM, ICMR, AIIMS).

- Exposure to NIPT, oncology NGS or infectious disease workflows.

## What We Offer

Competitive fixed pay plus an uncapped incentive tied to account revenue growth. Direct line to the founders, and a seat in building the commercial team as we scale toward INR 100 crore. Products built and manufactured in India, used by the country's largest genomics labs.

## Location & Work Mode

Field role: travel at least 20 days a month

title: Service Manager
description:
**Location:**
New Delhi (Sarita Vihar)

**Working Hours:**
Any 9 hours between 9am - 9pm

**Working Days:**
5 days per week

**Weekly Offs:**
2 rotational offs between Monday and Friday

**Saturday & Sunday:**
Mandatory working

**Experience:**
5–9 years

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced
**Service Delivery Manager**
to lead service delivery operations for a premium customer segment within a leading consumer internet organization.

The role will involve managing a team of
**Relationship Managers and Team Leads**
, ensuring high-quality customer service, effective escalation management, and strong customer retention and renewal outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead and manage a team of approximately
  **30–40 Relationship Managers and Team Leads**
  .
* Drive consistent service delivery and ensure a high-quality customer experience.
* Manage customer escalations and ensure timely, structured resolution of issues.
* Monitor team performance against defined service and business objectives.
* Drive customer engagement, retention, and
  **renewal outcomes**
  .
* Work closely with internal stakeholders to resolve operational and customer-related challenges.
* Coach and mentor Team Leads and Relationship Managers to improve productivity, service quality, and performance.
* Identify recurring customer issues and work with relevant teams to implement sustainable solutions.
* Maintain strong relationships with
  **high-value/HNI customers**
  and ensure a premium service experience.
* Track operational metrics and provide regular performance updates to leadership.
* Ensure adherence to organizational processes, service standards, and compliance requirements.

What We’re Looking For

* **5–9 years of relevant professional experience**
  , preferably in service delivery, customer success, customer experience, relationship management, or operations.
* Experience managing
  **large customer-facing teams**
  of 30+ members.
* Strong experience in
  **escalation management and customer relationship management**
  .
* Exposure to customer retention, renewals, or account management.
* Strong people-management, coaching, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Excellent communication and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, customer-centric environment.
* Experience handling premium, high-value, or HNI customer segments would be an advantage.

Why Join Us?

* Opportunity to work with a
  **leading consumer internet brand**
  .
* Manage a high-performing customer-facing team.
* Work with a premium and high-value customer segment.
* Opportunity to influence customer experience, retention, and service delivery at scale.

**Work Location:**
New Delhi

* **Work Schedule:**
  5 days a week, with Saturday and Sunday working and two rotational weekly offs between Monday and Friday.

title: Account Development Manager
description:
**Job Purpose**
The Accounts Manager is the main interface between the Company and our partner community. The Accounts Manager is responsible for the 'complete' sales cycle for the relevant business partners with the view to maximizing revenue, margin, and partner satisfaction. Having internal resources for assistance, the role is to develop deep relationships with key people inside the business partner and uncover sales opportunities, while delivering ongoing value to the partner.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* With assistance from the Channels Director build and execute a call plan that will ensure maximum return from the business partner community.
* Develop a solid understanding of the product range and present an informed overview.
* Up and cross sell each opportunity for maximum margin return and differentiation.
* Understand strengths and weaknesses in the product sets from a technical perspective.
* Liaise with other divisions of the Company, as required, to ensure efficient customer transactions that ultimately deliver a sound buying experience for the Company's partners.
* Keep CRM up to date to ensure you and the management team have an accurate view of your business.
* Ensure all quotations are followed up and moved through the various levels of a sales cycle with ultimate goal, being of closure.
* Capture and maintain all relevant data needed to sell and renew maintenance.
* Plan, design and implement outbound campaigns as necessary to deliver on agreed margin goals
* Make outbound sales calls to business partners and prospects as per call plan.
* Identify the Company's services opportunities in conjunction with the the Company's Technical Services team.
* Ensure all quotations are built using the company quotation tool.
* Provide Sales Support Specialist with all relevant information necessary to build and configure the 'winning' solution.
* Achieve and maintain sales certification for relevant product groups when required
* Ensure all partner issues are resolved promptly and seek management guidance where necessary.
* Ensure all business partners are alerted of any upcoming renewals
* Ensure the CRM is updated and used pro-actively to drive business engagements and forecasting
* Accurately forecast business with Sales Manager on a monthly basis.
* Work with Sales Support and provide support where necessary to ensure timely logging of orders.

**Knowledge, Skills And Experience**

* Minimum 4 to 6 years of experience selling IT solutions in the channel required.
* Tertiary IT degree or Diploma preferable
* Relationship Building Skills
* Communication Skills
* Self managed
* Maturity - able to work with all levels within an organization
* Strong business acumen
* Presentation Skills
* Leverage internal relationships and sell the 'value add'
* Opportunity Closing Skills
* Technically competent

At Tech Data, a TD SYNNEX Company, our values guide everything we do: Together, We Own It, We Dare to Go, We Grow and Win, and above all, We Do the Right Thing. These principles shape how we work with each other, our partners, and our communities as we drive innovation and create lasting impact.
  
  
**What's In It For You?**

* Elective Benefits: Our programs are tailored to your country to best accommodate your lifestyle.
* Grow Your Career: Accelerate your path to success (and keep up with the future) with formal programs on leadership and professional development, and many more on-demand courses.
* Elevate Your Personal Well-Being: Boost your financial, physical, and mental well-being through seminars, events, and our global Life Empowerment Assistance Program.
* Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: It's not just a phrase to us; valuing every voice is how we succeed. Join us in celebrating our global diversity through inclusive education, meaningful peer-to-peer conversations, and equitable growth and development opportunities.
* Make the Most of our Global Organization: Network with other new co-workers within your first 30 days through our onboarding program.
* Connect with Your Community: Participate in internal, peer-led inclusive communities and activities, including business resource groups, local volunteering events, and more environmental and social initiatives.

**Don't meet every single requirement? Apply anyway.**

If you're excited about working for our company and believe you're a good fit for this role, we encourage you to apply. You may be exactly the person we're looking for!

title: Business Growth & Client Success Manager
description:
**Experience:**
3–5 years

**Compensation:**
₹8LPA + performance incentives

**Location:**
Delhi NCR / Hybrid

**Employment:**
Full-time

About The Violet

The Violet is a creative AI-first digital agency working across content, branding, design, demand generation and performance marketing.

We believe AI should not sit separately from marketing. It should improve how teams research, think, create, sell, analyse and execute.

We are looking for someone who can own
**business growth, client relationships and AI-enabled workflows**
across the agency.

This is not a traditional sales role and it is not a conventional account-management role.

You should be comfortable speaking to founders and marketing leaders, managing client expectations, closing business and personally using AI tools to work faster and smarter.

What You Will Own

* Generate and develop new business opportunities through outbound, LinkedIn, referrals, networking and inbound leads.
* Conduct discovery calls and understand client business problems independently.
* Create proposals, pitch narratives, scope documents and commercial recommendations.
* Own follow-ups, negotiations and movement of opportunities towards closure.
* Become the primary point of contact for assigned clients.
* Conduct client review calls independently without requiring founder participation.
* Manage expectations around timelines, revisions, scope and deliverables.
* Coordinate design, content, SEO, performance, video and specialist resources.
* Work closely with the project coordinator to ensure briefs, feedback and timelines are properly documented.
* Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities within existing accounts.
* Support renewals and payment follow-ups.

AI Is a Core Part of This Role

You should already be comfortable using AI hands-on rather than treating it as something only the creative team uses.

You will be expected to use AI for areas such as:

* Client and industry research
* Competitor analysis
* Proposal development
* Pitch preparation
* Content ideation
* Campaign thinking
* Brief creation
* Meeting summaries
* Client communication
* Presentation development
* Reporting and analysis
* Sales prospect research
* Outreach personalisation
* Process documentation
* Workflow automation
* Quality checking and refinement

You should be comfortable working with tools such as
**ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, Canva AI and other emerging AI platforms**
relevant to marketing and agency operations.

We are not looking for someone who simply says, “I use ChatGPT.”

We want someone who knows how to
**structure prompts, iterate intelligently, fact-check outputs, improve them and turn AI output into usable business work.**

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 90 days, you should be able to:

* Manage most client conversations independently.
* Run discovery and sales calls without founder involvement.
* Create strong first drafts of proposals and pitch material using AI.
* Ensure clients interact with The Violet as an agency rather than depending on the founder.
* Reduce unnecessary calls and fragmented feedback loops.
* Create clearer briefs for internal teams.
* Maintain an organised pipeline and account tracker.
* Generate new recurring revenue.
* Use AI to significantly reduce time spent on repetitive sales and servicing tasks.
* Escalate only strategic or genuinely sensitive issues to the founder.

Who We Are Looking For

Ideally, you have 3–5 years of experience in a digital agency, creative agency, marketing services company, SaaS business or B2B services environment.

You should:

* Be confident speaking with founders, CXOs and senior marketing professionals.
* Understand digital marketing across social media, branding, websites, SEO, content and performance.
* Have experience managing clients, not only generating leads.
* Be commercially comfortable discussing scope and pricing.
* Be capable of handling difficult client conversations professionally.
* Have strong follow-up and project-management discipline.
* Be curious about AI and actively use it in your work.
* Be comfortable learning new tools without waiting for formal training.
* Know when AI output is weak, generic or factually unreliable.
* Be able to turn AI-assisted work into polished client-ready output.

This Role Is Not For You If

You are looking for a pure telecalling or lead-generation role.

You expect the founder to join every important client call.

You think account management means forwarding messages between clients and designers.

You use AI only for writing basic captions.

You copy-paste AI output without thinking, checking or refining it.

You are uncomfortable learning new tools or experimenting with new workflows.

Compensation

**Upto ₹8 Lacs Per Annum + Plus performance-linked incentives**

title: Ecommerce Growth Specialist
description:
Marketplace Ecommerce and Expansion Manager

**Company:**
Bluethread Brands Pvt. Ltd.

**Location:**
Gurugram (On-site)

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
3–6 years

About Bluethread

Bluethread Brands Pvt. Ltd. is a fashion company building and scaling a portfolio of contemporary fashion brands, including Dorabi and Aamili with a focus on design, craftsmanship, and inclusive fashion, we are building brands that combine distinctive aesthetics with everyday wearability.

We are looking for a driven, commercially minded
**Marketplace E-commerce & Expansion Manager**
to own and grow our presence across Indian and international marketplaces. This role goes beyond managing existing accounts. You will be responsible for identifying the right platforms for our brands, evaluating new growth opportunities, launching new marketplace channels, and scaling revenue across geographies, particularly the United States.

You should understand how marketplaces work as businesses, how to build a profitable presence on them, and what it takes to take a fashion brand from onboarding to meaningful scale.

Key Responsibilities1. Marketplace Expansion & Strategy

* Identify and evaluate relevant marketplaces across India and international markets, with a particular focus on the
  **US marketplace opportunity**
  .
* Research marketplace models, customer demographics, category demand, competitive positioning, commercial terms, commission structures, fulfilment requirements, and profitability.
* Build a marketplace expansion roadmap, prioritising platforms based on revenue potential, brand fit, operational feasibility, and contribution margins.
* Lead the onboarding and launch process for new marketplaces, from initial research and commercial discussions to catalog setup, integrations, and go-live.
* Explore opportunities across fashion marketplaces, multi-brand retail platforms, and other relevant online distribution channels.
* Develop market-entry strategies for international platforms, particularly the US, considering pricing, assortment, fulfilment, returns, duties, and local customer expectations.
* Build scalable processes for launching and managing multiple marketplaces simultaneously.

2. Marketplace Ownership & Growth

* Own the end-to-end performance of existing marketplace accounts, including Myntra, Nykaa Fashion, and other relevant platforms.
* Drive GMV growth through assortment planning, catalog optimisation, search visibility, conversion improvements, pricing, promotions, and best-seller scaling.
* Plan and execute marketplace campaigns, promotional events, and sale calendars.
* Work with platform account managers to unlock better visibility, marketing opportunities, and commercial growth.
* Identify underperforming products and categories and implement corrective action plans.
* Build strategies to improve sell-through, inventory productivity, repeat sales, and overall marketplace profitability.

3. US Marketplace Expansion

* Demonstrate a strong understanding of the US e-commerce landscape and the operating models of major marketplaces.
* Evaluate opportunities across platforms such as Amazon US, Walmart Marketplace, and relevant fashion-focused marketplaces, based on their suitability for our brands.
* Understand the differences between first-party retail (1P), third-party marketplace selling (3P), and direct-to-consumer models, and recommend the right approach for each opportunity.
* Evaluate fulfilment models such as Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA), seller-fulfilled operations, and third-party logistics providers.
* Assess US-specific requirements around catalog compliance, product listings, sizing, pricing, returns, shipping, taxes, and customer expectations.
* Build a practical launch and scaling plan for the US market, including platform selection, onboarding, assortment strategy, unit economics, and growth milestones.
* Coordinate with external partners, agencies, logistics providers, and platform representatives wherever required to establish and scale international operations.

4. Marketplace Operations & Backend Management

* Own catalog onboarding, product content, imagery, attributes, tagging, pricing, and listing quality.
* Manage inventory availability, stock accuracy, order fulfilment, cancellations, returns, and marketplace reconciliations.
* Use Unicommerce for inventory, order management, and marketplace integrations.
* Work with EasyEcom or similar OMS/WMS platforms wherever required.
* Coordinate with warehouse and logistics teams to improve fulfilment SLAs and minimise cancellations, returns, and operational penalties.
* Establish standard operating procedures to support efficient operations across multiple platforms and geographies.

5. Analytics, Performance & Profitability

* Build and maintain marketplace dashboards tracking GMV, net revenue, conversion rates, returns, sell-through, advertising performance, and contribution margins.
* Analyse product-level performance, customer demand, size-related returns, discount dependency, and inventory ageing.
* Evaluate marketplace commissions, fulfilment costs, advertising expenses, promotional funding, and other channel-specific costs to assess profitability.
* Develop business cases for new marketplace launches, including expected investment, revenue potential, operational requirements, and break-even considerations.
* Translate performance data into clear action plans and regularly report progress against revenue and profitability goals.

6. Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Work closely with design and merchandising teams to plan assortments and prioritise products for different markets.
* Coordinate with marketing teams on marketplace advertising, campaign participation, and brand visibility.
* Collaborate with finance, operations, logistics, and technology teams to ensure seamless execution.
* Ensure consistent brand positioning, pricing discipline, and product presentation across all platforms.

What We're Looking For

* 3–6 years of hands-on experience in marketplace e-commerce, online retail, or marketplace expansion.
* Demonstrated experience managing fashion, lifestyle, beauty, or consumer brands across one or more marketplaces.
* Strong understanding of Myntra and/or Nykaa Fashion, with the ability to independently manage existing accounts.
* **Practical exposure to international marketplaces, particularly the US market, or demonstrable experience building marketplace expansion strategies for international markets.**
* **Understanding of US marketplace models, including 1P versus 3P selling, FBA, seller-fulfilled operations, and marketplace unit economics.**
* **Experience identifying, onboarding, and scaling new sales channels is highly desirable.**
* **Proficiency in Unicommerce is mandatory; familiarity with EasyEcom or similar OMS/WMS platforms is an advantage.**
* **Strong commercial acumen, analytical skills, and an understanding of marketplace profitability.**
* **Ability to manage platform relationships, negotiate opportunities, and work independently without extensive hand-holding.**
* **A proactive, entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to turn research and strategy into actual marketplace launches and revenue.**

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, E-commerce, or a related field preferred.
* 3–6 years of relevant professional experience.
* Experience working with Indian fashion marketplaces and international e-commerce platforms is strongly preferred.

Why This Role Matters

* **Build new revenue channels:**
  Take ownership of identifying and scaling marketplaces rather than simply maintaining existing accounts.
* **Expand internationally:**
  Play a key role in building Bluethread's presence in the US and other global markets.
* **Own business outcomes:**
  Work directly on marketplace revenue, growth strategy, and profitability.
* **Work with an ambitious fashion portfolio:**
  Help scale brands with distinct identities, established products, and growth potential.
* **Have meaningful ownership:**
  Work in a founder-led environment where decisions are made quickly and your work has a direct impact on the business.
* **The ideal candidate is not just a marketplace account manager. They are a marketplace growth operator who can identify where a brand should sell, build the business case, launch the channel, and scale it profitably.**

title: Brand Partnerships Manager - FMCG
description:
**Brand Partnership Manager - FMCG**

**About Wishlink**

Wishlink is on a mission to revolutionize the creator economy and redefine how people shop. We're all about providing every user with a highly personalized shopping experience guided by creators, so they can find exactly what they want, in a very short time, while improving their online shopping experience severalfold. We are shaping a new era at the intersection of two of the most prominent aspects of the internet-
**e-commerce and social media**
.

**Team and Investors**

Wishlink was founded by 3 friends from college, Chandan, Shaurya, and Divyansh, with a shared passion to solve real-world problems at scale and consume content for hours (XD). We started Wishlink in January 2022 when we discovered products on social media that we wanted to buy but could not (in some cases, actually did)! We are based out of Gurugram. We have recently raised a
**series B round of $17.5M backed by leading global investors including Vertex Ventures SE Asia & India, Fundamentum, and Elevation Capital.**

**Why Join Us?**

**Exciting Problem**

The way people shop online is changing. Users are tired of spending hours browsing humongous catalogs on eCommerce marketplaces just to find a single piece of apparel they like. They need curation, and they need trusted reviews - which is what Wishlink is bringing with the help of content creators. Wishlink is at the forefront of this change, enabling users to shop in an easier and more exciting way.

**Immense Scale**

In just 3 years of existence, Wishlink is used by over
**900k users daily**
to discover and shop products online. This number has grown over 3x in the last 4 months.

**Stellar Team**

Wishlink is all about its people. Our team is young and energetic, come from stellar backgrounds, and are dedicated towards a common goal. Also, we have a LOT of fun!

**Growth Opportunity**

We have grown remarkably in the last 3 years and are doing a monthly GMV of over Rs. 300cr. We are working with over 50,000 content creators and 300+ brands and eCommerce marketplaces including Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Nykaa, Ajio, H&M, Savana (Urbanic), Only, Vero Moda, Libas, Aurelia, Mama Earth, and many more.

Wishlink presents an exciting opportunity for you to contribute to and grow within the creator-enabled eCommerce space, have the chance to work at an emerging consumer-tech startup and be an integral part of this dynamic journey.

**What would you be doing?**

* **Own the monetization P&L**
  — set and deliver the growth and revenue target across your category, and be accountable for the number end to end.
* **Build the category annual plans**
  — bottom-up targets by category and brand, the assumptions behind them, and the quarterly milestones that make the annual number credible. Own the re-forecast when reality moves.
* **Build the category strategy and brand playbook**
  — decide which categories and brands to prioritize, how to price and package solutions, what the pitch is, and what the reachout motion looks like at scale. Turn what works into something repeatable, not a series of one-off wins.
* **Hunt and farm brand budgets**
  — build the pipeline from the ground up, run the outreach, negotiate deals, and grow spend from existing brands season over season. You'll be as comfortable opening a cold brand as expanding a live one.
* **Set and drive targets across teams**
  — translate the category plan into clear targets for the respective category KAMs, align them on the why, and run the review cadence that keeps everyone honest against the number.
* **Run the category on data**
  — build the metrics and dashboards that matter, use them to spot opportunities and diagnose problems, and translate analysis into decisions (not just charts).
* **Partner cross-functionally**
  — work with sales, product, creator, and marketing teams to execute your plan when you don't directly control every lever.
* **Shape how we monetize**
  — as an early owner, define the playbook for categories that others will build on.

**What are we looking for?**

* **5–7 years in category management**
  at an FMCG / CPG or beauty & personal care (BPC) brand, or on the e-commerce / quick-commerce / marketplace side.
* **A track record of owning a commercial or revenue number**
  — ideally monetization, ad revenue, or retail media (not only supply, assortment, or vendor management).
* Experience
  **planning a target bottom-up**
  and then landing it across teams you don't directly manage.
* **Strong, hands-on data and analytics ability**
  — comfortable in Excel/Sheets and BI tools, and able to manipulate data yourself rather than relying entirely on an analyst.
* **Proven experience building business partnerships and alliances**
  — sourcing, negotiating, and growing brand relationships.
* **Strategic and hands-on in equal measure**
  — you can set the plan and also do the work in a lean, fast-moving environment.
* **Strong commercial judgment and communication**
  — able to influence stakeholders and make sound trade-off calls.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with retail media or ad-monetization products on a platform/marketplace.
* Exposure to the creator, influencer, or affiliate-commerce ecosystem.
* Have built a monetization or GTM motion from scratch before.

**Why join us?**

* Full ownership of a category's monetization — not a slice of it.
* A rare role that genuinely blends strategy, hands-on data, and partnerships.
* High-growth stage with room to shape how the category is built.

**Perks and Benefits**

* We are committed to providing the best environment for you to thrive in. To help with this, we have the following benefits available for all our employees.
* Competitive Salary, Generous ESOPs, and Relocation Bonus
* Learning & Development Programs with a Dedicated Budget
* Company sponsored newsletters and books
* ChatGPT Subscription
* Regular Team Outings
* Discounted Health Plans & Gym Memberships

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Manager, Tax Services**
**– Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) -**
**SAP FICO/SD - DRC E-Invoicing E-Reporting**
Join Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited and support US-based clients as they modernize and strengthen their tax functions through SAP-enabled transformation. This role sits within Tax Transformation Consulting and focuses on SAP FICO/SD integration and SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (DRC) capabilities supporting e-invoicing, e-reporting, and digital compliance requirements. You will work across tax, finance, IT, and business stakeholders to help design and deliver scalable compliance solutions in complex ERP environments.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Manager, Tax Services on the Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Business Development: Develop and maintain contact with top decision makers at key clients; organize and lead pursuit teams; participate and lead aspects of the proposal development process; contribute to the development of proposal pricing strategies.
* Client Management: Manage the day-to-day interactions with executive clients and sponsors.
* Engagement Management: Lead engagement planning and budgeting; mobilize and manage engagement teams; define deliverable structure and content; facilitate buy-in of proposed solutions from top management levels at the client; direct on-time, quality delivery of work products; manage engagement economics; and manage engagement risk.
* Practice Development & Eminence: Develop practical solutions and methodologies; develop "thought-ware" and "point-of-view" documents; participate in public speaking events; get published in industry periodicals.
* People Development: Perform role of counselor and coach; provide input and guidance into the staffing process; actively participate in staff recruitment and retention activities; provide leadership and support for delivery teams and staff in local offices.

**The team**
Deloitte’s Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) group helps our clients’ tax departments improve their operations by developing new technology-enabled, cutting-edge methods and processes. Deloitte TTC professionals are aligned across our global network of member firms to address our clients’ objectives in a seamless fashion. Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co-sourcing specialists who help connect our clients’ global strategies and the options that exist to turn theory into an executable plan.
  
  
TTC’s Enterprise Tax Integration (ETI) professionals provide an integrated approach to process improvement that can help the tax department maximize its strategic value to the organization. Companies that have already implemented or are considering implementing an enterprise resource planning (ERP) system often overlook the tax benefits these systems can provide or underestimate the impact on the tax department. To be most effective from a tax perspective, a successful ERP implementation requires professionals who specialize in tax and can effectively address a corporate tax function’s unique needs, requirements, and obligations. Our ETI team, the largest of its type, offers the necessary combination of skills, methodology and practical experience to help clients avoid the pitfalls of an ERP implementation.
  
  
Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) - Ever expanding regulations and increasing scrutiny on multinational corporations has made it necessary for leading-edge tax departments to serve a critical role in the risk management and overall performance of the enterprise. This has resulted in an opportunity for Deloitte to provide even greater value through our tax services, in helping develop tax departments of the future that are strategic, agile, and, above all, focused on creating value for the business.
  
  
Deloitte's TTC group helps our clients’ tax department move forward from their current state to the next generation of tax functions and is dedicated to finding new methods and processes to assist clients in improving their tax operations. Deloitte Tax LLP professionals are aligned worldwide to serve our clients’ needs through the TTC group. Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co-sourcing specialists who can help make the necessary connections between our clients’ global strategies and the many options for carrying them out in the tax function.
  
  
**Location: Bengaluru, Chennai, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, Pune**
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* 8 to 15+ years of total experience.
* 5+ years of Implementation experience in SAP ECC 6.0 & S4 HANA with focus on Tax integration with SAP FICO/MM/SD integration with direct or indirect tax experience.
* Experience with design and implement SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (DRC) solutions that support global e-invoicing, statutory reporting, and digital compliance requirements. Experience of working across tax, finance, IT, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable SAP-based compliance capabilities across complex ERP environments. Ability to translate country-specific statutory and e-invoicing requirements into functional specifications, solution designs, and testing scenarios.
* Expert in Direct and Indirect Tax configuration, Withholding Taxes, local country indirect tax localizations, VAT customizations and Reporting.
* Experience with User Exits, preparing functional specifications, executing test cycles, cutovers, go-live and Hypercare, providing user training and documentation.
* Expert in cross functional integration of modules - SD-FI & MM-FI
* Strong in project management, leadership abilities, and has tendency to independently execute project cycles and deliverables.
* Relentless focus on quality of work products while adhering to completing deliverables on time.
* Effective communications and strong presentation and team building skills. Initiative-taking participates in firm-based activities and owns his/her career.
* Strong analytical skills in business process design and requirements preparation

Preferred:
  
  

* SAP MM or SD (ECC or S4 HANA) Certified
* Experience with tax technology applications i.e., ONESOURCE /Global NEXT Integration, Vertex/Accelerator & Chain flow Accelerator Integration, Avalara, Sovos

description:
What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity?
  
  
At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. The
**Research Partner Account Manager (PAM)**
is responsible for driving annual sales, market development, and strategic growth across Illumina's Research portfolio in India. The role will lead engagement with key research institutions, government organizations, academia, national genomics programs, and strategic research partners to accelerate adoption of Illumina's sequencing and multiomics solutions.
  
  
The position focuses on achieving revenue growth, improving price realization, expanding technology utilization, and creating long-term demand through scientific partnerships, KOL engagement, and collaborative research initiatives. The Research PAM will serve as the primary commercial and scientific interface for strategic research customers, working cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Scientific Applications, Government Affairs, and Global teams to execute Illumina's research growth strategy across metro and Tier 2/3 markets.
  
  
Position Responsibilities
  
  

* Develop and execute the Research segment strategy for India aligned with Illumina's commercial objectives.
* Build strategic partnerships with government agencies, research institutes, academia, genome centers, and national research programs.
* Drive revenue growth, price realization, instrument utilization, and consumables adoption across the research portfolio.
* Identify and develop new strategic research opportunities, including national genomics initiatives, population genomics, agriculture, and translational research.
* Expand geographic reach across metro and Tier 2/3 cities to increase research market penetration.
* Drive adoption of emerging technologies, including multiomics, through scientific engagement and solution-based selling.
* Develop and execute collaborative account growth plans for key research institutions.

* Build relationships with principal investigators, scientific leaders, institutional decision-makers, and funding agencies.
* Lead strategic opportunity planning, forecasting, pipeline management, and CRM reporting.

* Demonstrated success in consultative, solution-based selling and scientific engagement.

* Strong strategic planning, communication, negotiation, and cross-functional leadership skills.
* Experience working across diverse geographic regions in India; exposure to South Asia (Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Nepal) is an added advantage.

* Contribute to regional OEM business planning, including annual targets, segment strategies and portfolio positioning. Share OEM feedback with product management for localization, pricing and portfolio development.
* Design-in and Standardization
* Work with OEM design and engineering teams to get Siemens instruments designed into their standard products, drawings and BOMs, and to standardize on Siemens across product lines.
* Understand OEM applications and P&IDs, then do instrument sizing and selection, and optimize the BOQ for cost, performance and delivery.
* Negotiate and manage frame agreements, rate contracts and annual volume commitments with OEMs, so that business is repeatable and predictable.
* Support OEMs with end-customer approvals. This means engaging end users, consultants and EPCs so that Siemens instruments are accepted on OEM-supplied skids and packages.
* Solution Selling and Partnerships
* Cross-sell and up-sell the wider DI portfolio to OEMs: controllers (S7-1200, S7-1500), HMI, TIA Portal, drives and motors (SINAMICS, SIMOTICS, and PMA portfolio such as SIMOTION and servo motors where relevant), and industrial communication. Offer integrated, instrument-to-controller solutions that make OEM machines more competitive.
* Promote digitalization offerings such as device diagnostics, asset management (SIMATIC PDM), Industrial Edge and IoT-based remote monitoring. These help OEMs differentiate their equipment and build service revenue.
* Work with channel partners and system integrators to serve OEMs, including partner enablement and joint account planning.
* Conduct product presentations, technical workshops, demos and training for OEM design and service teams.
* Market Intelligence and Sales Operations
* Track OEM market trends, OEM expansion plans and competitor activity, particularly Endress+Hauser, KROHNE, Yokogawa, Emerson, ABB, VEGA, WIKA and IFM. Use this intelligence for value-based selling and competitive positioning.
* Maintain the opportunity pipeline, forecasts and win/loss analysis in CRM (Salesforce), and give regular updates to management.
* Coordinate with internal teams, including product management, the application/technical support center, order management, logistics and service. The aim is competitive pricing, reliable lead times and smooth support for OEMs.

**Technical Requirements**

* Must have
* Strong knowledge of process instrumentation: measuring principles, selection criteria, installation requirements and calibration.
* Ability to work with P&IDs, data sheets, GA drawings and BOMs of OEM skids and equipment.
* Understanding of hazardous area classification and certifications (ATEX, IECEx, PESO), SIL requirements, hygienic and sanitary requirements for pharma and F&B, and material selection for process conditions.
* Knowledge of field communication protocols: HART, IO-Link, PROFIBUS PA, PROFINET, Modbus.
* Working knowledge of PLC-based automation and how instruments integrate with OEM control panels.
* Qualifications and Experience
* B.E./B.Tech in Instrumentation, Electronics & Instrumentation, or Instrumentation & Control Engineering (preferred). Electrical/Electronics candidates with a strong instrumentation background may also be considered.
* 10-14 years of experience in sales, business development or application engineering of process instrumentation, with instrumentation or automation OEMs or companies selling to them.
* At least 5 years in a customer-facing OEM sales or key account management role, with a proven record of design-in wins and volume business growth.
* Established network among OEMs in the assigned region. Familiarity with the related end-user and EPC community is an advantage.
* Key Competencies
* Techno-commercial acumen and value-selling skills, with an understanding of OEM cost structures and the price-volume balance.
* Strategic thinking and account planning.
* Strong customer relationship management and networking.
* Ability to influence OEM owners, design heads and purchase heads.
* Good communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Coaching and mentoring skills.
* Strong ownership and ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Self-driven, target-oriented, with a positive attitude and resilience.
* Willingness to travel within the assigned territory.

description:

This is a builder’s role. You’ll own Stefto’s international revenue agenda end to end: choosing the markets, opening the doors, closing the deals and growing the accounts, backed by a delivery engine that already serves India’s top banks and ARCs.

* Leverage Stefto’s track record with large Indian banks and ARCs to win global BFSI and collections mandates
* Partner with operations and delivery teams to design winning solutions and ensure smooth transitions
* Develop channel partners, alliances and advisor networks to speed up market entry
* Own the pipeline, forecasts and revenue reporting to the CEO
* Represent Stefto at global industry events and client meetings
* Build and lead a growth team as the function scales

This role is specifically for professionals who have
**sold BPO/BPM services to international clients**
. You’re a strong fit if you have:

* 10–15 years in business development, with
  **at least 5–6 years in international BD within the BPO/BPM/CX industry**
* A proven record of winning and growing offshore contracts with clients in the US, UK, Middle East or APAC
* Hands-on experience selling customer support, CX, collections or back-office services

* CXO-level presence with excellent communication and presentation skills
* An entrepreneurial mindset and the drive to build something new

**careers@stefto.com**

description:
