**Manager – Customer Experience (Queries)**
Global Business Services | Order-to-Cash (O2C)
  
  
**About Us**
With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.
  
  
Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other.
  
  
Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.
  
  
**About The Function**
Global Business Services (GBS) is where Diageo runs and transforms its core commercial and financial processes at scale. Within GBO, the Order-to-Cash (O2C) team owns the end-to-end journey from customer order through to cash collection — and the customer experience that surrounds it.
  
  
Customer Experience (Queries) sits at the heart of that journey. When a customer raises a query, dispute or claim, how quickly and cleanly we resolve it shapes their trust in Diageo and the cash we collect. This team is accountable for resolving customer queries at pace, removing the root causes behind them, and raising the service bar across markets.
  
  
It’s a space that blends operational delivery with transformation — where you improve today’s service while redesigning tomorrow’s, and see the impact of your work on both customers and the P&L almost immediately.
  
  
**About The Role**
As Manager – Customer Experience (Queries), you are the expert owner of customer query, orders, dispute and claim resolution across your markets, and a driving force behind improving and transforming how that work is done. This is an individual contributor role: you are accountable for service performance — speed, quality and customer satisfaction — and for reducing the volume and root causes of queries over time.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the end-to-end transformation of Order-to-Cash and customer service across people, process, technology and data — lifting service levels and reducing cost-to-serve across markets.
* Own process and technology solution transformation from design and business case through build, deployment and adoption, ensuring measurable service and efficiency gains.
* Drive continuous-improvement initiatives that embed a culture of ongoing improvement across query, dispute and claim resolution.
* Identify and eliminate the root causes of recurring queries, partnering with upstream O2C, master data and commercial teams to fix them at source.
* Use data and insight to track performance, prioritise improvements and report to senior stakeholders.
* Act as a subject-matter resource for the team on query-resolution best practice, helping embed standard ways of working as the market footprint grows.

**Essential**
**Experience / skills required**

* 10–12+ years' experience in Order-to-Cash, with deep end-to-end process knowledge.
* Proven track record of delivering transformation and change in an O2C or shared-services environment.
* Experience managing senior stakeholders across multiple markets.
* Strong analytical, data-driven approach to performance improvement.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder-influencing skills.

**Preferred**

* Lean / Six Sigma qualification, or demonstrable process-improvement experience.
* Customer service, query or dispute-management experience.
* Experience operating across multiple international markets.

**Working with us**
Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you, so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.
  
  
We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package.
  
  
**Diversity statement**
Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.
  
  
We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.
  
  
Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.
  
  
Ready to bring your best? This could be your opportunity.
  
  
If you require a reasonable adjustment, please ensure that you capture this information when you submit your application.

*be your best*

• Develop cloud migration, modernization, IaaS, backup-as-a-service and disaster-recovery-as-a-service opportunities.

• Position cloud security, governance, cost optimization and managed cloud operations.

• Coordinate workload assessment and migration planning with cloud and solution architecture teams.

5. Managed Services

• Identify recurring-revenue opportunities across infrastructure monitoring, NOC, remote infrastructure management and data center operations.

• Position managed cloud, backup and DR management, service desk, AMC, FMS and professional services.

• Work with delivery and service teams to define scope, service levels, transition plans and governance models.

• 12–18 years of experience in enterprise IT sales or strategic account management, with substantial exposure to a System Integrator environment.

• Proven experience in growing existing enterprise accounts through account mining, cross-selling and up-selling.

• Working knowledge of Data Center, Cloud and Managed Services solutions.

• Ability to understand customer infrastructure environments and translate business priorities into qualified opportunities.

• Strong relationships with enterprise customers, OEMs, cloud providers, distributors and technology partners.

• Experience managing large, complex and multi-OEM solution opportunities.

• Strong commercial understanding of revenue, gross margin, TCO, pricing, payment terms, profitability and collections.

• Experience working with Presales, Solution Architects, Delivery, Finance and OEM teams.

• Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and stakeholder-management skills.

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business or a related discipline.

• MBA in Sales, Marketing or Business Management is preferred.

• Relevant OEM, data center, cloud or managed-services certifications will be an advantage.

• Revenue and gross margin achieved from assigned accounts.

• Year-on-year account growth and improvement in share of wallet.

• Value of opportunities proactively created from existing accounts.

• Cross-sell and up-sell conversion across Data Center, Cloud and Managed Services.

• Pipeline coverage, forecast accuracy and opportunity conversion.

The ideal candidate knows the account, maps the technology environment and whitespace, creates opportunities proactively, engages Presales and OEM teams, expands wallet share and develops the customer into a strategic, multi-technology partnership.

title: Regional Director, Forward Deployed Engineering
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.
  
  
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.
  
  
****About The Role****
We're building a Forward Deployed Engineering team to close the gap between the value our enterprise customers expect from Cursor and the value they're actually getting. FDEs don't advise, they embed directly with customer engineering teams, build production-grade Cursor workflows, and transfer the habits and culture that compound long after the engagement ends. The measure of success is what's different at day 30, not what got shipped.
  
  
We're looking for a Regional Director, Forward Deployed Engineering to lead and help scale this team. You'll manage a growing team of FDEs working across our most strategic enterprise accounts, own what makes a world-class FDE engagement, and stay close enough to the work to escalate, coach, and course-correct in real time. You will serve as the primary point of contact for customers, owning both project delivery and the day-to-day relationship, while also identifying and scoping new opportunities. You'll also build our partner FDE track — training and enabling GSI and consulting partners who extend this motion at scale.
  
  
This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who combines deep technical credibility, strong people management, and the judgment to keep engagements scoped tight, delivered fast, and worth repeating. This role will be based in all 3 cities: Bengaluru, Mumbai and New Delhi.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  

* Sell

+ Own the full arc from technical discovery to executive close — partnering with Sales and Account teams to qualify opportunities, leading architecture reviews, surfacing integration complexity and infrastructure constraints, and scoping engagements with enough precision to de-risk delivery before a line of code is written
+ Build and present proposals that translate ambiguous customer problems into concrete, time-boxed deliverables with clear ROI
+ Sell the vision and the plan to C-suite stakeholders who need to believe in both the outcome and the team delivering it
+ Drive deal strategy on strategic accounts; your technical credibility is a direct lever on close rates for six- and seven-figure engagements

**Deliver**

* Serve as executive technical sponsor on your region's highest-priority engagements and manage stakeholder relationships from IC engineers to C-suite
* Ensure delivery quality across your team's projects: appropriate scoping, milestone tracking, technical standards, and clean handoffs to customer engineering teamsTranslate between business outcomes and technical implementation in both directions
* Identify and escalate product gaps, integration friction, and recurring customer pain back to Product and Engineering with enough specificity to drive roadmap decisions
* Manage active engagements: escalate on complex builds, coach FDEs on scoping and delivery decisions, and step in directly on accounts where the stakes are highest
* Build reusable playbooks that make the broader FDE org more capable over time

**Manage People**

* Lead, develop, and scale a team of 6–8 Forward Deployed Engineers working strategic FDE projects
* Hire top-tier FDE talent; set clear expectations, technical performance standards, and career growth paths for a team where "excellent" means actually shipping in production
* Coach FDEs through the hardest problems in the field — scoping under deal pressure, building alongside senior technical stakeholders, and knowing when to protect scope vs. when to flex
* Build and scale the partner FDE track — train, enable, and hold the quality bar for GSI and consulting partners who carry the FDE motion forward at volume

You may be a fit if
  
  

* You have 8+ years of experience leading technical teams that build and ship in production — Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or a similar function where writing and reviewing code is part of the job
* You have experience with software development and coding in Python, Javascript/Typescript
* You’ve built and owned AI-native workflows in production, not just prototypes, and have debugged real-world model failures
* You can diagnose a complex enterprise engineering environment quickly, identify the highest-leverage intervention, and scope a meaningful engagement
* You've built and scaled IC-level technical teams and know what excellence looks like in the field: sharp scoping, clean delivery, and knowledge that stays at the customer long after the engagement closes

title: Category Manager
description:
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a dynamic, detail-oriented
**Category Manager – Mobility, Transit & Tourism t**
o own the end-to-end performance of this unified vertical on DigiHaat. You will build and scale a comprehensive mobility and tourism marketplace covering daily/regional transit options, stays, local experiences, guided tours, and travel-linked products such as handicrafts, local produce, and curated travel kits. You will onboard and manage supply, ensure listing quality, track bookings and fulfillment, and work with product and tech teams to deliver a seamless buyer journey across transit and travel.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Category Strategy and Growth
* Define and execute the category strategy for mobility, transit, and tourism with clear goals, priorities, and KPIs in collaboration with product, marketing, and business teams.
* Identify high-potential segments across transit & mobility (first-mile/last-mile connectivity, intercity bus/rail integrators, local transit options) alongside tourism segments (homestays, rural & heritage tourism, craft and culinary experiences, pilgrimage and wellness travel).
* Build the category roadmap around seasonality, commuting patterns, regional demand, festivals, and travel trends.
* Align category operations with broader business objectives of growth, network adoption, profitability, and customer satisfaction.
* Supply Onboarding and Partner Management
* Onboard and nurture a diverse supply base: transit operators, mobility service providers, homestay owners, tour operators, local guides, experience hosts, artisans, and tourism-linked sellers.
* Build strong relationships with mobility aggregators, transport operators, travel suppliers, and logistics partners to ensure service reliability, availability, and cost efficiency.
* Set and monitor service standards, cancellation/refund policies, and compliance requirements, including transport permits, local licenses, and safety norms.
* Handhold small transit operators, experience hosts, and first-time digital sellers through onboarding, catalogue creation, and platform best practices.
* Booking, Transit & Order Lifecycle Operations
* Monitor the full lifecycle from route search, booking, ticket issuance, and service delivery to post-trip feedback to ensure a smooth end-to-end customer experience.
* Track and resolve operational issues such as schedule disruptions, cancellations, no-shows, overbooking, service quality complaints, refunds, and physical product deliveries.
* Work with operations teams to streamline fulfillment for mobility bookings and tourism-linked retail products.
* Identify and implement process improvements to reduce operational costs and maximize booking efficiency.
* Pricing, Inventory and Demand Management
* Use demand forecasting to manage inventory, seat/stay availability, and peak/off-peak capacity across daily transit and travel seasons.
* Develop dynamic pricing strategies, bundled offers, and multi-modal travel packages (e.g., Transit Pass + Stay + Experience + Local Products) to improve conversion and basket value.
* Work with marketing on customer acquisition campaigns, transit usage incentives, destination-led promotions, and seasonal travel offers.
* Data-Driven Decision Making
* Use data and analytics to track category performance: GMV, total bookings, route throughput, conversion rate, repeat rate, cancellation rate, customer ratings, and partner reliability.
* Identify commuting and travel trends, regional transit bottlenecks, and category expansion opportunities.
* Deliver regular performance reports and actionable insights to internal and external stakeholders for continuous platform optimization.
* Listing Quality and User Experience
* Ensure listings, routes, and travel options are accurate, current, and compelling - covering departure/arrival schedules, stay descriptions, itineraries, amenities, pricing, availability, and policies.
* Analyze customer reviews, ratings, and ride/trip feedback to identify pain points and collaborate with tech/product teams to address them.
* Drive product enhancements for multi-modal travel discovery, transit routing, category search filters, and trust signals for mobility and travel services.

**Qualifications And Experience**

* Total Experience: 8–12 years in category management, marketplace operations, or business leadership roles.
* Mandatory Industry Experience: Direct, proven experience across Mobility / Transit, the Travel Industry, and Tourism Management.

title: Customer Success Manager, Booking for Business
description:
**About Us:**
At Booking.com, data drives our decisions. Technology is at our core. And innovation is everywhere. But our company is more than datasets, lines of code or A/B tests. We’re the thrill of the first night in a new place. The excitement of the next morning. The friends you encounter. The journeys you take. The sights you see. And the memories you make. Through our products, partners and people, we make it easier for everyone to experience the world.
  
  
**Role Title: Customer Success Manager, Booking for Business -**
**Gurgaon (Gurugram)**
At Booking.com for Business, you are the trusted face and voice of our platform for corporate customers around the globe. Whether representing us at business events and trade fairs or engaging directly with clients via phone and web meetings, you will be the key driver in attracting, connecting with, and supporting our business travel users.
  
  
You’ll bring passion, expertise, and a service-first mindset to every interaction—helping customers navigate our platform and adopt it in ways that bring real value to their companies. Your goal is to build long-lasting relationships grounded in trust, loyalty, and mutual success. You are “the representative” of Booking.com for Business for our corporate customers around the globe.
  
  
On business events as well as via the phone and web meetings, you will contact, attract, connect and inform corporate customers of our product and services. You will share your knowledge, your passion with our customers and teams and guide them in using Booking.com for Business to best fit them and their company’s needs.
  
  
Your goal is to build up a long term relationship full of trust and loyalty towards Booking.com for Business. Furthermore you will become an expert in the Business Travel industry and continuously enrich your knowledge in this area for and with all stakeholders involved.
  
  
With excellent communication skills and a strong service minded attitude you are the ideal connector to bring people together experiencing the world through Booking.com for Business.
  
  
Your key objective will be owning the customer lifecycle by activating and converting high value (potential) small business customers into loyal ambassadors. You will coach, educate and advise them through training, webinars, calls and interactive support materials giving them the confidence to be an expert in using our product themselves and spread the word.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Customer Lifecycle Ownership: Guide new and existing SME customers through the full customer journey—from onboarding and adoption to optimization and advocacy.
* Client Engagement: Regularly engage with customers via virtual meetings, phone calls, webinars, and selective live events to understand their business travel needs and demonstrate how Booking.com for Business can meet those needs.
* Product Education: Deliver tailored training and product walk-throughs to ensure customers are confident and capable in using our platform independently.
* Relationship Building: Act as the key point of contact and trusted advisor, building relationships grounded in trust, loyalty, and mutual success.
* Advocacy Development: Identify high-value users and support them in becoming Booking.com for Business ambassadors, promoting organic growth and user adoption.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Sales, Product, Marketing, and Support teams to relay customer feedback and drive continuous improvement in our offerings.
* Event Representation: Represent Booking.com for Business at relevant industry trade shows, conferences, and networking events to attract new customers and strengthen existing relationships.

**Key Stakeholders include:**

* Regional Leaders (CEM, ArM, RM and RD)
* HQ
* Product teams
* AE, AMs, KAMs

**Requirements Of Special Knowledge/skills**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Hospitality Management, Marketing, or work experience in a related field.
* Experience: 5+ years of relevant experience in the hospitality or commercial services sector, preferably in a customer-facing B2B role.
* Customer-Centric Mindset: Passion for delivering top-tier service and solving customer problems with empathy and efficiency.
* Communication Skills: Strong communication skills - in person and over the phone, comfortable hosting webinars, leading training sessions, and representing the brand at events.
* Commercial Acumen: Strong understanding of business travel dynamics and the ability to align platform capabilities with customer goals.
* Tech-Savvy: Comfortable working with digital tools, CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce), and virtual meeting platforms.
* Team Player: Collaborative mindset with the ability to work cross-functionally and contribute to a shared vision.

**Benefits & Perks - Global Impact, Personal Relevance**
Booking.com’s Total Rewards Philosophy is not only about compensation but also about benefits. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, as well as unique-to-Booking.com benefits which include:
  
  

* Annual paid time off and generous paid leave scheme including: parent, grandparent, bereavement, and care leave
* Hybrid working including flexible working arrangements, and up to 20 days per year working from abroad (home country)
* Industry leading product discounts - up to €1400 per year - for yourself, including automatic Genius Level 3 status and Booking.com wallet credit

**Inclusion at Booking.com:**
Inclusion been a core part of our company culture since day one. This ongoing journey starts with our very own employees, who represent over 140 nationalities and a wide range of ethnic and social backgrounds, genders and sexual orientations.
  
  
Take it from our Chief People Officer, Paulo Pisano: “At Booking.com, our people don't just build an outstanding workplace, it also creates a better and more inclusive travel experience for everyone. Inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. It’s a place where you can make your mark and have a real impact in travel and tech.”
  
  
We ensure that colleagues with disabilities are provided the adjustments and tools they need to participate in the job application and interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.
  
  
**Application Process:**

title: Customer Success Engineer
description:
**About GoKwik**
GoKwik is building the growth operating system for D2C and eCommerce brands, enabling businesses to optimise checkout, reduce RTO, power payments, drive retention, and unlock post-purchase engagement. With 15,000+ merchants globally and a growing presence across India, the UK, Europe, and the US, GoKwik is building technology and financial infrastructure that powers the next generation of digital commerce.
  
  
Why This Role Matters
  
  
As a Customer Success Engineer, you will help GoKwik merchants get the most out of our products by resolving technical issues, supporting product configurations, and ensuring seamless day-to-day operations. You will act as a trusted technical point of contact for enterprise merchants, combining strong troubleshooting skills with a customer-first approach to deliver timely resolutions and a consistently high-quality support experience.
  
  
What You’ll Own
  
  

* Merchant Technical Support: Serve as the primary point of contact for GoKwik merchants, providing timely and professional support through email and chat.
* Technical Troubleshooting: Investigate, diagnose, and resolve merchant-reported technical issues, escalating complex cases to the relevant internal teams when required.
* Product Configuration & Guidance: Assist merchants with product configurations, customisation requests, integrations, and best practices to improve product adoption and usage.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Engineering, Product, and other internal teams to resolve complex issues and ensure effective outcomes for merchants.
* Ticket & Case Management: Maintain accurate documentation of support tickets, issue descriptions, troubleshooting steps, escalations, and resolutions using Freshdesk and Freshchat.
* SLA & Customer Satisfaction: Meet support SLAs, prioritise cases effectively, and maintain high customer satisfaction through prompt and reliable issue resolution.
* Issue Analysis & Improvement: Identify recurring merchant queries and technical issues, analyse patterns, and recommend improvements to product functionality, support documentation, and workflows.
* Customer Communication: Keep merchants informed throughout the resolution process, explaining technical issues and solutions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Support Operations: Work in a roster-based environment, including weekend support and occasional evening coverage during peak periods.

Who You Are
  
  

* Have at least 2 years of experience in technical support, customer engineering, or a similar role, preferably supporting enterprise clients through email and chat.
* Have strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts clearly.
* Are skilled at troubleshooting technical issues, identifying root causes, and driving resolution independently or with cross-functional teams.
* Have experience using ticketing and customer support platforms such as Freshdesk and Freshchat.
* Understand eCommerce workflows and merchant-facing technology products.
* Have familiarity with Shopify, APIs, product integrations, or SaaS-based solutions; these will be an added advantage.
* Are organised, proactive, and capable of managing multiple support cases in a fast-paced environment.
* Demonstrate strong ownership, attention to detail, and a customer-first mindset.
* Are comfortable working in a roster-based support model, including weekends and occasional evenings when required.

Why GoKwik
  
  
At GoKwik, you will work closely with eCommerce merchants and help solve real-world technical challenges that directly affect their business operations and customer experience. You will gain exposure to a growing commerce technology ecosystem, collaborate with Product and Engineering teams, and contribute to improving both product reliability and merchant satisfaction.

title: Partner Success Manager
company: Acumen, Part of Sannam S4 Group
description:
**About Us**

Acumen, established in 2008 under the SannamS4 Group umbrella, is a premier internationalisation partner for educational institutions worldwide. Originating in India, we have expanded our services across Asia, North America, and beyond, providing comprehensive support to universities and organizations embarking on their global journeys.

**Our Mission and Approach**

Driven by research and rich data insights, Acumen offers innovative solutions tailored to the unique needs of each partner. Our end-to-end services empower educational institutions to establish and enhance their international presence, ensuring they receive trusted guidance and expertise at every step.

**Global Reach and Services**

With a strong presence in India, South and Southeast Asia, and North America, Acumen delivers excellence in education consulting, advisory, and implementation. Our services include in-country representation, high school engagement, agent management, enrollment services, and strategic consulting, all designed to help institutions thrive in today's competitive international education landscape.

**Our Team and Values**

Our diverse team of over 300 professionals, with a 70% female representation, embodies our core values: Collaboration, Agility, Impact, Empowerment, and Integrity. This commitment to diversity and inclusion fosters a dynamic and supportive environment, enabling us to deliver impactful solutions to our partners.

**Why Choose Acumen**

Our unique understanding of the education sector, combined with a people-first approach and student-focused insights, has made us an invaluable partner for educational institutions globally. We prioritise your needs, offering practitioner-led expertise and end-to-end support without taking commissions or selling services directly to students, ensuring our focus remains solely on enhancing your institution's success.

Partner with Acumen to navigate the complexities of international education and achieve sustainable growth in the global arena.

**The Opportunity**

The role holder will act as a key support and coordination function for the Partner Success Director and ICR teams, enabling smooth day-to-day operations while strengthening partner delivery, process implementation, and stakeholder engagement. The role carries strong ownership for partner success, operational excellence, and commercial support across university partnerships.

**Role Summary**

This role supports the Partner Success Director and ICR teams by managing day-to-day operations, streamlining administrative processes, and ensuring effective delivery across partner accounts. It enables ICRs to focus on core recruitment and partner engagement activities while maintaining oversight of billing, reporting, coordination, and compliance. The role also drives strong stakeholder relationships, supports onboarding and process adherence, and contributes to partner success by managing university accounts, identifying growth opportunities, and ensuring delivery against agreed objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Act as the primary point of contact for the Partner Success Director and ICR teams, supporting daily operations including calling support, Happay/PO management, administrative coordination, billing follow-ups, and monthly data/reporting requirements.
* Reduce administrative and tactical workload for ICRs, allowing them to focus on core partner and recruitment activities.
* Support the implementation and adherence to defined processes, procedures, and operational frameworks across teams.
* Build strong working relationships with ICRs to drive consistent process adoption and optimal delivery outcomes.
* Support the Partner Success Director in overseeing billing and invoicing for client accounts.
* Create, collate, and maintain territory and performance reports by client and region.
* Assist with onboarding and training of new hires, under the supervision of the Partner Success Director.
* Represent the client in meetings or activities when the ICR is unavailable.
* Proactively identify issues and escalate them in a timely manner for resolution.
* Provide regular feedback to the line manager on operational matters, competitor activity, market dynamics, and changes in the external environment (e.g., student visa policies).
* Support integration of compliance requirements into staff performance appraisals and annual objectives.
* Act as the internal voice of the ICRs, providing feedback on service delivery and opportunities for improvement.
* Create and update competitor university intelligence, including market practices and admissions processes.

**Partner Success & Commercial Focus**

* Take clear ownership of partner success across assigned university accounts.
* Manage and grow projects and university partnerships with a structured, outcome-driven approach.
* Build strong stakeholder relationships and ensure delivery against agreed objectives.
* Identify opportunities for account growth, renewals, and expanded engagement.
* Effectively manage both high-touch and light-touch accounts with clear follow-ups and tracking.
* Bring a commercial mindset to partner management and service delivery.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Public Relations, Management, Operations Management, or a related field (or equivalent combination of education and experience).
* Former ICR experience and/or overseas education at UG or PG level preferred.
* Demonstrated experience managing business activities in a globally diverse organisation.
* Strong project management skills with high attention to detail.
* High aptitude for software and technology.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to take initiative, think critically, and solve problems independently.
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities while delivering high-quality outcomes.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
* Willingness to travel (approximately 30%).
* Experience using project management tools and systems.

**Work Experience Requirements**

* 5+ years of experience in globally diverse organisations.
* Minimum 2 years of experience in the international education sector, with a strong understanding of international student recruitment dynamics across key source markets.
* Exposure to international research collaboration or partnership arrangements between institutions or faculty is preferred.
* A balanced background across client/partner servicing, advisory, and sales support roles is highly desirable.
* Strong understanding of the overseas higher education ecosystem, ideally with direct experience working within a university environment.
* Exposure to the UK, and/or Australian , New Zealand higher education sectors is strongly preferred, enabling confident leadership of client discussions and delivery of relevant sector insights.

Website Address: www.acumen.education

Social media: https://www.linkedin.com/company/acumen-edu/

title: Guest Advisory Lead
description:
**About Atlys**
Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.
  
  
Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.
  
  
Atlys is changing that.
  
  
We’re building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for
**1M+ travellers across 127 countries**
. But we’re still early.
  
  
**The Role**
We’re looking for a
**Guest Advisory Lead**
to lead a high-performing customer-facing team that turns traveller interest into confident decisions and successful conversions.
  
  
You’ll be responsible for
**leading, coaching, and developing the Guest Advisory team**
, while ensuring every customer receives clear, thoughtful, and personalised guidance. You’ll set the standard for customer conversations, drive team performance, and ensure consistent ownership of the customer journey from the first interaction through conversion.
  
  
This is a leadership role for someone who combines
**strong communication, commercial instinct, people management, and operational discipline**
, and thrives in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.
  
  
**The Job**

* Team Leadership & Performance: Lead, coach, and motivate the Guest Advisory team to consistently achieve customer experience and conversion goals.
* Customer Engagement: Oversee customer interactions across calls, chats, and email, ensuring travellers receive relevant guidance based on their travel needs.
* Conversion & Sales: Drive team performance across lead qualification, follow-ups, objection handling, and conversion while maintaining a customer-first approach.
* Coaching & Development: Conduct regular coaching, feedback, and performance reviews to improve communication, product knowledge, sales skills, and overall team effectiveness.
* Customer Experience: Ensure the team delivers clear, empathetic, and accurate guidance on Atlys products, visa processes, timelines, and next steps.
* Quality & Process Management: Monitor customer conversations and lead journeys to maintain high standards of quality, accuracy, ownership, and follow-through.
* Performance Tracking: Track key team metrics, identify performance gaps, and take proactive actions to improve productivity, conversion, and customer experience.
* Customer Insights: Identify recurring customer questions, objections, and pain points and turn these insights into actionable improvements for the team and business.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Marketing, Fulfilment, Product, and other teams to resolve customer issues, improve processes, and strengthen the overall customer journey.
* Data & Operations: Ensure lead, customer, and interaction data is accurate and up to date, while maintaining strong operational discipline across the team.

**The Ideal Candidate**
**You’ll Likely Thrive In This Role If You**

* Have 2+ years of experience in sales, pre-sales, customer success, customer experience, or another customer-facing role, with experience leading or mentoring a team.
* Have a strong track record of driving conversions, managing customer journeys, and achieving performance targets.
* Communicate clearly and confidently, with the ability to coach others and simplify complex information into easy, human conversations.
* Are empathetic and persuasive without being pushy, with a strong understanding of customer needs and buying behaviour.
* Are comfortable using data and performance metrics to identify opportunities and improve team outcomes.
* Are proactive, organised, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.
* Have strong ownership and problem-solving skills, and can step in to handle complex customer situations when required.
* Enjoy building teams, developing people, giving feedback, and creating a high-performance culture.
* Are comfortable working a 6-day schedule, with Monday to Friday in-office and a rotational WFH shift on either Saturday or Sunday.

*We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.*
**What You Can Expect**
Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.
  
  
**Here’s What You Can Expect**

* Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
* Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check-up on us.
* A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* Learning & development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* Great tools to do your best work, including high-spec equipment and software.
* An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.

Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.
  
  
*Come build the intelligence layer for global travel*

title: Client Partner, K12 - Cialfo
description:
What This Role Is
  
  
Across the Americas - from US school districts to Latin American international schools, counselors are the single point of contact between a student's ambition and the university system that will decide their future. Most of them are doing this work manually — tracking hundreds of applications in spreadsheets, chasing document deadlines by email, and making recommendations without the data to back them. When that system breaks down, it isn't a productivity problem. It's a missed deadline that closes a door a student spent years working toward.
  
  
Cialfo exists to close that gap, and how well that gap gets closed depends on two things happening at once: schools already on the platform getting real value out of it, and new schools discovering that this is the platform their counseling team actually needs.
  
  
That is what this role owns. You are the person a portfolio of high schools across North and South America trusts to make Cialfo work for them, and you are also the person who walks into a school that has never heard of Cialfo and makes the case for why that should change. Saige, our AI layer, is live, and part of what you own is making sure both existing and new schools actually adopt it rather than let it sit unused.
  
  
You own the renewal and growth of an existing book of schools, and the identification and close of new ones, across two markets that don't behave the same way — US schools and Latin American schools have different buying rhythms, different stakeholders, and often different languages. This role owns the health, retention, and growth of an assigned portfolio of US and LATAM K12 school accounts, operating from India on US hours.
  
  
What Makes This Role Different
  
  
Most account management roles in EdTech ask you to defend a territory. Most new-business roles ask you to build one from nothing. This role asks you to do both at once — which means you never fully switch off the instinct that wins new logos, and you never fully switch off the instinct that keeps existing ones. It also asks you to do it across two distinct markets under one remit, rather than one clean, homogenous territory.
  
  
It also asks you to do this across one of the widest timezone gaps in the Manifest portfolio. Being based in India while owning an Americas book of business isn't a limitation to work around — it's part of how Cialfo builds a genuinely global support model, and it means the muscle you build here (structured handoffs, tight written communication, deliberate scheduling around narrow overlap windows) is a distinct capability, not a compromise.
  
  
The Manifest ecosystem gives you something a standalone vendor doesn't have: when a school's ambitions extend beyond counseling — university outreach or student placement pathways — you can point to Explore or Kaaiser as part of the same infrastructure, rather than referring the school elsewhere. No competitor in this market holds that full arc.
  
  
The broader overseas education industry is contracting. Cialfo is growing. That gap is the argument for why now is the right time to be inside a school's counseling office, not outside it.
  
  
What You Own
  
  
**Existing school relationships across the Americas**

* Own the renewal and health of a defined portfolio of high school accounts across both US and Latin American markets
* Build direct relationships with counselors, IT teams, and school leadership — not just your primary point of contact
* Identify and resolve account risk before it becomes churn

**New school acquisition across the Americas**

* Build and work a pipeline of prospective schools across both markets
* Own the full sales cycle from first conversation to signed contract
* Translate Cialfo's platform value into terms that land with a counseling team meeting it for the first time, adjusting the pitch to how each market actually buys

**Onboarding and platform adoption**

* Lead onboarding and training tailored to each stakeholder group, from counselors to senior leadership, whether the school is new or renewing
* Drive adoption of Saige and other newer product features against each school's actual counseling workflow
* Ensure every stakeholder group understands the platform well enough to rely on it during peak application season

**Account growth and expansion**

* Build account-specific growth plans using engagement and outcome data, not general upsell targets
* Identify where a school's needs extend into other parts of the Manifest ecosystem and translate that into commercial opportunity
* Present renewal and expansion proposals with the credibility of someone who has actually used the data

**Client operations**

* Keep account records, interaction history, and pipeline status current in the CRM
* Translate recurring client feedback into structured input for the product team
* Structure your workflow and handoffs around narrow daily overlap windows that shift depending on whether you're working US or Latin American hours

What Success Looks Like
  
  
The markers below reflect where the Cialfo Americas client success and growth function is today. We'll calibrate the specifics once you're in the seat. These are directional, not fixed.
  
  
In the first three months, you know your existing portfolio well enough to have a point of view on which accounts are healthy in both markets, and you've built a working rhythm that makes the most of narrow live-overlap windows rather than fighting them — you've started building a real pipeline of prospective schools rather than a list of names.
  
  
By six months, your existing accounts show visibly higher adoption of features like Saige than when you started, and you've closed or are close to closing your first new schools in at least one of the two markets, without the timezone gap ever becoming the client's problem to manage.
  
  
By twelve months, you've built a portfolio that runs on trust rather than maintenance across both the US and Latin American book, and a track record of new schools who chose Cialfo because of how you made the case to them. What you built — on both sides of the book, in both markets — outlasts the individual deals.
  
  
The specifics will be calibrated once you're in the role. The direction won't change.
  
  
What You Bring
  
  
You've spent the better part of five years or more in customer success, account management, business development, or client-facing strategic consulting, ideally with exposure to SaaS, EdTech, or B2B technology sold into schools or comparable institutions. You've done both sides of this job before — closing new business and running an existing book — and you don't think of them as different skill sets, just different conversations.
  
  
You read data and use it to make decisions about an account before the client asks you to, not after. You track what a portfolio is worth today and what it should be worth, and you build the case to close that gap yourself — whether that gap is a renewal at risk or a school that hasn't signed yet.
  
  
You're comfortable moving between a counselor who's never used a CRM and a head of school who wants a strategic conversation about outcomes — and you adjust your approach for each without losing credibility with either. You're equally comfortable adjusting your approach between a US school district and a Latin American international school, because you know these aren't the same conversation wearing different accents.
  
  
You're fluent in English and comfortable working in Spanish or Portuguese, since a meaningful part of this book won't run in English at all.
  
  
You've built relationships across significant timezone gaps before, or you know exactly how you'd approach it: tight written communication, no reliance on catching people live, and a schedule structured enough that narrow overlap windows are a constraint you plan around, not an excuse.
  
  
This is a role with a defined book of accounts, an open territory of prospects, and real autonomy in how you manage both. You don't need someone checking in on your renewal strategy or your pipeline weekly.
  
  
You're coachable. This function is still being refined, and the person who thrives here treats feedback as part of getting better at the job, not as a threat to how they already do it.
  
  
Most importantly, you read the description of what Cialfo is building for schools across the Americas and your first reaction was that you already know exactly which relationships you'd deepen and which doors you'd knock on first — in both markets. That's the person this role is for.
  
  
Why Manifest
  
  
Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility — connecting students, schools, universities, and employers across 50+ countries. Our portfolio spans Cialfo (AI-powered college counseling, 2,000+ schools), BridgeU (university guidance for international schools globally), Kaaiser (trusted study abroad counseling since 1997 across India and Southeast Asia), and Explore (AI-powered university outreach, 1,000+ university partners). Together, we move talent across borders at scale. $700B flows annually in remittances from migrant workers. 85M workers will be missing from developed economies by 2030. We're building the operating system which changes that. $80M raised. Still early.
  
  
For this role specifically, the relationships you build with schools across the Americas — new and existing, in two markets that don't run the same way — are what turn Cialfo from a platform some schools use into the platform counseling teams across the hemisphere choose by default.
  
  
Cialfo is part of Manifest Global — a multi-brand group building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility, operating across 50+ countries.

title: SPL – EdTech and AI
description:
**About The Job SPL - EdTech And AI**
**Senior Project Lead – EdTech and AI**
**Location:**
Delhi
  
  
Founded in 2012, Central Square Foundation is a non-profit philanthropic foundation working with the vision of ensuring quality school education for all children in India. We believe that effective foundational learning is essential for better learning outcomes for all children in school. Development of foundational literacy and numeracy skills can help children progress to higher levels of learning and is an essential building block in a child's life.
  
  
We are driven by our mission to enable the school education system to adopt solutions that are scalable, sustainable and effective, so that all children get equal access to opportunities needed for leading a better life. CSF has prioritised five critical areas of work: Foundational Literacy & Numeracy (FLN); EdTech and AI; Early Childhood Education (ECE); Schools Governance; and High Potential Students (HPS).
  
  
Read more about our work at the CSF website: https://www.centralsquarefoundation.org.
  
  
**About EdTech And AI At CSF**
CSF's EdTech and AI initiative focuses on leveraging technology to enhance teaching and learning, both in classrooms and at home, through student-focused and teacher-directed interventions. Our goal is to improve foundational learning in primary grades and provide remediation support in middle school using evidence-based, scalable technology solutions.
  
  
**Role**
Since 2012, CSF has played a pivotal role in shaping India's EdTech ecosystem by bridging demand and supply, backed by rigorous research. We drive impact by:
  
  

* Supporting EdTech organisations to build contextually relevant, pedagogically sound products for low-income learners.
* Generating evidence on what works, how it works, and how to scale effective EdTech interventions.
* Partnering with governments to adopt and effectively implement evidence-backed EdTech solutions, strengthen the utilisation of public investments in technology, and influence policy and system priorities.
* Creating public goods to drive innovation and strengthen the broader ecosystem.

In the last five years, CSF has collaborated with 15+ EdTech organisations, 11+ state governments, and leading academic institutions, reaching over 10 million learners across India.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Senior Project Lead – EdTech and AI will lead CSF's government adoption, implementation and policy portfolio across EdTech and emerging AI-enabled opportunities in school education.
  
  
The role will translate CSF's EdTech and AI strategy into government adoption and sustained implementation at scale by:
  
  

* Leading partnerships across 3–4 states, from opportunity identification and programme design through procurement, implementation and institutionalisation.
* Building relationships with senior government stakeholders and supporting states to use technology investments effectively.
* Strengthening implementation systems, including Technical Support Units (TSUs), Programme Management Units (PMUs) and other technical-assistance structures.
* Contributing to CSF's engagement with the Ministry of Education and other central institutions.
* Managing teams, budgets and complex programmes while converting evidence and field insights into policy and system-level action.

The Senior Project Lead will report to the Associate Project Director – EdTech and AI.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Strategy, Portfolio Leadership & Growth
* Translate CSF's EdTech and AI strategy into priorities, workplans and measurable outcomes.
* Lead a portfolio of 3–4 state partnerships, ensuring clear strategies, milestones, ownership, risks and resource plans.
* Identify opportunities for evidence-backed EdTech and AI-enabled interventions and contribute to CSF's thinking on AI in education, digital infrastructure and technology-enabled governance.
* Government Adoption, Implementation & Institutionalisation
* Build demand for evidence-backed EdTech approaches and lead engagements from opportunity identification through scale-up and institutionalisation.
* Support quality-led procurement through programme specifications, technical requirements and implementation frameworks.
* Diagnose implementation bottlenecks using data and field insights, and strengthen government capabilities, ownership, monitoring and sustained usage.
* Government Engagement, Advocacy & Salience Building
* Build trusted relationships with senior state and central government stakeholders.
* Lead engagement with the Ministry of Education and other national institutions on EdTech, AI and digital education.
* Develop government-facing narratives and outputs, including concept notes, policy memos, guidelines, procurement language and implementation frameworks.
* Programme Management, Governance & Technical Assistance
* Lead programme design, partner selection, contracting, implementation planning, risk management, monitoring and course correction.
* Establish effective governance systems, including workplans, reviews, decision logs and deliverable tracking.
* Design or strengthen TSUs, PMUs and other technical-assistance structures, working with Evidence/M&E, Finance, Communications, State Reform and other CSF teams.
* Evidence, Knowledge & Thought Leadership
* Use evidence, implementation data and field learning to guide programme decisions and recommendations.
* Develop case studies, implementation playbooks, policy notes, frameworks and other knowledge outputs.
* Contribute to CSF's thought leadership on evidence-backed EdTech, AI in education, technology for governance and public investment in education technology.
* Team Leadership, Budgeting & Organisational Management
* Lead, coach and performance-manage a high-performing team while building ownership and execution capability.
* Own portfolio planning, budgeting, resource allocation, reporting and decision materials for leadership and other stakeholders.
* Coordinate across CSF teams and contribute to talent reviews, capability building and organisational priorities.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* 10+ years of relevant experience, including significant work with Indian state and/or central government systems. Preference will be given to applicants from Education, EdTech, or adjacent social sectors.
* Track record of leading complex, multi-stakeholder programmes from design through implementation and institutionalisation.
* Experience managing portfolios, budgets, teams and external partners with strong execution discipline.
* Master's degree in business, public policy, education, engineering, development studies or a related field.
* Demonstrated ability and track record in building senior government relationships and translating evidence and programme insights into policy, strategy and system-level outcomes.

**Desired Qualities**

* Strong commitment to improving learning outcomes and equity through public education systems.
* Systems thinker who connects policy, programmes, implementation, evidence and government incentives while remaining execution-focused.
* Entrepreneurial, self-directed and comfortable creating structure in ambiguous and evolving environments.
* Strong influencing, relationship-building, judgement and prioritisation skills across diverse stakeholders.
* Excellent synthesis and communication skills, with curiosity about emerging technologies and their responsible application to education and government systems.

**Compensation**
Remuneration will be competitive with Indian philanthropy and social-impact sector benchmarks, commensurate with experience.
  
  
**Application Process**
Interested candidates should submit a resume customised to role outlining relevant experience, a brief statement of interest outlining how your past experience and future aspirations connect to the role (max. 500 words) through the CSF Careers Portal by
**20th September 2026**
.
  
  
Candidates should apply only if they can
**commit to at least a three-year journey**
to help materialise CSF's 2025–2028 EdTech and AI strategy.

title: Head Strategic Partnerships
description:
***About Us***

We believe where a child is born should never determine how prepared they are for the future. Everyday, millions of children walk into government school classrooms with the same curiosity, dreams and potential as children anywhere else.

But as technology and AI rapidly reshape how we learn, work and solve problems, access to the skills and opportunities needed to thrive remains deeply unequal.

We exist to change that.

At Muskaan Dreams, our work begins with children and teachers. We spend time in classrooms, listen deeply to teachers, understand the realities of government schools, and design solutions that can work in the real world, not just in pilots.

We don't believe change can be created by building parallel systems. We believe in strengthening the public education system itself. That means working alongside teachers, school leaders, district administrations and state governments so that solutions can be adopted, sustained and eventually reach millions of children.

Over the last decade, this belief has taken us from working with a handful of schools to reaching nearly 1 million children, 5000+ government schools and 15000+ teachers across six states.

But for us, scale is not simply a number.

* Scale means a teacher feels more confident in her classroom.
* It means a child in a government school beginning to see herself as a problem-solver and creator.
* It means an education system becoming capable of sustaining change long after a programme or funder has exited.

Our ambition is to ensure that children in India's government schools are not simply consumers of technology but become confident problem solvers, critical thinkers, creators and future-ready citizens.

***Our Flagship Initiatives***

***Digital Shaala***

Digital Shaala transforms government school classrooms into engaging, technology-enabled learning environments. Through Smart Classrooms, curriculum-aligned digital content, teacher capacity building, and academic mentoring, the programme improves learning outcomes in Science and Mathematics while nurturing students' curiosity, confidence, and interest in STEM education and careers.

***AI-Saksham***

AI-Saksham prepares students and teachers for an AI-enabled world. Through experiential, classroom-integrated learning, students develop foundational AI literacy, computational thinking, critical thinking, creativity, problem-solving, and responsible AI practices.

The programme empowers young people with the skills and confidence needed to thrive in the future of work while enabling teachers to integrate AI meaningfully into classroom teaching.

As India prepares millions of young people for an AI-driven economy, we believe government schools must become the foundation of this transformation and not be left behind.

***Our Next Chapter***

Muskaan Dreams is entering a defining phase of growth.

Today, we manage an annual budget of approximately ₹20 crores, supported by leading corporations, foundations, philanthropies, and ecosystem partners.

Over the next 2–3 years, we aim to grow this into a ₹50 crore annual portfolio through a diversified and sustainable fundraising strategy built on long-term institutional partnerships rather than transactional grants.

Our larger ambition is to reach and impact 10 million children over the next five years while building one of India's leading organisations working at the intersection of AI, education, and government system transformation.

Achieving this will require more than funding. It will require a coalition of corporations, foundations, philanthropists, governments, technologists, educators, and leaders who share our belief that every child deserves the opportunity to thrive in an AI-enabled future.

***That is where you come in.***

***About the Role***

This is not simply a fundraising leadership role. It is an opportunity to help build the partnerships that could shape how millions of children experience education in an AI-enabled India.

As Director – Strategic Partnerships, you will work closely with the Founder & CEO and Leadership Team to bring together corporations, foundations, philanthropists, family offices, governments, and ecosystem leaders around a shared ambition: ensuring that children in India's government schools are not left behind as the world becomes increasingly technology and AI-driven.

You will lead Muskaan Dreams' institutional fundraising strategy, but your role will go far beyond raising capital.

You will help partners understand the problem deeply, imagine what is possible, and co-create long-term partnerships that combine philanthropic capital, technology, expertise, government systems, and on-ground execution to create sustainable change.

You will also build the team, systems, relationships, and institutional capabilities required to take Muskaan Dreams from a ₹20 crore organisation towards ₹50 crore in next 2-3 years and from reaching nearly 1 million children today towards 10 million over the next five years.

We believe the strongest partnerships are not transactions. They are built on trust, shared purpose, evidence, and a long-term belief in what is possible together.

***Key Areas of Focus***

***50%***
***– Corporate CSR Partnerships & Revenue Growth***

Lead Muskaan Dreams' corporate fundraising strategy by building long-term partnerships with leading Indian and global corporations.

Develop a strong pipeline of high-value opportunities, engage senior CSR leaders, and secure multi-year partnerships that enable sustainable organisational growth.

***30% – Foundations, Philanthropy & Institutional Grants***

Build and deepen relationships with Indian and international foundations, philanthropists, family offices, bilateral agencies, and institutional donors.

Lead grant strategy, proposal development, stewardship, renewals, and portfolio diversification while identifying funders aligned with Muskaan Dreams' long-term mission.

***20% – Strategy, Leadership & Institutional Growth***

Work closely with the Founder & CEO to shape Muskaan Dreams' long-term fundraising strategy, strengthen systems and processes, mentor the partnerships team, represent the organisation nationally, and identify new opportunities that strengthen institutional credibility and sustainability.

***What You Will Do***

You will build and manage relationships with some of India's most influential corporations, CSR leaders, philanthropies, foundations, family offices, and ecosystem partners aligned with Muskaan Dreams' mission.

You will own the complete partnership lifecycle from identifying opportunities and initiating conversations to proposal development, budgeting, presentations, negotiations, contracting, onboarding, stewardship, reporting, and partnership expansion.

You will engage senior decision-makers to understand both their business priorities and social impact goals, translating Muskaan Dreams' work into compelling partnership opportunities that create measurable impact for children while delivering strategic value to partners.

**Co-creating Partnerships for Scale**

This role goes beyond fundraising. You will work closely with our Program, Government Partnerships, Product, Finance, Communications, and Leadership teams to translate India's most pressing education challenges into ambitious, fundable, and scalable partnerships.

You will have the opportunity to bring together philanthropic capital, technology, government systems, and Muskaan Dreams' on-ground capabilities to help millions of students and teachers become future-ready.

These partnerships will span:

* AI Literacy, Computational Thinking & Future Readiness
* STEM Learning & Innovation
* Teacher Capacity Building & Leadership
* Government System Strengthening & Education Transformation
* 21st Century Skills, Life Skills & Student Agency

The ambition is not simply to fund programmes, but to build partnerships that demonstrate what works, create meaningful change for children and teachers, and scale sustainably through government systems.

You will also identify opportunities for consortium funding, strategic collaborations, innovation partnerships, employee engagement, technology partnerships, and ecosystem alliances that unlock long-term institutional growth and impact.

**Team Leadership & Institution Building**

You will lead and inspire a team of strategic partnerships professionals by setting ambitious goals, building strong execution systems, and creating a culture of ownership, collaboration, excellence, and continuous learning.

You will coach team members to independently build relationships, develop compelling proposals, manage donor portfolios, negotiate partnerships, and close meaningful opportunities — while developing future fundraising leaders within the organisation.

You will institutionalise strong forecasting systems, dashboards, review mechanisms, CRM discipline, proposal processes, partner stewardship, and fundraising governance that improve productivity, predictability, and decision-making across the function.

The goal is not only to deliver today's fundraising targets, but to build a partnership function capable of powering Muskaan Dreams' growth for the next decade.

***What Success Looks Like***

***Success in this role will mean:***

1. Fundraising Growth

Drive sustained year-on-year institutional fundraising growth, contributing significantly to Muskaan Dreams' journey from a ₹20 crore to ₹50 crore annual portfolio within 2–3 years.

2. A Predictable Fundraising Pipeline

Build and maintain a high-quality, qualified fundraising pipeline of at least 3–4× the annual fundraising target, providing strong visibility on conversions, renewals, and future revenue.

3. Strategic & Multi-Year Partnerships

Secure and grow multiple large, multi-year CSR and foundation partnerships while maintaining a strong 80%+ partner renewal/retention rate.

Success will be measured not simply by the number of partnerships but by their quality, longevity, scale, and potential to deepen over time.

4. Diversification & Strategic Value

Build a diversified funding portfolio that reduces dependency on a small number of funders while deepening important relationships beyond grants into government collaboration, technology, employee volunteering, knowledge, innovation, and ecosystem partnerships.

5. Team & Fundraising Systems

Build a high-performing partnerships team and institutionalise strong CRM, forecasting, proposal development, stewardship, reporting, and governance systems, enabling team members to independently manage a significant share of Muskaan Dreams' fundraising portfolio.

***Who We're Looking For***

We are looking for a leader who combines the relationship orientation of a partnership builder, the ambition of an entrepreneur, and the discipline of an institution builder. Someone who can sit across the table from a CEO, CSR Head, Foundation Director, philanthropist, or government leader and have a thoughtful conversation about not simply funding a programme, but what it will take to create lasting change at scale.

***Experience***

* 10–15+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, institutional fundraising, CSR, business development, consulting, enterprise sales, or corporate engagement.
* Demonstrated success in securing and managing high-value CSR and philanthropic partnerships.
* Experience engaging with CXOs, CSR Heads, Foundation Directors, Trustees, Family Offices, and other senior decision-makers.
* Proven experience leading high-performing teams and contributing to organisational growth.
* Experience in education, technology, development, or social impact will be an advantage.

***Capabilities***

* Exceptional relationship-building and stakeholder-management skills.
* Strong
  **storytelling, proposal writing, presentation, and negotiation**
  abilities.
* Ability to translate complex education and technology challenges into compelling partnership opportunities.
* Strategic thinker with strong execution capability.
* Ability to connect
  **mission, impact, evidence, and partner priorities**
  into a compelling narrative.
* Comfortable engaging with senior government officials, corporate leaders, philanthropists, educators, and ecosystem partners.
* Strong commercial acumen with a
  **partnership-first mindset**
  .
* Ability to build systems, processes, teams, and capabilities in a fast-growing organisation.

***Personal Attributes***

* **Deep commitment to educational equity and creating opportunities for every child.**
* Genuine respect for teachers and belief in their role as the most important agents of sustainable classroom change.
* Belief in working with and strengthening
  **government education systems to achieve scale and sustainability**
  .
* Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to build from first principles.
* High integrity, humility, empathy, and professionalism.
* Resilient and persistent in navigating long and complex partnership cycles.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and working in a fast-growing, evolving organisation.
* Passionate about building institutions that create lasting social impact.
* Motivated by both
  **ambitious outcomes and the human stories behind those outcomes.**

***This Role May Not Be Right For You If***

* You are more comfortable managing existing grants than building new strategic relationships.
* You see fundraising primarily as a transaction or a numbers game.
* You prefer short-term funding conversations over building relationships that may take months or years to mature.
* You thrive only in highly structured environments and are uncomfortable building new systems.
* You are unwilling to travel extensively or spend time understanding our work with children, teachers, schools, and government partners.
* You are looking for a role focused only on fundraising targets rather than
  **institution building and national-level impact**
  .

***Build the Future with Us***

There are fundraising roles where success is measured by the size of the portfolio you build.

We believe this role can be about something bigger. It is about finding people and institutions who believe that a child's future should not be limited by the school they attend. It is about helping a teacher feel more confident using technology in her classroom.

It is about enabling a child who may never have imagined herself working with technology to become a problem-solver, critical thinker, and creator. It is about bringing together philanthropy, technology, government, and educators to solve problems that no organisation can solve alone.

And ultimately, it is about ensuring that as AI transforms the world, millions of children and teachers in India's government schools have the skills, confidence, and opportunity to be part of that future.

If you want to build more than a fundraising portfolio — if you want to help build an institution, a movement of partners, and a more equitable future for millions of children — we would love to build it with you.

***Important note:***

**Location: Mumbai/Delhi | Hybrid | Travel across India and internationally, as required**

**Reports to: Founder & CEO**

**Member of: Leadership Team**

title: Head of Customer Expansion
description:
**About OneMetric**
OneMetric (formerly Growtomation) is a revenue enablement partner for B2B teams. We build revenue engines end to end: the systems and data the teams run on, the GTM execution that turns them into demand, closed deals, and retention, and the AI that makes the whole engine faster and smarter.
  
  
As an Elite HubSpot Partner, we work with high-growth companies across the US and globally, and we start with the real revenue problem, not the tool. Most companies buy these three pieces from three different vendors, then wonder why nothing connects. We run them as one.
  
  
**The problem we want to solve**
Our account managers and delivery leads own our client relationships today, and they do it well. But those relationships are built around the service the client hired us for, often CRM / RevOps work.
  
  
OneMetric now does more than CRM / RevOps. We also do go-to-market (GTM) strategy, consulting, web experiences, and AI transformation. Most clients don’t know that, because we haven’t built relationships with their senior leaders, like the CMO or CRO, or gone deep on their revenue problems.
  
  
We need someone to build on the trust our delivery teams have earned. Your job is to get closer to the C-suite, understand what’s holding back their revenue, and show where we can help beyond the original project.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
***Own the strategy***

* Set the plan for how we keep and grow our clients. Your goals are net revenue retention (NRR) in a few customers and client lifetime value (LTV), in many of them.
* Decide which accounts to grow, how, and in what order.

***Own the relationships***

* Be the main contact for senior leaders in our largest accounts.
* Act as a trusted advisor to their C-suite. Learn their revenue goals and problems, and talk in business terms, not tool terms.
* Work with account managers and delivery leads to map each account: who we know, who we don’t, and who matters.
* Build new relationships beyond our current champion, both up and across the client’s leadership team.
* Keep in regular touch with your accounts to learn what they need next and fix concerns early.

***Grow revenue***

* Work with Sales to sell more of what we do: GTM strategy, consulting, web experiences, and AI transformation.
* Add value in our customer marketing programs, like case studies and client stories, so strong relationships turn into visible proof.
* Spot churn risks early, and have a plan ready for each one.
* Build the process for taking new services to existing clients.

***Build & Lead the team***

* Build the team of customer success managers
* Lead, coach, and develop them.
* Teach account managers and delivery leads how to grow accounts the way you do.
* Plan who can step up next, so the team keeps growing.

**Minimum Requirements**

* 10 to 12 years in a similar role at a services company.
* US-based clients with contracts worth $100K or more a year.
* Strong B2B marketing basics. You can hold a real conversation with a CMO or CRO about pipeline and growth.
* Proven experience growing inside an account, not just up. For example, you started with a head of martech and built the relationship until you were working with the CMO.
* Experience leading and coaching a team.
* Strongly preferred: experience at a digital, marketing, martech, RevOps, Salesforce, or HubSpot agency.

title: Account Manager
description:
**About WhiteCrow**

We are global talent research, insight, and sourcing specialists with offices in the UK, USA, Singapore, Malaysia, Hong Kong, Dubai, and India. Our international reach has helped us to understand and penetrate specialist markets at a global level. In addition to this, our service is also extended to complement our client’s in-house talent acquisition teams.

**About our client**

For more than 80 years, our client’s engineers and product specialists have partnered with customers to produce highly engineered connectivity and sensing solutions that make a connected world possible.
